title: Customer Education Specialist
summary: The Customer Education Specialist creates and maintains Help Center documentation, self-service resources, and Runway Academy materials, including video scripts and tutorials. The role coordinates content launches with product and engineering teams, tracks content performance, and ensures customer-facing usage policies and terms are accurate.
description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.
 Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.
 About the role
 * Open to hiring remote across the US — we also have offices in NYC, San Francisco, and Seattle 
 Runway is growing fast, and so is the surface area of what users need to learn. We're looking for an Education Content Specialist to keep our Help Center accurate, our Academy content well-produced, and our users set up for success from day one.
 You'll sit within the Experience & Enterprise Enablement team, working closely with the Education & Enablement lead to execute against a content roadmap that spans written documentation, video scripts, and self-service resources. Every feature launch will have your fingerprints on it. You're the person who makes sure users don't have to guess.
 What you’ll do
   Write, update, and maintain Help Center articles across product features, billing, policies, and troubleshooting — keeping documentation accurate as the product moves fast

  Coordinate with engineering and product at launch time to ensure articles are live before features ship

  Audit existing Help Center content for accuracy and discoverability; surface recommendations based on support ticket trends and user feedback

  Create and maintain self-service content — FAQs, quick-start guides, troubleshooting flows — that reduces ticket volume and helps users help themselves

  Draft scripts for Runway Academy video tutorials, walkthroughs, and course modules

  Support production of Academy content: create supporting assets, prepare materials for recording, and help get finished content published and organized

  Build and maintain a library of templates, prompt guides, and project starters across Runway's tools

  Support production and publishing of office hours, webinars, and live Q&A sessions

  Keep Help Center documentation and Academy content consistent and cross-referenced

  Track the performance of content you've produced — article engagement, search deflection, CSAT — and flag gaps to the Education & Enablement lead

  Work with legal to ensure usage policies and terms are accurately reflected in customer-facing content

  What you’ll need
   2-3 years of experience in technical writing, documentation, education content, or a similar role at a software or SaaS company

  Ability to translate complex product features into clear, user-friendly language — across articles, scripts, and guides

  Experience shipping documentation on tight timelines with cross-functional dependencies

  Comfort with help center platforms (Zendesk, Intercom, or similar) and content management systems

  Familiarity with video content production and an instinct for how to structure and pace educational content

  Strong editorial judgment — you catch inconsistencies before they go live

  Organized and autonomous working style; you can manage a documentation backlog while staying responsive to urgent launch needs

  A bias toward action and a belief that no task is too small

  Familiarity building with LLMs to streamline and automate processes

   Nice to have 
   Experience with AI or creative tools — with genuine curiosity about how they work

  Background in or passion for the creative space — video, design, animation, or related fields

  Experience using support data (ticket volume, search queries, CSAT, completion rates) to prioritize content work

title: Engineering Manager, Cloud Infrastructure
summary: Replit seeks a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead and grow its Cloud Infrastructure team, overseeing infrastructure as code, networking, storage, compute, Kubernetes, and service mesh platforms. The role owns the cloud-platform roadmap and production reliability, while coaching engineers, managing performance and hiring, and staying technically involved in design, incidents, and safe infrastructure changes.
description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.
 About the Role
 Replit enables people to build software with AI. The infrastructure underneath that experience must make it straightforward to launch services, isolate workloads, and run reliable systems at scale.
 We're hiring a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead Cloud Infrastructure: the shared  infrastructure as code (IaC), networking, storage, compute, and service mesh  platforms that Replit's product and platform teams depend on. You'll lead and grow an existing engineering team building and operating these foundations, including Kubernetes, shared edge networking, service mesh and workload identity.
 This is a platform-building role with production accountability. You should be comfortable going deep on a design or incident while developing a team that does not depend on you for every decision.
 What You'll Do
    Own the cloud-platform roadmap.  Lead the team's IaC, networking, storage, compute, and service mesh platforms. Translate product, platform, reliability, and security needs into sequenced outcomes, balancing foundational investment, lifecycle work, and delivery commitments against the team's capacity.

   Make infrastructure repeatable and self-service.  Build maintained IaC interfaces for services, cells, connectivity, identities, and shared resources. Enable internal customer teams to provision infrastructure without bespoke coordination or dependence on individual experts.

   Operate what the team builds.  Own platform availability, upgrades, isolation, recovery, and incident remediation. Maintain clear SLOs, sustainable on-call coverage, and primary and backup owners for critical systems.

   Stay technically engaged.  Review designs and production changes, debug difficult failure modes, and use AI coding tools—including Replit—to prototype and automate. Apply rigorous review and verification to AI-generated infrastructure changes.

   Build and grow a high-ownership engineering team.  Coach engineers, develop technical leaders, set clear expectations, manage performance, and hire against agreed needs. Delegate meaningful ownership as the team grows.

  What You'll Bring
    Demonstrated engineering management.  You have led and developed engineers, made prioritization and performance decisions, hired thoughtfully, and delivered through a team—not only acted as its strongest individual contributor.

   Software-oriented infrastructure depth.  You have built and operated cloud platforms or distributed systems and can reason across infrastructure code, Kubernetes, networking, service identity, and stateful dependencies.

   Safe-change and production judgment.  You have owned consequential migrations and incidents, can explain failure modes and rollback limits, and know when simplifying a system is better than adding another platform.

   Platform-product and engineering judgment.  You understand internal customers, create interfaces other teams adopt, and make clear tradeoffs among reliability, developer autonomy, engineering effort, and workload efficiency.

  Nice to Have
   Experience with multi-tenant, cellular, regional, or dedicated enterprise infrastructure.

  Familiarity with GCP/GKE, Terraform or similar IaC systems, Cloudflare, Envoy/Istio, SPIFFE/SPIRE, and managed data services.

  Experience with large-fleet rightsizing, infrastructure consolidation, or migrating CI compute without disrupting developer workflows.

  A track record using AI tools to increase engineering output while preserving production safeguards.

title: Principal Customer Success Executive
summary: The Principal Customer Success Executive owns post-sale relationships with strategically important customers, advising C-suite stakeholders and driving satisfaction, retention, renewals, and growth through ServiceNow Impact delivery. The role leads complex transformations, governance, adoption, risk mitigation, and executive alignment while shaping strategy, identifying services opportunities, and mentoring customer success teams.
description:
Company Description
 It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
 Join us to put AI to work for people.
 Job Description
 As a trusted C-Suite / executive level advisor on ServiceNow offerings, the Principal Customer Success Executive (PCSE) owns the post-sale customer relationship, aiming to increase customer satisfaction and drive retention through Impact delivery. Principal CSEs are experienced individuals who bring a consultative, problem-solving approach to partnering with senior customer stakeholders to derive value from our platforms. They demonstrate a strong understanding of customer’s industry and specific business strategies, driving alignment between these factors and what ServiceNow can offer to enable better business outcomes for their customers. This role drives business transformation by maximizing the long-term strategic value of ServiceNow and ensuring that every aspect of the customer’s platform and capability are ready for expansion. 
 They provide strategic direction and mentorship to both customers and ServiceNow teams managing complex, multi-workstream programs. They play a pivotal role in resolving escalations and mitigating risks, ensuring adoption and usage is maintained at healthy levels. Principal CSEs focus on ensuring the customer recognizes the value of the ServiceNow Platform at all levels and stages, facilitating a smooth path to both renewal and up- and cross-sell. 
 Overall, Principal CSEs are responsible for fostering the relationship with C-suite level stakeholders in a smaller number of strategically important Impact accounts, with the aim of increasing customer satisfaction and driving retention and upgrades, where applicable. 
 Job Responsibilities:
  Lead high-complexity transformations in our largest and most strategic customers, ensuring all ServiceNow Customer Excellence roles align and deliver in accordance with governance frameworks, customer objectives, and organizational priorities; ultimately chaperoning Impact value management and demonstrating strategic oversight. 
 Proactively identify professional services pipeline opportunities through product capabilities road mapping, value blueprints and adoption analysis, providing pre-sales support for funnel opportunities as requested. 
 Partner with Impact team members (e.g., Customer Success Managers) leveraging the joint visibility of customer insights to create executive-ready narratives. 
 Work with senior executives to shape and influence customer organizational strategy by identifying emerging trends, refining best practices, and aligning delivery approaches with evolving market demands, and providing industry-specific thought leadership. 
 Drive operational consistency and excellence by standardizing delivery methodologies and ensuring adherence to governance and quality standards, interfacing with Delivery as required. 
 Establish relationships with ServiceNow leaders, advocating for product evolution based on customer insights, and mentoring other Customer Success resources on transformation best practices. 
 Identify areas of risk and take steps to prevent customer or revenue churn. 
 Work closely with Sales Teams to define and execute product adoption and customer retention plans. 
 Provide prescriptive guidance on internal project/program governance and help the customer create the appropriate governance models and ensure adherence. 
 Help the customer identify incidents where contractual SLAs were missed and take necessary action. 
 Improve overall customer satisfaction, as well as the satisfaction of their internal customers.
  Qualifications
 Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry. 
 Significant experience collaborating with senior IT and business leaders, with a track record of successfully translating corporate strategy/objectives with the applied use of ServiceNow technology in the context of the client’s environment. 
 PMP preferred; project management experience required. 
 Minimum 15+ years in client-facing roles with a focus on account management, consulting, or transformation leadership. Experience in executive-level leadership roles, with a proven track record of influencing senior stakeholders and driving strategic outcomes, is strongly preferred. 
 Experience in any of the following critical subject areas, with a demonstrated history delivering consulting services: 
  IT Strategy and Planning 
 IT Operations and Management 
 Human Resources 
 Security Operations 
 Customer Service Management 
 IT Processes 
 IT Governance 
 IT Portfolio, Program and Project Management 
 IT Project Delivery (SDLC) 
  Experience with project problem diagnosis, solution development, client communications, facilitation of decision making, documentation, managing client expectations, and team leadership. 
 Independently leverages AI to optimize workflows, tailor customer solutions, and inform strategic decisions.  
 Articulates AI system design, ethical implications, and platform use cases clearly, guiding peers and stakeholders in responsible, value-driven AI adoption.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact  globaltalentss@servicenow.com   for assistance.

title: Manager, Revenue Accounting
summary: The Manager, Revenue Accounting leads order management and revenue accounting, ensuring contracts are processed accurately and revenue is recognized in compliance with ASC 606. Responsibilities include owning revenue close and reporting, technical accounting, contract review, controls and audits, and driving process automation and AI adoption across the order-to-cash cycle.
description:
Who We Are

Finance leaders choose Billtrust to get paid faster, control costs, and maximize customer satisfaction. As the leader in B2B accounts receivable workflow and payment software, we provide the world’s leading brands with AI-powered solutions across the full AR lifecycle—from invoice presentment and payment processing to cash application and collections. With over 2,600 global customers, more than $1 trillion in invoice dollars processed, and a proprietary network of 13 million buyers, Billtrust delivers business value through deep industry expertise and a culture relentlessly focused on meaningful customer outcomes.

We’re an AI-first company, not just in what we build for our customers, but in how we work. Across every function, our teams use AI tools daily to work faster, make better decisions, and deliver higher-quality outcomes. We hire exceptional people, give them cutting-edge AI capabilities, and measure success by the impact they create. If you want to do the best work of your career at the frontier of AI and fintech, Billtrust is the place to do it.

Our Values

Customers

We relentlessly increase value for customer and do the right thing for them.

Action

We make ‘thoughtfully fast’ decisions, act quickly, cut through red tape, deliver progress not perfection, take ownership and accountability.

Team Spirit

We put the team ahead of ourselves, foster trust and respect, collaborate with passion, despise toxic politics, value our differences, and celebrate together.

Innovation

We challenge the status quo, experiment thoughtfully, and are novel and brilliant in what we create.

Excellence

We love to win, but we hate losing even more. We aspire to be the best and take pride in our work. When we fall short, we own it and come back stronger.

About the Role

The Manager, Revenue is a critical role responsible for overseeing order management and revenue operations, ensuring that customer contracts are booked accurately, revenue is recognized correctly, and the order-to-cash process runs smoothly. You will leverage AI tools and co-worker agents to automate order processing, flag revenue recognition exceptions, and accelerate month-end close, focusing your expertise on process accuracy, compliance, and team leadership.

Reporting to the Controller, this role leads the team responsible for order management and revenue accounting, partnering closely with Sales, Legal, and FP&A to ensure contracts are processed correctly and revenue is reported in compliance with ASC 606 and company policy.

What You’ll Do

Revenue Recognition & Technical Accounting

  • Serve as the organization’s subject matter expert on ASC 606, owning and maintaining the company’s formal revenue recognition policy.
  • Research and document technical accounting positions and memoranda for complex, non-standard, or new revenue arrangements, ensuring conclusions are audit-ready.
  • Own and evolve standalone selling price (SSP) methodologies and allocation approaches as products, pricing, and geographies expand.

Contract Review & Deal Partnership

  • Lead review of complex and strategic customer contracts, determining revenue treatment and advising on deal structure before terms are finalized.
  • Partner proactively with Legal, Sales, and Order Management during deal structuring to flag revenue recognition implications early, rather than only reviewing after signature.

Fluctuation Analysis & Close Ownership

  • Own the end-to-end monthly revenue close, including flux/variance analysis, and prepare clear explanations of revenue movement for executive and board-level audiences.
  • Own deferred revenue, unbilled receivables, and contract asset/liability reconciliations, ensuring balances tie to source data and the general ledger.

Internal Controls

  • Design, document, and continuously improve internal controls over  the quote-to-cash cycle
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external auditors on revenue matters, owning PBC packages, walkthroughs, and audit responses.

Internal & External Reporting

  • Prepare and review revenue-related financial statement disclosures and supporting schedules for external reporting.
  • Deliver management reporting and analysis that informs decisions made by FP&A, executives, and the board.

Process Automation & AI Adoption

  • Lead automation and process-transformation initiatives across the revenue close and order-to-cash cycle, building or directing the build of tools that reduce manual work.
  • Maintain a working practice with AI tools (e.g., LLMs, copilots) for tasks such as contract term extraction, reconciliation matching, anomaly detection, and first-draft variance narratives, with clear judgment on where AI output still requires human review.
  • Drive the strategy and roadmap for revenue-related systems improvements, partnering with Engineering/Business Systems on implementation.

ERP & Systems Fluency

  • Maintain deep fluency in the company’s ERP, CRM, and revenue subledger systems (e.g., Salesforce, Intacct, Billing Platform, Certinia, or equivalent), including leading system integrations or migrations affecting revenue.

What You’ll Bring

Required Skills:

  • 7+ years of experience in revenue accounting, order management, or a related accounting function.
  • Track record driving AI adoption across a team or function, using AI tools to automate order processing and revenue recognition workflows.
  • Strong knowledge of ASC 606 revenue recognition principles and their application to SaaS or subscription contracts.
  • Experience managing or leading a team of accounting or order management professionals.
  • Proven ability to partner cross-functionally with Sales, Legal, and FP&A.
  • Strong attention to detail and a track record of managing accurate, timely month-end close processes.

Preferred Skills:

  • CPA or progress toward CPA certification.
  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, or subscription-based business models.
  • Experience with ERP and CPQ systems.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered accounting or revenue automation tools.

What You’ll Get

At Billtrust, we believe your total rewards should reflect the impact you make. Our benefits package includes comprehensive health coverage, competitive retirement, generous PTO and parental leave, flexible work options, and meaningful investment in your professional development. We’re building something special and we want you to feel supported while doing it.

At Billtrust, we value an equitable and inclusive work environment and strive to build and foster diverse teams. Even if your work experience doesn’t align exactly with the position requirements, we’d still love to hear from you. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.

We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace that celebrates and supports diversity and inclusion. We make all employment and related decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.

title: Sr. Engineer II (remote)
summary: The Sr. AI SDLC Engineer II will build agentic AI platforms and workflows that automate software development lifecycle tasks, improve context retrieval and model routing, and provide observability and benchmark tooling. The role partners with engineering teams to identify workflow friction and advance responsible, cost-conscious AI adoption.
description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

   About the Role:  
  CrowdStrike's engineering organization is scaling its use of agentic AI across the software development lifecycle — from code generation to review to testing and release. As a Sr. AI SDLC Engineer II, you'll help drive that transformation: building the platforms and workflows that let engineers ship faster, offload well-scoped work to AI agents with confidence, and spend more of their time on the hardest problems. You'll partner closely with engineering teams to identify friction points across the dev lifecycle and turn them into automated, agent-driven capabilities — with an eye toward efficient use of compute and model spend along the way. 

   What You'll Do:  

   Design and build agentic workflows that let engineers automate more of the SDLC — from code generation and review to testing and release — with confidence in the output. 
  Improve context-grounding systems so agents resolve the right information on the first try, cutting slow, error-prone multi-turn search out of the workflow. 
  Tune model-routing so each task runs on the model best suited to it — matching capability to the job at hand, with cost efficiency as one input among several. 
  Build observability and quality tooling — dashboards, usage insights, benchmark suites — that give engineers confidence in what agents are doing and how well they're doing it. 
  Establish internal benchmarks graded against real-world tasks (bug detection, review quality, latency) to validate improvements empirically rather than by intuition. 
  Partner closely with engineering teams to identify high-friction points in their workflows and turn them into automated, agent-driven capabilities. 
  Contribute to the broader engineering culture of responsible, effective AI adoption across the organization. 
 
   What You'll Need:  

   5+ years of backend/platform engineering experience, ideally with production Kubernetes systems. 
  Hands-on experience building or operating LLM-agent infrastructure — harnesses, tool-integration protocols, subagent orchestration, or similar. 
  Strong understanding of LLM application mechanics: context windows, prompt design, caching, and reasoning/latency tradeoffs. 
  Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes. 
  Comfort working from ambiguous, evolving specs. 
  Go and/or Python proficiency. 
  Experience building internal developer platforms, observability tooling, or cost/governance dashboards. 
 
   Bonus Qualifications  

   Experience with modern AI coding agent frameworks or SDKs. 
  Familiarity with graph-based context systems (knowledge graphs, entity resolution) feeding LLM applications. 
  Background instrumenting or optimizing large-scale event pipelines. 
  Prior experience running a benchmark-driven optimization program (A/B testing, Pareto-frontier tracking) for a production system.

 CrowdStrike's engineering organization is scaling its use of agentic AI across the software development lifecycle — from code generation to review to testing and release.   Build observability and quality tooling — dashboards, usage insights, benchmark suites — that give engineers confidence in what agents are doing and how well they're doing it. 
  Establish internal benchmarks graded against real-world tasks (bug detection, review quality, latency) to validate improvements empirically rather than by intuition. 
  Partner closely with engineering teams to identify high-friction points in their workflows and turn them into automated, agent-driven capabilities. 
  Contribute to the broader engineering culture of responsible, effective AI adoption across the organization.

   5+ years of backend/platform engineering experience, ideally with production Kubernetes systems. 
  Hands-on experience building or operating LLM-agent infrastructure — harnesses, tool-integration protocols, subagent orchestration, or similar. 
  Strong understanding of LLM application mechanics: context windows, prompt design, caching, and reasoning/latency tradeoffs. 
  Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes. 
  Comfort working from ambiguous, evolving specs. 
  Go and/or Python proficiency. 
  Experience building internal developer platforms, observability tooling, or cost/governance dashboards. 
 
   Bonus Qualifications:  

   Experience with modern AI coding agent frameworks or SDKs. 
  Familiarity with graph-based context systems (knowledge graphs, entity resolution) feeding LLM applications. 
  Background instrumenting or optimizing large-scale event pipelines. 
  Prior experience running a benchmark-driven optimization program (A/B testing, Pareto-frontier tracking) for a production system.

  Mission-Driven: We focus on creating economic and social impact.
 People-Centric: We care deeply about our team’s growth, well-being, and sense of belonging.

  If you’re passionate about innovation, collaboration, and making a real impact, we’d love to have you on board!

 Energy, Oil & Gas is one of the most operationally complex and asset-intensive industries, where AI is rapidly moving from experimentation to enterprise-scale deployment.
While the opportunity is significant, many organizations struggle to move from promising pilots to production-grade AI due to fragmented data, complex environments, and strict safety and regulatory requirements.
 CloudFactory is built to solve exactly this.
 As Client Principal, AI Consulting (Energy, Oil & Gas), you will be the senior commercial and strategic leader for our energy sector. You will operate as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders across operators, oilfield services companies, and energy enterprises, shaping AI transformation agendas and leading engagements from origination through delivery oversight.
 This is a high-impact, externally facing role for someone who can open doors, lead complex conversations, and convert opportunity into long-term partnerships.

  Executive Relationships & Strategic Advisory 
  Build and lead market growth strategy across energy operators, oilfield services companies, and energy enterprises.

 Engage C-suite and VP stakeholders as a trusted advisor, not a vendor.

 Develop a deep understanding of client priorities across upstream, midstream, and downstream operations.

  Own new client acquisition, account expansion and P/L management accounts within the energy sector.
 Develop and execute strategic account plans with clear pathways from pilot to enterprise-scale programs.
 Lead consultative, executive-level sales conversations and build compelling business cases for AI investment.
 Own the full commercial lifecycle: discovery, solution framing, proposal development, and executive presentations.
 Navigate sector-specific buying cycles, procurement processes, and capital planning timelines.

title: Principal Customer Success Executive, U.s. Federal
summary: The Principal Customer Success Executive owns post-sale relationships with strategically important U.S. Federal customers, serving as a senior executive advisor focused on customer satisfaction, retention, adoption, and expansion. The role leads complex transformations, provides strategic and governance guidance, identifies risks and professional services opportunities, and partners with customers, sales teams, and ServiceNow stakeholders to deliver platform value.
description:
Company Description
 It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
 Join us to put AI to work for people.
 Job Description
 As a trusted C-Suite / senior executive level advisor on ServiceNow offerings, the Principal Customer Success Executive (PCSE) owns the post-sale customer relationship, aiming to increase customer satisfaction and drive retention through Impact delivery. Principal CSEs are experienced individuals who bring a consultative, problem-solving approach to partnering with senior customer stakeholders to derive value from our platforms. They demonstrate a strong understanding of customer’s industry and specific business strategies, driving alignment between these factors and what ServiceNow can offer to enable better business outcomes for their customers. This role drives business transformation by maximizing the long-term strategic value of ServiceNow and ensuring that every aspect of the customer’s platform and capability are ready for expansion.  
 They provide strategic direction and mentorship to both customers and ServiceNow teams managing complex, multi-workstream programs. They play a pivotal role in resolving escalations and mitigating risks, ensuring adoption and usage is maintained at healthy levels. Principal CSEs focus on ensuring the customer recognizes the value of the ServiceNow Platform at all levels and stages, facilitating a smooth path to both renewal and up- and cross-sell.  
 Overall, Principal CSEs are responsible for fostering the relationship with C-suite level stakeholders in a smaller number of strategically important Impact accounts, with the aim of increasing customer satisfaction and driving retention and upgrades, where applicable.  
   What You Get to Do in This Role:  
  Lead high-complexity transformations in our largest and most strategic customers, ensuring all ServiceNow Customer Excellence roles align and deliver in accordance with governance frameworks, customer objectives, and organizational priorities; ultimately chaperoning Impact value management and demonstrating strategic oversight.  
 Proactively identify professional services pipeline opportunities through product capabilities road mapping, value blueprints and adoption analysis, providing pre-sales support for funnel opportunities as requested.  
 Partner with Impact team members (e.g., Customer Success Managers or other Customer Success Executives) leveraging the joint visibility of customer insights to create executive-ready narratives and platform value stories.  
 Work with senior executives to shape and influence customer organizational strategy by identifying emerging trends, refining best practices, aligning delivery approaches with evolving market demands, and providing industry-specific thought leadership.  
 Drive operational consistency and excellence by standardizing delivery methodologies and ensuring adherence to governance and quality standards, interfacing with Delivery as required. Advise on change management plans to support strong post-delivery adoption. 
 Establish relationships with ServiceNow leaders, advocating for product evolution based on customer insights, and mentoring other Customer Success resources on transformation best practices.  
 Identify areas of risk and take steps to prevent customer or revenue churn.  
 Work closely with Sales Teams to define and execute product adoption and customer retention plans.  
 Provide prescriptive guidance on internal project/program governance and help the customer create the appropriate governance models and ensure adherence.  
 Help the customer identify incidents where contractual SLAs were missed and take necessary action.  
 Improve overall customer satisfaction, as well as the satisfaction of their internal customers. 
  Qualifications
  To be successful in this role you have: 
  Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.  
 Significant experience collaborating with senior IT and business leaders, with a track record of successfully translating corporate strategy/objectives with the applied use of ServiceNow technology in the context of the client’s environment.  
 PMP preferred; project management experience required.  
 Minimum 15+ years in client-facing roles with a focus on account management, consulting, or transformation leadership throughout all phases. Experience in executive-level leadership roles, with a proven track record of influencing senior stakeholders and driving strategic outcomes, is strongly preferred.  
 Experience supporting or working with U.S. Federal customers preferred

 IT Operations and Management  
 Human Resources  
 Security Operations  
 Customer Service Management  
 IT Processes  
 IT Governance  
 IT Portfolio, Program and Project Management  
 IT Project Delivery (SDLC) and adoption

 Independently leverages AI to optimize workflows, tailor customer solutions, and inform strategic decisions.   
 Articulates AI system design, ethical implications, and platform use cases clearly, guiding peers and stakeholders in responsible, value-driven AI adoption.

description:

We're looking for a People Programs Manager who brings the rigor of a great operator, the instincts of a strategist, and the curiosity of someone who genuinely wants to reimagine how HR works in an AI-first world.

title: Senior Cloud Security Automation & AI Engineer- Remote (anywhere in the U.s.)
summary: The Senior Cloud Security Automation & AI Engineer will deliver and secure AI/ML solutions across multi-cloud environments, including agentic AI architectures, AI gateways, governance controls, and security automation. The role also includes technical oversight, mentoring, presales support, client engagement, reusable framework development, and thought leadership.
description:
GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

General Description

We are looking for a skilled Senior Cloud Security Automation & AI Engineer to support the Cloud Security Automation and AI Practice. This role combines hands-on delivery, technical oversight, presales support, and practice development to help organizations adopt and secure AI/ML platforms across multi-cloud environments.

The Senior Cloud Security Automation & AI Engineer will be required to demonstrate strong technical depth across cloud-native AI services, agentic AI design patterns, and AI governance frameworks. This individual will compose and secure agentic AI solutions, implement AI gateways and policy-based controls, and translate complex security and automation requirements into actionable, outcome-driven solutions. They will lead by influence and bring business acumen to drive the adoption of progressive cloud security automation programs aligned with client objectives and practice priorities.

 

About the Cloud Security Automation and AI Practice

The Cloud Security Automation and AI Practice is responsible for helping organizations securely adopt, deploy, and govern AI/ML workloads and automation pipelines across cloud environments. We deliver advisory, implementation, and managed services that bridge the gap between innovation and security.

Our team of engineers, architects, and consultants focuses on cloud-native AI platforms, security automation frameworks, and enterprise AI governance. We partner with clients, account executives, and technology vendors to deliver solutions that reduce risk while accelerating AI adoption.

  • Deliver secure AI/ML platform implementations across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and third-party enterprise AI platforms
  • Develop reusable automation frameworks, accelerators, and reference architectures for AI security
  • Drive thought leadership and practice growth through presales support, content development, and industry engagement

 

Roles and Responsibilities

Delivery & Technical Execution

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of cloud security automation and AI engagements, including scoping, architecture design, implementation, and client handoff
  • Design and implement secure agentic AI solutions, including multi-agent orchestration, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, AI gateway architectures, and policy-based access controls using frameworks such as Cedar
  • Architect and enforce AI governance policies, including usage policies, data handling controls, model access management, and compliance guardrails for enterprise AI deployments
  • Develop and deploy AI-powered security automation solutions (e.g., automated compliance checks, threat detection agents, remediation workflows) for clients
  • Produce high-quality deliverables including architecture documents, runbooks, SOPs, and security assessment reports

Technical Oversight & Quality Assurance

  • Provide technical oversight and quality assurance across active engagements, ensuring deliverables meet GuidePoint standards and client expectations
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers on best practices for cloud security, AI/ML implementation, and secure development
  • Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, and security assessments for AI/ML workloads

Presales & Business Development Support

  • Support presales activities by participating in client discovery calls, demos, and technical deep dives
  • Contribute to proposals, statements of work (SOWs), and pricing estimates for AI security and automation engagements
  • Collaborate with account executives and practice leadership to identify opportunities and shape client solutions

Practice Development & Thought Leadership

  • Contribute to practice development by building reusable tools, templates, accelerators, and reference architectures
  • Develop thought leadership content such as blog posts, whitepapers, webinars, and conference presentations
  • Stay current on emerging AI/ML platforms, cloud security trends, and regulatory developments to inform practice strategy

 

Required Experience and Education

  • Bachelor's Degree (BS/BA) + 5-7 years of experience
  • Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, or securing AI/ML workloads in cloud environments
  • Hands-on proficiency with primary AI/ML platforms: Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Q, and Amazon SageMaker
  • Preferred experience with secondary platforms: Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure Machine Learning
  • Experience in a client-facing consulting or professional services role
  • Embraces emerging technologies, including AI tools, to work smarter, solve problems, and drive better business outcomes
  • Basic Python competency, including the ability to read, write, and troubleshoot code for automation and integration tasks
  • Understanding of agentic AI patterns, AI governance frameworks, and secure AI composition (e.g., multi-agent orchestration, tool-use guardrails, prompt injection mitigation)

 

Technology Proficiency

Primary (AWS)

  • Amazon Bedrock
  • Amazon Q (Business, Developer)
  • Amazon SageMaker

Secondary (Azure)

  • Azure AI Foundry
  • Microsoft 365 Copilot
  • Copilot Studio
  • Azure Machine Learning

Additional Platforms

  • Gemini for Google Workspace
  • Claude for Enterprise (Anthropic)
  • ChatGPT Enterprise / OpenAI Platform

AI Security & Governance

AI Gateways (centralized proxy, traffic control, policy enforcement)

Model Context Protocol (MCP)

Cedar (AWS policy language for fine-grained authorization)

title: Principal Forward Deployed Engineer
summary: The Principal Forward Deployed Engineer embeds with strategic customers to design, build, and operate production solutions using Docker, AI agents, and enterprise systems. Responsibilities include owning technical delivery, integrating Docker with customer infrastructure, making AI adoption secure and governable, mentoring FDEs, influencing product direction, and shaping repeatable delivery practices.
description:
About Docker 
 Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.
 _______________________________________________________________________
 Docker Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) embed directly with our most strategic customers to solve important, complex technical problems and turn ambitious ideas into production outcomes. FDEs take on the most challenging technical challenges using existing Docker products and patterns when possible, and work across customer, Docker Product and Engineering teams to realize new approaches when required.
 As a Docker FDE, you will work side-by-side with customer engineering teams to deeply understand their goals, problems, constraints, and technical landscape; identify the highest-leverage opportunities; and design, build, and ship solutions with them. You own the technical journey from discovery and architecture through prototyping, implementation and production rollout.
 The solutions you build may use existing Docker products, extend Docker into new environments, integrate deeply with customer and third-party systems, or reveal capabilities that Docker should build next. You work closely with Docker Solutions Architects to evolve existing patterns, and Docker Product and Engineering to turn new learnings into reusable patterns and product capabilities.
  Responsibilities 
  Build in Production with Customers 
   Embed with customer engineering teams to design, build, and ship solutions from first prototype through stable production rollout. Use existing Docker products and patterns when possible, invent, prototype and validate innovative solutions when necessary.

  Deliver working technical artifacts to customers: custom MCP servers with tightly integrated Docker Sandbox environments for coding agents and containerized agents; Docker Compose definitions for multi-agent harnesses and model-backed applications; Hardened Image standardization and migration; New tools that unblock customer progress.

  Integrate Docker's AI platform with the customer's existing stack, including identity providers (OIDC/SAML/SSO), secrets management, private and air-gapped registries, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling.

  Own technical delivery on your engagements: scope the work, sequence it, make trade-offs between speed and quality, remove blockers early, and contribute directly to code whenever progress depends on it.

   Make AI Adoption Safe and Governable 
   Translate customer security, compliance, and platform requirements into concrete plans and see those plans through from ideation to production.

  Help customers define controls to enable them to adopt agentic AI to solve their unique business problems without compromising security, compliance, data sovereignty or end-user experience.

  Establish quality and performance standards for customers and work closely with Docker Product and Engineering to quickly address issues that fall outside of established thresholds

  Partner with customer security and platform teams to get agentic workloads through architecture review, threat modeling, and change control.

   Partner with Solutions Architecture and the Field 
   Work closely with Solutions Architects to enable off-the-self solutions when possible and provide technical experience and leadership when a bespoke solution is necessary.

  Feed implementation learnings back into reference architectures, SOW templates, and success patterns so that FDE innovations become standard features and implementation patterns.

  Support the field with technical depth during proofs of concept, escalations, and expansion conversations when a working build is the fastest path to a customer adoption.

   Close the Loop with Product and Engineering 
   As part of Docker Engineering FDEs work closely with Product and Engineering teams to fold FDE innovations, learnings, and design patterns into existing or new products and services.

  Work with Customers, Product and Engineering to establish quality and performance thresholds, ensuring customer environments meet them consistently, and responding quickly and decisively when they don’t.

  Be the voice of the customer. Deliver data-driven and actionable feedback to Product and Engineering: what works well; what does not; what customers are asking for; and what blocks their adoption and forward progress. FDE experience directly influences the roadmap.

   Shape the Practice 
   Define the FDE engagement model, delivery standards, and quality bar, and codify them so that engagements are consistent across customers, regions, and delivery partners.

  Mentor and lead other Forward Deployed Engineers, and participate in hiring loops to grow the team.

  Act as the senior technical escalation point on the hardest problems impacting your customers. Every incident is an opportunity to improve Docker products and services.

  Maintain deep, current knowledge of the agentic AI stack: LLMs, APIs, MCP, coding agents, model and harness evaluation approaches, performance and quality thresholds, deployment patterns.

  This role may require participation in an on-call rotation to provide support outside of standard business hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as needed.

   Qualifications 
  Required 
   10+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role such as Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Professional Services Engineer, or Software Engineer with consulting or technical founder experience.

  Technical leadership across multiple engagements, teams, or domains, with a proven ability to set delivery standards, define repeatable patterns, and influence product direction through field evidence.

  Expert production coding skills in Go, Python, or TypeScript, with a track record of shipping and operating software that other people depend on and of leading technical design reviews.

  Deep, hands-on Docker expertise: Dockerfiles and multi-stage builds, Docker Compose, image and registry operations, container networking and storage, and container security fundamentals.

  Hands-on experience building with LLMs and agents in production, including tool use and function calling, the Model Context Protocol (MCP server and client implementation), prompt and context engineering, and evaluation of agent behavior.

  Working knowledge of software supply chain security: SBOMs, image signing and attestation, vulnerability management, minimal and hardened base images, and secure CI/CD.

  Experience integrating with enterprise systems: identity providers (Okta, Entra ID, LDAP/Active Directory), federated identity protocols (OIDC, SAML), secrets managers, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP).

  Ability to scope and deliver complex work in ambiguous, fast-moving customer environments, making sound trade-offs between scope, speed, and quality.

  Excellent communication skills with engineers, security and platform teams, and executive stakeholders, with a low-ego, collaborative approach and the ability to lead through influence rather than authority.

  Proven track record of technical mentorship and of raising the bar for the engineers around you.

  High agency and comfort operating autonomously in distributed, remote-first teams.

  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  Travel to customer sites to build in person with customer teams, estimated at up to 50%.

   Bonus  
   Experience with Docker Hardened Images, Docker Scout, MCP Gateway, MCP Toolkit, Docker Sandboxes, or Docker Model Runner.

  Experience deploying and operating coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, or similar) in team or enterprise settings.

  Experience with air-gapped, regulated, or compliance-driven environments in financial services, healthcare, government, or similar sectors.

  Contributions to open source projects in the container, Kubernetes, or MCP ecosystems.

  Prior experience founding or scaling a Forward Deployed Engineering or Professional Services practice.

   Docker considers visa sponsorship on a case-by-case basis based on business needs. 
  Compensation & Equity 
  United States:  $198K – $319K + equity

    Remote-first by design  – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.

   Docker swag  – Because representing the whale never gets old.

Responsibilities include sales analytics, forecasting, pipeline and performance analysis, dashboard development, statistical analysis, AI-assisted analytics, workflow automation, and communicating executive-ready findings in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment.
description:
Job Title:
Senior Business Intelligence Analyst Job Description
 Join our award-winning One Concentrix team as a BI Analyst supporting one of the world's most innovative AI-native technology companies. This role operates at the intersection of AI, customer outcomes, partner performance, and business transformation in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where speed, ownership, and execution matter.

  ABOUT CONCENTRIX 

 At Concentrix, we help the world's best brands build exceptional customer experiences through innovative technology, operational excellence, and human-centered solutions. As organizations accelerate adoption of AI, automation, cloud technologies, and digital transformation initiatives, Concentrix partners with clients and strategic ecosystem partners to deliver measurable business outcomes at scale.

 We are seeking a BI Analyst to drive the help successful delivery, adoption, and expansion of partner-led AI solutions while ensuring customers achieve meaningful business value and long-term success.

 Success in this role requires comfort operating in a highly dynamic, rapidly evolving environment where priorities shift quickly, new challenges emerge daily, and ambiguity is often present. The ideal candidate thrives in an AI-native culture, demonstrates strong initiative, embraces continuous learning, and can quickly evaluate information, make sound decisions, and drive execution without waiting for direction.

  Strategic Sales Partnership 
  Serve as a  trusted analytical partner and extension of SMB Sales leadership , providing an independent, data-informed point of view.
 Translate data into clear recommendations that influence sales strategy, prioritization, resource allocation and frontline execution.
 Support Sales leadership with planning, forecasting, pipeline reviews, performance management and strategic decision-making.
   Commercial and Action-Oriented Analytics 
  Identify where the business is winning, losing, accelerating, stalling or underperforming.
 Segment performance across markets, customer groups, industries, products, channels, sellers, partners, funnel stages and opportunities.
 Move beyond reporting  what happened  to determine  why it happened, what it means commercially and what Sales should do next .
 Identify emerging trends, risks, execution gaps and growth opportunities before they become visible through standard reporting.
 Develop and test hypotheses, challenge assumptions and proactively investigate areas of business opportunity or risk.
   Client and Stakeholder Management 
  Partner directly with Sales leaders, clients, operational teams and cross-functional stakeholders to clarify objectives and define the appropriate analytical approach.
 Manage client communication and expectations across competing priorities, changing requirements and evolving business needs.
 Communicate complex analytical findings simply and confidently to technical and non-technical audiences.
 Move comfortably between detailed analysis and high-level commercial discussions.
   AI-Native Analytics and Automation 
  Use advanced AI capabilities, to structure ambiguous business problems, analyze information, generate hypotheses and accelerate insight development.
 Use  AI coding tools  to support  SQL   development, automate repetitive analysis, build lightweight tools and improve data workflows.
 Apply AI-assisted methods to structured and unstructured information, including qualitative feedback, conversation outputs and operational notes, when appropriate.
 Identify opportunities to automate recurring reporting, data preparation and analytical workflows.
 Validate AI-generated outputs and maintain strong standards for analytical accuracy, confidentiality, data integrity and responsible AI use.
   Independent Work in an Ambiguous Environment 
  Operate  effectively in a fast-moving , startup-like environment where processes, systems, requirements and success measures may not be fully defined.
 Create structure from  incomplete information  and independently determine a practical path forward.
 Demonstrate curiosity and creativity by exploring data, asking strong questions and proposing new approaches to business problems.
 Prioritize quickly,  balance speed with analytical rigor  and adapt as business needs evolve.
 Take ownership from problem definition through analysis, recommendation, stakeholder alignment and follow-through.
   Expanded Data and BI Expectations 
  Work with structured and unstructured information from multiple sources and clearly communicate data limitations, assumptions and quality gaps.
 Develop dashboards and decision-support tools that allow Sales leaders to quickly understand performance and determine the required action.
 Apply appropriate statistical methods to evaluate segmentation, trends, variation and performance relationships.
 Move recurring reporting toward more diagnostic, predictive and action-oriented insights.
 Maintain the consistency, accuracy and reliability of reporting, business metrics and underlying data.
   Stronger Senior-Level Qualifications 
  Require   5 +  years of experience  in business intelligence, sales analytics, business analytics, revenue operations, sales strategy or a related analytical role.
   Demonstrate success turning data into commercial insights and practical business recommendations, rather than primarily producing reports.
 Bring practical knowledge of B2B or SMB sales motions, including pipeline management, acquisition, activation, conversion, adoption, retention and growth.
 Demonstrate experience partnering directly with Sales leaders or client stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
 Communicate executive-ready insights and influence senior stakeholders through clear, concise business narratives.
   Preferred Experience Added 
  Experience in software, SaaS, technology, partner-led sales or another complex B2B commercial environment.
 Hands-on experience using  AI platforms   in analytical work.
 Experience automating recurring analysis, prototyping lightweight analytical tools or improving data workflows.
 Experience combining quantitative data with qualitative or unstructured information to identify themes, sentiment or knowledge gaps.
 Experience establishing reporting, decision frameworks and operating rhythms in a build-and-run environment.
 Familiarity with revenue operations, sales plays, partner performance, adoption, activation and  campaign-effectiveness  analytics.
 
 The salary for this position is $92,000-100,000 Annually, plus bonus incentives that align with individual and company performance. Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies. Benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, comprehensive employee assistance program (EAP), 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off and holidays, and paid training days.

  WHY JOIN CONCENTRIX 

 At Concentrix, you'll help shape the future of AI-powered customer experiences while partnering with one of the world's leading AI-native organizations. You'll operate in a fast-moving environment where AI is embedded into daily workflows, decisions are made quickly, ownership is expected, and innovation is constant. This role offers the opportunity to directly influence customer success, partner performance, AI adoption, and business outcomes at scale.

 Finalists should expect to participate in a live, unscripted walkthrough of an actual deliverable, workflow, or solution they personally created using an LLM. This discussion will focus on the business problem addressed, implementation approach, prompt refinement, limitations encountered, lessons learned, and measurable business impact. Prepared demonstrations or hypothetical examples are not preferred.

summary: The Director, Pursuit Lead, Elevate owns transformational enterprise opportunities from strategic engagement through close and early customer success. The role leads deal strategy, commercial architecture, executive engagement, cross-functional pursuit orchestration, and alignment of transformation outcomes with the ServiceNow platform. It also develops new commercial models, codifies pursuit learnings, and mentors peers.
description:
Company Description
 It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
 Join us to put AI to work for people.
 Job Description
 Role Summary 
 The Pursuit Lead, Elevate owns transformational opportunities end-to-end—from first strategic engagement through close and into early customer success. You are the single point of accountability for deal progression, commercial architecture, and customer outcomes. Unlike traditional deal roles, you work shoulder-to-shoulder with an embedded Transformational Platform Consultant; you own the transformation strategy and commercial model while they own the technical transformation narrative and North Star architecture. Together, you present one unified voice, one coherent vision, and one executable path to operational transformation through the ServiceNow platform. 
 You operate upstream of traditional sales motions, identifying and developing transformational opportunities that cut across business units and require platform-level thinking, executive engagement, and cross-functional orchestration from our ecosystem and partners.
 Six Core Accountabilities 
 Own Deal Outcome & Business Impact 
 Drive the complete deal lifecycle as the business strategist and executive deal leader. Own the strategic hypothesis for transformation from initial customer vision all the way through to value driving deal shaping, commercial architecture, and handoff into post-sale. Ensure the deal structure, investment thesis, and success metrics align with the customer's bold transformation ambition, not just a software purchase. 
 Shape Transformational Hypotheses Using Platform Depth 
 Partner with the Transformational Platform Consultant to connect customer business imperatives to the ServiceNow platform as a unified operational backbone. Develop a North Star vision that shows how NOW enables measurable outcomes—faster decision cycles, reduced operational friction, AI-accelerated operations, or enterprise-wide visibility. Make the platform's operational impact tangible and urgent, not abstract. 
 Orchestrate Cross-Functional Pursuit Execution 
 Act as the single point of accountability for deal momentum. Mobilize Partners, Value teams, GTM, Enterprise Architecture, Hyperscalers, Finance, Legal, Revenue, etc into one unified pursuit with clear ownership. Remove blockers, escalate conflicts, redirect resources, and maintain tempo. Silo'd work isn't allowed—every function moves the deal forward together or not at all. 
 Build Commercial Models That Unlock Transformational Investment 
 Challenge assumptions about what transformational deals can look like. Invent new commercial structures (outcome agreements, platform commitments, co-investment models, pricing ramps) that align customer risk with platform value realization. Own the deal economics—not just revenue, but deal shape, investment strategy, and commercial terms that reflect transformation scope. 
 Create Executive Conviction Through Outcome Clarity 
 Craft C-suite narratives that connect business imperatives to platform capabilities to measurable operational outcomes. Move customers from curiosity → confidence → commitment by simplifying complexity and making the transformation case irrefutable. Work alongside the Transformational Platform Consultant to speak both business and technical languages with credibility. 
 Codify and Raise the Bar for Future Pursuits 
 Every deal teaches. Capture what worked—use-case patterns, commercial structures, stakeholder plays, objection patterns, sequencing. Mine deal stalls for pattern insights. Feed playbook learnings back into Elevate strategy teams. Mentor peers on pursuit mastery. Redefine how ServiceNow pursues transformational business with each win. 
 Lifecycle Ownership: S0–S5+ 
 Sense Intent & Shape Opportunity (S0–S1) 
   Identify transformation signals: Where is the customer facing structural business change (market shift, operating model redesign, AI adoption cliff, loss of strategic capability)? 

    Conduct deep strategic discovery with C-suite and board: Uncover business imperatives, organizational constraints, transformation timelines, and success metrics. 

    Partner with Portfolio Intelligence to form transformation readiness hypothesis and identify the right NOW capabilities. 

    Co-create the opening vision with the Transformational Platform Consultant: Position this as a transformational moment where NOW becomes the operational backbone, not a software conversation. 

    Sequence ecosystem partners (Product, Inspire, GTM, Enterprise Architecture) into a deliberate strategy before pursuit begins. 

  Co-Create & Architect (S2–S3) 
   Validate the North Star: Work with the Transformational Platform Consultant to stress-test the platform vision against customer architecture, integration needs, and operating model. 

    Build executive conviction: Craft C-level narratives showing how NOW solves their boldest imperative. Make the business case undeniable. 

    Design commercial architecture: Invent deal structures (outcome agreements, platform commitments, phased investment, shared risk) that reward transformation outcomes. 

    Orchestrate cross-functional alignment: Ensure Partners, Enterprise Architecture, Finance, Legal, and Revenue are aligned on pursuit strategy and customer commitments. 

    Maintain stakeholder momentum: Lock in customer commitment to sequencing, investment timeline, and success metrics. 

  Drive Commercial & Close (S4–S5) 
   Lead final negotiations: Finalize commercial terms, investment structure, and customer commitments. 

    Maintain executive engagement: Keep deal momentum through decision cycles by reinforcing strategic messaging and outcomes. 

    Coordinate internal execution: Align approvals, financing, Legal, and ecosystem delivery sequencing. 

    Ensure commercial integrity: Validate that deal terms, platform scope, and success metrics all ladder to the transformation thesis. 

  Secure & Embed Value (S5–S5+) 
   Own the handoff to Account Owner, Customer Success, and Delivery teams: Ensure transformation thesis, platform roadmap, commercial model, and success metrics are understood and locked in. 

    Monitor early value realization: Track customer's time-to-value, adoption, outcome realization. Identify and remove blockers. 

    Identify adjacent opportunities: Spot expansion use cases and renewal growth as customer scales transformation. 

    Capture and codify learnings: Document use-case patterns, commercial structures, stakeholder plays, deal stalls, and success factors. Share playbook insights with team. 

  Qualifications
 Required 
   10+ years of traditional enterprise sales, Software Sales and deal structuring 

     5+ years of Large Deal Pursuit type role with proven track record closing $50M+ TCV contracts with a focus on incremental revenue vs renewals  

    And/or 5+ years of experience with corporate strategy, business development, large, complex corporate transactions (M&A, IP acquisition, revenue-share models, strategic partnerships, or consulting engagements) 

    Demonstrated executive presence: Credible with C-suite stakeholders in strategic business conversations, not just sales pitches 

    Deep understanding of enterprise transformation: Know how operating models change, what drives customer urgency, and how to sequence multi-year transformation programs 

    Ability to influence without authority: Align partners, internal teams, and customer stakeholders around a shared deal strategy with no formal power over most parties 

    Comfort operating in ambiguity and building structure where none exists: Complex deals require inventing new playbooks 

    Single point of accountability mindset: Own deal outcome completely; solve problems rather than escalate blame 

  Preferred 
   Experience originating transformational opportunities proactively, not just advancing inherited deals 

    Familiarity with platform-based enterprise selling, cross-business-unit deal development, or ecosystem partnerships 

    Experience with Office of CEO, Strategic Initiatives, or similar portfolio management 

    Track record of building and mentoring teams, codifying playbooks, and raising capability standards across an organization 

  For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of  $193,000 - $319,000  plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.
 Additional Information
  Work Personas 
 We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location.   Learn more here  . To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.
  Equal Opportunity Employer 
 ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin or nationality, ancestry, age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements. 
  Accommodations 
 We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact  globaltalentss@servicenow.com   for assistance.

 For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals.
