title: Field Installation Technician
summary: ORBCOMM is seeking a Field Installation Technician to install, deploy, troubleshoot, and support telematics, in-cab, and related hardware solutions. The role includes customer and partner training, technical documentation, product rollout support, and collaboration with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success teams. It is remote within Texas, Arkansas, or Oklahoma and averages 80% travel.
description:
Join Us as a Field Installation Technician!  
   Are you a hands-on technical professional who enjoys working directly with customers and technology in the field? ORBCOMM is seeking a Field Installation Technician to support the deployment, installation, training, and ongoing success of our telematics and hardware solutions. In this role, you will play a critical part in delivering high-quality installations, supporting new product rollouts, and helping customers and partners maximize the value of ORBCOMM technology.  
  
 
   Why You’ll Love Working Here  
   As a member of ORBCOMM’s Field Services organization, you will work closely with customers, installation partners, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams to ensure successful deployments across a wide range of fleet and telematics solutions. Reporting to the Field Installation Team Lead, you will contribute to installation excellence, customer enablement, field support, and continuous improvement initiatives that directly impact customer satisfaction and product adoption.  
  
 
   This role can be held remotely in Texas, Arkansas, or Oklahoma. This position averages 80  %  travel.  
  
 
   What You’ll Do  
   Installation & Deployment  
    Perform field installations across ORBCOMM’s telematics, in-cab, and related hardware solutions.  
   Support pilot programs, large-scale deployments, and product rollouts.  
   Ensure installations are completed accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with project timelines and service expectations.  
   Maintain consistency across installations while adhering to established standards and best practices.  
    Training & Customer Enablement  
    Deliver hands-on training to customers, partners, and third-party installers.  
   Demonstrate installation procedures, product functionality, and troubleshooting techniques.  
   Help drive successful adoption of ORBCOMM solutions through effective knowledge transfer and support.  
    Technical Support & Troubleshooting  
    Provide on-site and remote technical support during and after installations.  
   Diagnose and resolve hardware, wiring, connectivity, and installation-related issues.  
   Escalate and collaborate with internal teams as needed to ensure timely resolution of customer issues.  
    Documentation & Process Improvement  
    Maintain accurate   installation   records, field reports, and supporting documentation.  
   Assist with the development, review, validation, and continuous improvement of installation guides and technical materials.  
   Identify opportunities to improve installation processes, tools, and documentation.  
    Cross-Functional Collaboration  
    Partner with Engineering and Product teams to support new hardware introductions and product enhancements.  
   Provide field feedback to help improve products, installation methods, and customer experience.  
   Communicate regularly with Field Services, Customer Success, Engineering, and other internal stakeholders.  
   
 
   Who You Are  
   You are a technically skilled and customer-focused professional who thrives in field environments and takes pride in delivering quality work. You combine strong troubleshooting abilities with excellent communication skills and enjoy helping customers, partners, and installers succeed.  
   If you have:  
    3–5+ years of experience in field installation, telematics, fleet technology, or   a related   technical field.  
   Hands-on experience with in-cab systems, telematics devices, fleet technology, or similar hardware solutions.  
   Strong mechanical aptitude and attention to detail.  
   Experience reading and interpreting technical installation documentation and wiring diagrams.  
   Ability to troubleshoot hardware, wiring, and connectivity issues.  
   Experience working in field environments, including vehicles, depots, and customer locations.  
   Strong verbal and written communication skills  .  
   Demonstrated ability to train, coach, and support customers, partners, or installers.  
   Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and Word.  
   Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.  
   Preferred: Experience using mobile installation applications or field service tools.  
   Preferred: Familiarity with creating training materials, instructional content, or installation documentation.  
   Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.  
   Commitment to quality, safety, accountability, and continuous improvement.  
   Leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to support daily tasks and productivity.  
   Commitment to continuous learning in digital and AI literacy.  
    Additionally:  
   Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull up to 50 lbs (23 kg) on a regular basis.
 Ability to work in and around trucks, trailers, refrigerated units, and heavy equipment.
 Ability to bend, kneel, crouch, crawl, reach, and climb while performing installations and troubleshooting.
 Ability to work in tight or confined spaces, including under dashboards, inside cabs, and around equipment compartments.
 Ability to use hand and power tools safely and effectively for extended periods.
 Ability to stand, walk, and perform physical work for prolonged periods throughout the workday.
 Ability to work indoors and outdoors in varying weather and environmental conditions.
 Ability to climb ladders and safely access installation locations at various heights when required.
 Ability to travel frequently and operate a motor vehicle with a valid driver's license.
   

   Then we want to   meet   you!  
 

  
 
   The Benefits of Working Here    
   A career with ORBCOMM offers a unique opportunity to grow your skills and expand your expertise in a collaborative, innovative environment. Beyond being part of an exceptional team, we provide a competitive, locally relevant benefits package designed to support our employees around the world. Benefits vary by location and include health and wellness coverage, paid time off, retirement or savings programs, flexible work arrangements, insurance coverage, lifestyle perks, and access to employee discounts—helping you thrive both professionally and personally.  
  
 
   How We Hire  
   ORBCOMM uses technology-enabled tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by people, as part of our human-led, tech-enabled culture.  
  
 
   About Us  
   At ORBCOMM, we’re pioneers in IoT technology that drives innovation and empowers our clients to make data-driven decisions. Our industry-leading solutions enable customers to boost productivity, streamline operations, and increase their bottom line. With over 30 years of experience and the most comprehensive solution portfolio in the industry, we enable the management of millions of assets worldwide across diverse sectors, including transportation, heavy industries, satellite, and maritime. Discover how ORBCOMM is transforming industries and unlocking the potential of data to drive meaningful change at       www.orbcomm.com      !   
  
 
   Ready to Join Us?  
   We believe that our people are our greatest asset. Your skills and passion can help us achieve remarkable things! If you’re seeking a thrilling career opportunity in a vibrant, growth-oriented environment, ORBCOMM is the perfect fit for you.   
  
 
   We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and appreciate all applicants for their interest in joining our team. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.    
  
 
   At ORBCOMM, we are also dedicated to ensuring accessibility and are pleased to offer accommodations for individuals with disabilities upon request throughout all aspects of the selection process.

title: Senior Content Strategist - Freelance
summary: The Freelance Senior Content Strategist will shape end-to-end content experience strategy for a major digital platform and connected product ecosystem in financial services. Responsibilities include auditing current experiences, identifying opportunities, defining a target vision and roadmap, and developing content frameworks and systems with senior client stakeholders and integrated teams.
description:
At AKQA (part of WPP) we believe in the imaginative application of art and science to create beautiful ideas, products and services. With an entrepreneurial and collaborative approach, we design adaptive digital services and applications that capture the imagination, delivering impressive returns for our clients.

Content strategists at AKQA are curious thinkers who want to investigate, understand, and organize to create a better future, with a specific focus on the content that powers our clients' experiences. To us, content is more than words on a screen; it is the story and information that drives our clients' brands and products forward.

In this role, the Freelance Senior Content Strategist will support end-to-end content experience strategy for a flagship digital platform and connected product ecosystem for one of the most recognized and trusted names in financial services, a brand with deep roots in helping people plan, protect, and secure their futures. Responsibilities span auditing current experiences, identifying gaps and opportunities, defining an ideal-state vision, and developing a pragmatic roadmap to get there. The Strategist will work closely with senior client stakeholders and an integrated AKQA team to formulate and deliver smart, tailored content frameworks, recommendations, and systems that serve our client's needs across digital products and platforms.

 
ROLE REQUIREMENTS
  • 8+ years of experience in content strategy for digital products, apps, and web platforms, with a portfolio that demonstrates structured thinking and measurable outcomes on complex, high-visibility consumer experiences
  • Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to define voice, tone, messaging hierarchies, and editorial guidelines across product and marketing surfaces
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze user, client, and business needs and develop relevant content strategies, frameworks, and taxonomies that measurably improve outcomes
  • Comfort consuming large quantities of research and data, including behavioral, consumer, industry, and academic sources, to inform perspectives, set KPIs, and partner on measurement
  • Experience driving content for high-traffic digital surfaces, including information architecture, navigation, personalization, SEO, accessibility, experimentation, and content operations
  • Proven success working cross-functionally with strategists, product managers, UX designers, copywriters, creatives, engineering, and analytics teams
  • Strong presentation skills, with the ability to craft persuasive narratives and present confidently to senior clients and internal leadership
  • Knowledge of contemporary practice across digital product development, including agile delivery, content governance, and operational frameworks
  • Ability to take responsibility for on-time deliverables and expertly crafted perspectives within an accelerated timeline


QUALITIES AND CHARACTERISTICS
  • Undaunted by the unknown; ambiguity sparks your curiosity and accelerates your learning
  • A love of hard problems and a drive to inspire new ways of thinking across teams and stakeholders
  • A passion for transforming large amounts of disorganized information into clarity through structure, rigor, and systems
  • Deep affinity for the end user, with empathy that translates into usable, valuable content experiences
  • Extreme attention to detail coupled with the ability to zoom out to a compelling strategic narrative
  • Phenomenal communication skills and the ability to partner with senior clients and executive stakeholders
  • 8+ years working across digital experience, brand experience, customer experience, or communications; an intersection of more than one is ideal; experience with financial services, membership and loyalty programs, or mobile app ecosystems is a plus
  • Self-directed and proactive; comfortable operating independently in a fast-paced, high-visibility environment

 

Location & Commitment

  • Remote (US Based)
  • Available during core business hours, U.S. Eastern Time
  • ASAP through December 23, 2026
  • 40 hours/week
  • Expected weekly compensation: 3,000 to 3,400 USD

We believe great work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach including required in-office days. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

AKQA is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

title: Community Web Manager
summary: The Community Web Manager leads publishing operations and content management across the ServiceNow Community platform. Responsibilities include managing website updates and deployments, configuring platform features, building product hub experiences, coordinating content migrations and launches, supporting stakeholders, and developing self-service publishing training and documentation.
description:
Company Description
 It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
 Join us to put AI to work for people.
 Job Description
  About the Team: 
 The ServiceNow Community Platform team manages one of ServiceNow's largest customer-facing digital experiences. The Community serves customers, developers, partners, user groups, product teams, and advocates through forums, product hubs, events, learning resources, and peer-to-peer engagement experiences. 
 We are looking for a Community Web Manager to lead publishing operations and content management across the ServiceNow Community platform. This role is responsible for ensuring content is accurate, timely, discoverable, and aligned with the needs of business stakeholders and customers. 
  What You Will Do: 
  Own Community Publishing Operations: 
   Execute and manage website updates across the ServiceNow Community platform. 

    Manage staging, quality assurance, and production deployment processes. 

    Design, build, and deploy landing pages using Khoros templates. 

    Manage page layouts, components, asset placement, and responsive design. 

    Manage external Community properties, like the ServiceNow Community YouTube channel, podcast publishing via Omny, and video publishing on Brightcove. 

   Manage Community Platform Configuration: 
   Configure site navigation, redirects, content placement, tagging, labels, permissions, and visibility settings. 

    Support role-based access controls and community governance requirements. 

    Partner with engineering and product to identify publishing workflow improvements, submit feature requests, and resolve publishing issues. 

    Collaborate with UX design and brand teams on page layouts, components, design implementation, and brand compliance. 

   Support Product Hubs and Community Experiences:  
   Build and maintain product hub experiences using established templates and content frameworks. 

    Coordinate content migrations, launches, and updates with business stakeholders. 

    Ensure content is organized and presented consistently across the platform. 

   Partner with Stakeholders:  
   Serve as the primary point of contact for Community publishing and content management requests. 

    Consult with product marketing, customer marketing, events, advocacy, and enablement teams on content strategy and site best practices. 

    Translate business requirements into scalable web experiences. 

    Manage multiple projects and competing priorities while maintaining service-level expectations.

   Enable Self-Service Publishing:  
   Train stakeholders on community tools, publishing processes, and governance standards. 

    Develop documentation, reference materials, and training resources. 

    Support content owners in maintaining their sections of the Community platform. 

  Qualifications
  Required Qualifications:  
   7+ years of experience in web publishing, web content management, digital operations, community management, or related field. 

    Experience working within a CMS, digital experience platform, or online community platform. 

    Strong understanding of content governance, publishing workflows, and quality assurance practices. 

    Experience managing multiple stakeholder requests and priorities. 

    Strong written and verbal communication skills. 

    Strong project management and organizational skills. 

   Preferred Qualifications: 
   Experience managing publishing workflows in community platforms (Khoros, Gainsight, Higher Logic, etc.)" 

    Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JSON-based content configuration, Adobe Experience Cloud (AEM, Adobe Target, etc), Adobe Photoshop, redirects, navigation management, and CMS administration. 

    Experience supporting enterprise-scale customer-facing digital properties. 

    Experience designing and delivering stakeholder training and enablement. 

    Experience utilizing AI tools to streamline publishing workflows, content optimization, or stakeholder enablement. 

   Key Competencies: 
   Web Publishing & Content Operations 

    Digital Experience Management 

    Stakeholder Management 

    Content Governance 

    Platform Administration 

    Quality Assurance 

    Training & Enablement 

    Project Coordination 

  Additional Information
  Work Personas 
 We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location.   Learn more here  . To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.
  Equal Opportunity Employer 
 ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity,  veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.  
  Accommodations 
 We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact  globaltalentss@servicenow.com   for assistance. 
  Export Control Regulations 
 For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

title: Senior Manager, Brand Marketing
summary: CertifyOS is seeking a Senior Manager of Brand Marketing to own the company’s brand presence, content strategy, owned media channels, events, employer brand, and corporate communications. The role combines brand development, editorial leadership, thought leadership, podcast and LinkedIn management, event programming, and cross-functional collaboration to build market visibility, audience engagement, and pipeline support.
description:
About CertifyOS 
 CertifyOS is building the data infrastructure that powers modern healthcare.
 Today, healthcare organizations rely on fragmented and outdated provider data. This creates unnecessary administrative work, regulatory risk, and higher costs across the system. We’re solving that problem.
 Our API-first platform automates provider licensing, enrollment, credentialing, and network monitoring by connecting directly to hundreds of primary data sources. We help healthcare organizations maintain accurate, compliant, and reliable provider networks at scale.
 Our vision is simple: One API. One provider ID. Frictionless provider data. 
 We’re backed by leading investors and built by a team with deep experience in provider data systems. At CertifyOS, we value authenticity, accountability, collaboration, results, and openness to feedback. We’re building a high-ownership team focused on solving real infrastructure problems that impact millions of patients.
  About the role: 
 We are seeking a Senior Manager of Brand Marketing to own Certify's brand presence, content output, and audience-building channels end-to-end. This is a high-impact, creative-meets- strategic role for someone who can simultaneously build a cohesive brand identity and operatethe full content engine that brings it to life — from thought leadership to LinkedIn, events,podcasts, employer brand, and corporate communications.
 You will help define how Certify shows up in the market — shaping perception among healthplan buyers, potential hires, and industry stakeholders. This role requires equal parts brandvision and content discipline. You will own the editorial calendar, manage all owned channels,and ensure every piece of content is consistent, compelling, and connected to businessobjectives.
  What you'll do: 
 1. Brand Development & Identity
   Steward Certify's brand identity — including voice, tone, visual language, and positioning ensuring consistency across all internal and external touchpoints.

  Maintain and help evolve the living brand guidelines system — covering written style, design standards, messaging hierarchies, and channel-specific adaptations.

  Lead periodic brand audits to evaluate consistency, resonance, and market perception, using findings to evolve the brand as Certify grows.

  Partner with Product Marketing and leadership to ensure brand positioning is tightly integrated with Certify's market strategy and competitive narrative.

  2. Content Strategy & Production
   Own the master content strategy and editorial calendar, ensuring all content reinforces CertifyOS’ brand narrative, category POV, campaign priorities, and audience insights across channels.

  Develop distinctive thought leadership that translates market trends, customer pain points, regulatory pressure, and product strategy into compelling content for health plan executives and provider operations leaders.

  Lead the creation of high-quality content across articles, blogs, LinkedIn, newsletters, video scripts, webinars, event presentations, white papers, contributed industry pieces, and sales enablement assets.

  Build a repeatable content production engine using AI tools, internal SMEs, customer insights, and external partners to scale output without sacrificing quality, originality, or editorial rigor.

  Partner with Marketing, BD, Product, Customer Success, and the executive team to ensure content directly supports pipeline creation, customer education, product launches, events, and market authority.

  3. Owned Channels: Podcast, LinkedIn & Newsletter
   Own and operate Certify's podcast — from guest strategy and topic selection to production workflow, episode publishing, and audience growth.

  Drive Certify's LinkedIn presence as a brand-building channel — developing a content cadence, growing follower engagement, and managing both company page and executive ghostwriting programs.

  Build and grow Certify's owned newsletter — developing the editorial voice, subscriber growth strategy, and content rhythm that turns subscribers into advocates.

  Track channel-level performance metrics and use data to continuously optimize content type, frequency, and distribution strategy.

  4. Events & Sponsorships
   Own Certify's events strategy — identifying, evaluating, and executing on industry conferences, roundtables, webinars, and proprietary events that build brand visibility and pipeline.

  Manage event logistics end-to-end: booth presence, speaker submissions, session content, on-site materials, and post-event follow-up campaigns.

  Build Certify's own event programming — from customer advisory board meetings to hosted industry roundtables — that positions Certify as a convener in the PDM space.

  5. Employer Brand & Internal Communications
   Develop and execute Certify's employer brand strategy — defining what it means to work at Certify and translating that into recruiting content, Glassdoor presence, careers page, and social storytelling.

  Partner with People & Talent to build a talent marketing program that attracts mission- driven candidates who align with Certify's culture and values.

  Own corporate communications — drafting executive announcements, company updates, investor communications, and press releases in Certify's voice.

  Build internal brand engagement programs that reinforce culture and ensure employees are proud ambassadors of the Certify brand externally.

   What Success Looks Like 
   Brand Consistency: A documented brand guidelines system live within 60 days; 100% of external content passing brand review within 90 days.

  Content Velocity: Weekly content output across LinkedIn, blog, and newsletter sustained at scale; editorial calendar planned 4+ weeks ahead.

  Podcast Growth: Podcast launched within 90 days; 10+ episodes published within 6 months with measurable audience growth quarter over quarter.

  Channel Performance: LinkedIn follower growth ≥20% quarter over quarter; newsletter open rates above industry benchmark; event ROI tracked and reported.

  Employer Brand: Certify employer brand presence established on LinkedIn and Glassdoor within 60 days; measurable improvement in qualified inbound applications.

   What you'll need: 
 Must-Have Experience
   6–10+ years in brand marketing, content strategy, or editorial leadership — with a track record of building or transforming a brand at a healthcare or technology company.

  Demonstrated experience owning content operations at scale — building editorial systems, managing production workflows, and maintaining quality across high-volume output.

  Hands-on experience managing owned media channels: LinkedIn company presence, newsletters, podcasts, or video programs.

  Strong writing and editorial skills — able to produce excellent content yourself and set the standard for others.

  Proven ability to translate business goals into brand narratives and content strategies that resonate with B2B buyers and talent audiences alike.

   Preferred Experience 
   Background in healthtech, health plan operations, or B2B enterprise SaaS with complex buyer audiences.

  Experience with AI-driven content workflows — using tools like LLMs, automation platforms, or content intelligence software to scale output efficiently.

  Experience managing or contributing to executive thought leadership programs and ghostwriting programs.

  Familiarity with demand generation and ABM — understanding how brand content feeds pipeline and measuring brand's contribution to revenue.


   Our Research & Culture Principles 
   Ground Truth First: No insight without validation. You talk to customers, prospects, and the market — you don’t just read reports.

  Insight to Action: Research without a recommended action is incomplete. You close the loop between intelligence and business impact.

  Low Ego, High Standards: Nothing is beneath you — you dive into the data, own the details, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes.

  Prioritize Relentlessly: The market generates infinite signals. You know which ones matter and focus your energy accordingly.

  Deliver A+ Work: “Good enough” is not our bar. The quality of your research reflects on Certify’s credibility with customers, investors, and partners.

   Benefits of Working at Certify 
   At Certify, we’re building with intention and taking care of the people doing the work.

  Your well-being matters to us. We provide 100% coverage of health, dental, and vision insurance premiums for employees. Our US-based team benefits from unlimited PTO, with at least two weeks off each year to recharge. In India, employees are supported with health insurance, statutory leave benefits, and additional wellness (menstrual) leave for women.

  We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to do their best work, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences.
 If you require reasonable accommodations during the application process, please contact recruiting@certifyos.com.
 We are also committed to pay transparency and foster an open culture where compensation conversations are encouraged and respected.

title: Enrollment Advisor
summary: The Enrollment Advisor guides prospective students through university and program selection, application, admissions, and registration processes. The role communicates with students across phone, email, and text, manages leads in a CRM, tracks student progress, meets daily sales and application metrics, and supports informed enrollment decisions.
description:
Company Description
  Make a world of difference. 
 Want to make a difference in the world?  Become a Keypather. 
 From guiding the student experience, to delivering programs that meet the needs of the future-of-work and help solve our global social and economic challenges, every one of our people (Keypathers!) create impact, every day.
  Roles at Keypath Education are available as remote, hybrid, or in-office. 
 Job Description
 The Enrollment Advisor role will be responsible for facilitating prospective students through the application process for their University of choice. The Advisor will uncover the needs and objectives of a prospective student through a set of interviews and help the student determine if the program or University is a fit for the student. The Advisor will also support the student through the admissions and registration process to ensure the student meets all requirements and deadlines.
  ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 
  Communication with prospective students through phone calls, emails, or text messages regarding the University and program​
 Follow the departmental and management guidelines for lead management and moving leads through the different statuses in the CRM system​.
 Responsible for supporting students using a consultative process to ensure the student has all the information to make an informed decision about the University and program from lead to start​.
 Use the database to track student progress and any communication with students​.
 Achieve daily metrics surrounding number of calls per day, speed to lead metrics, talk time per day, number of applications per day as set by their Manager​.
 Provide feedback when needed on lead quality, quantity, and applicable trends.
  Qualifications
  Education:  Bachelor’s degree required
  Experience: 
  Demonstrated critical thinking, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.
 2-3 years of sales experience (in an outbound call center preferred)
 General knowledge of higher education and/or College admissions and recruitment experience preferred.
 Technically proficient.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills
 Goal-oriented and demonstrated ability to meet sales targets.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to successfully work with all levels of management.
 Supervisory management skills and the ability to oversee delegated tasks. 
 Proven ability to effectively provide training and explain processes and procedures.
 Knowledge of planning processes and issues.
   Technical   S  kills :
  Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. 
 Experience with CRM system(s) preferred.
   Special Requirements Specific to Job :
  Self-motivated
 Proactive
 Able to multitask
 Excellent written and oral communication skills
 Strong attention to detail
 Customer service skills
 Team player
 An understanding of the Higher Education and Post-Secondary Education sector, including working for a Higher Education Institution, is preferred
   WORK ENVIRONMENT 
 It is essential to determine a suitable workspace in your home before starting your remote work.  Below is a checklist to help you set up shop:
  Flat surface to set your computer on (desk, kitchen table, counter, etc.)
 Unobstructed Wi-Fi signal (ability to hardwire if needed is also important)
 Internet with at least 25 Mbps download and 3 Mbps upload speed  (Unsure of your speed? Check here: https://www.speedtest.net/ )  
 
 Power outlet to plug in your laptop and any other equipment
 Quiet space with limited noise interruptions
 Good lighting for a professional appearance when video conferencing.
  Additional Information
 At Keypath, our salary structure and compensation philosophy reflect the value we place on our employees. We pride ourselves on offering a competitive and fair total rewards package that considers the market.
 The salary range for this position is between $65,000-$72,000. The starting salary will fall within this range and will be determined by various factors such as experience, location, market conditions, and departmental budgets. You will have the opportunity to discuss your salary expectations during the interview process.
  Embrace the flexibility of remote, hybrid, and flexible work options.

 As part of our commitment to supporting our employees, Keypath provides a quarterly $75 Remote Work Stipend to help cover internet and remote work-related technology expenses. 
 Invest in your future with our tuition reimbursement and professional development programs. 
 Secure your retirement with our 401(k) retirement contributions and company matching. 
 Enjoy our paid leave policies designed to ensure you have the time to rest and recharge. 
 Company-supported life and AD&D insurance, along with short-term and long-term disability coverage. 
 Inclusive parental leave programs are designed to support you and your family. 
   Want to make a difference?  Become a Keypather. 
 Apply today
  A little bit about us  
 Keypath Education is a leading edtech company that partners with leading Universities to create innovative and in-demand online education programs and champion the student journey from enrolment to graduation. We are a fast-moving team that values community, collaboration, innovation, and lifelong learning. 
 Certified as a  Great Place to Work , our corporate office is in Schaumburg, Illinois. We gather teams of experts from digital marketing, course development, web development, finance, and student service backgrounds to support university partners in the US.

Sure, anyone can tell you how good their company culture is, but we encourage you to read our reviews and form your own opinion. We’ve got a caring and engaged CEO who replies to Glassdoor reviews personally and recognizes that the only way we can achieve our vision is through an inclusive culture that celebrates diversity, works in harmony, and cares for our community.

title: Clinical Quality Specialist
summary: The Clinical Quality Specialist supports Vynca’s Enhanced Care Management program through internal chart audits, clinical documentation review, and oversight of care management quality. The role analyzes audit findings and partners with operations, clinical leadership, compliance, and training teams to improve workflows, documentation, education, and audit readiness.
description:
Join the dynamic journey at Vynca, where we're passionate about transforming care for individuals with complex needs.

We’re more than just a team; we're a close-knit community. Our shared commitment to caring for each other and those we serve is what sets us apart. Guided by our unwavering core values: Excellence, Compassion, Curiosity, and Integrity, we forge paths of success together. Join us in this transformative movement where you can contribute to making a profound difference every day.

At Vynca, our mission is to provide comprehensive care for more quality days at home.
  About the Job 
The Clinical Quality Specialist for the Enhanced Care Management (ECM) program is a newly created role supporting all aspects of ECM quality. This position conducts internal chart audits across Vynca’s contracted health plans, provides clinical oversight of care management documentation, and translates audit findings into operational and educational improvement in partnership with ECM Operations and the Training and Development team. The role requires active clinical licensure and combines independent chart review with cross-functional collaboration, and flexes into training delivery as program needs require. This is a highly visible position that directly supports audit readiness for health plan and regulatory review while advancing internal standards beyond what any single plan measures.
  At this time we are only considering applicants in the following states: California, Arizona, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Nevada, North Carolina, Oregon, Texas, Utah and Washington. 
 

  What you'll do 
  Internal Auditing and Monitoring 
   Conduct internal chart audits of Lead Care Managers across contracted health plans, applying each plan’s own audit criteria alongside Vynca internal quality standards.

  Maintain audit cadence in accordance with the ECM Internal Audit Cadence Stanard Operation Procedure, including elevated cadence for new hires and staff on performance improvement plans.

  Select audit samples according to defined chart composition requirements, including discharge and enrollment mix and minimum enrollment tenure.

  Document findings objectively with supporting evidence locations so internal audit records can be used to respond to health plan documentation requests.

  Analyze results at the criterion, category, Lead Care Manager, and health plan level to identify trends, areas of opportunity, and emerging risk.

  Participate in inter-rater calibration exercises to confirm scoring consistency across auditors.

  Support audit readiness for health plan and regulatory audits, including self-audit submissions and corrective action plan (CAP) responses.

  Maintain the master audit record and reporting surfaces used for monthly and quarterly quality review.

   Secondary Clinical Review and Clinical Oversight 
   Provide secondary clinical review of comprehensive assessments, care management plans, and transitional care documentation for clinical appropriateness, completeness, and defensibility, in addition to the oversight provided by Clinical Managers.

  Provide clinical oversight as needed, including coverage and escalation support where Clinical Manager oversight is unavailable or additional clinical review is warranted.

  Serve as a clinical resource to Lead Care Managers on complex member scenarios, escalation pathways, and documentation of clinical decision-making.

  Support interdisciplinary and multidisciplinary care team activity, including documentation of clinical oversight requirements.

  Review clinical content within training materials, assessments, and job aids for accuracy and alignment with scope of practice.

  Escalate identified clinical risk, member safety concerns, or quality-of-care issues through appropriate channels.

   Cross-Functional Collaboration 
   Partner with ECM Operations leadership to translate audit findings into workflow change, documentation standards, and targeted remediation.

  Collaborate with Clinical and Program Managers on performance improvement plans, including audit-based evidence, progress monitoring, and tier and titration decisions.

  Partner with Training and Development Specialists to convert identified gaps into curriculum updates, education huddle content, and remediation training.

  Support the Compliance department on ECM audit readiness, regulatory monitoring, and quality assurance and performance improvement (QAPI) activities.

  Communicate results, trends, and at-risk staff to Clinical and Program Managers and to Directors.

   Training and Education Support 
   Flex into training delivery as program needs require, including onboarding, ongoing education, and post-remediation reinforcement for Lead Care Managers.

  Develop and deliver audit-related education, including criteria walkthroughs, documentation standards, and findings review sessions.

  Contribute to the design and maintenance of knowledge checks, test-out assessments, and competency validation tools.

  Support preceptor and shadowing activities as a clinical subject matter resource.

   General Duties 
   Maintain organized, audit-ready documentation of all internal quality activities.

  Monitor CalAIM policy changes, Department of Health Care Services (DHCS) guidance, and health plan criteria updates, and assess their impact on audit tools and documentation standards.

  Support the build and maintenance of plan-specific audit tools as health plan contracts are added or criteria change.

  Support ad-hoc quality initiatives, policy development, and special projects as assigned.

   Your experience and qualifications 
   Bachelor’s degree required. Master’s in Nursing, Social Work, Public Health, or Health Care Administration preferred.

  Active, unrestricted California clinical licensure required (RN, LCSW, LMFT, LPCC, or equivalent), or the ability to obtain California licensure within the first six months of employment.

  5+ years of experience in care management, case management, or direct clinical practice.

  1+ years of experience in quality auditing, chart review, utilization review, or quality assurance and performance improvement (QAPI) activities.

  Previous experience with documentation integrity, including review of clinical documentation for accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and defensibility under audit.

  Willing and able to work Monday through Friday 8:30am to 5pm Pacific Time.

  Experience working with Medi-Cal populations, ECM, or CalAIM programs is highly desirable.

  Working knowledge of clinical documentation standards, care plan development, and transitional care requirements.

  Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify patterns across data and translate findings into actionable recommendations.

  Exceptional written communication skills, particularly for documenting audit findings objectively and defensibly.

  Ability to deliver difficult feedback constructively while maintaining professional credibility with clinical staff.

  Proficiency with Google Suite, electronic health records, and virtual collaboration platforms (e.g., Zoom, Microsoft Teams).

  Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines within a dynamic setting.

  Cultural competence and the ability to interact effectively with diverse populations.

   Preferred Qualifications 
   Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish.

  Familiarity with the CalAIM initiative, Enhanced Care Management, and community-based care models.

  Experience conducting or responding to health plan delegation audits, including corrective action plans.

  Certification in healthcare quality (CPHQ) or healthcare compliance (CHC).

  Experience with training delivery, curriculum development, or adult learning principles.

  Experience with trauma-informed care, motivational interviewing, or other relevant therapeutic approaches.

  Advanced spreadsheet skills, including formula-driven tracking and reporting tools.

   Additional Information 
   The hiring process for this role may consist of applying, followed by a phone screen, online assessment(s), interview(s), an offer, and background/reference checks.

  Background Screening: A background check, which may include a drug test or other health screenings depending on the role, will be required prior to employment.

  Job Description Scope: This job description is not exhaustive and may include additional activities, duties, and responsibilities not listed herein.

  Vaccination Requirement: Employees in patient, client, or customer-facing roles must be vaccinated against influenza. Requests for religious or medical accommodations will be considered but may not always be approved.

  Employment Eligibility: Compliance with federal law requires identity and work eligibility verification using E-Verify upon hire.

  Equal Opportunity Employer: At Vynca Inc., we embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace. We value all applicants regardless of race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, citizenship status, or membership in any other protected group under federal, state, or local law.

  Environmental Conditions and Physical Requirements: Works with Vynca patients/clients remotely and/or in-person. Successfully performs the essential duties and responsibilities of the position through the use of physical activities as described below:
   Regularly requires sitting, standing, walking, talking, use of hands, listening, and observing.

  Regularly requires working at a computer for an entire shift (with appropriate breaks).

  Regularly requires use of laptop and video-conferencing technology.

  Occasionally requires reaching, stooping, bending, kneeling, and lifting items weighing 25 pounds or less.

  Occasional travel may be required to perform job duties, attend training, or company events.

title: Senior Revenue Enablement Manager
summary: The Senior Revenue Enablement Manager designs, launches, and improves scalable learning and enablement programs to boost sales productivity, product adoption, and customer retention. The role measures program impact, develops enablement content and frameworks, and partners across Revenue, Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and other teams to drive adoption and organizational effectiveness.
description:
About Payscale  
 Payscale is the pioneer of compensation intelligence, helping organizations make smarter pay decisions that drive business performance. For more than 20 years, Payscale has combined trusted market data with AI-powered technology to deliver actionable insights that turn pay from a cost into a catalyst for growth. The Payscale Intelligence Cloud portfolio of solutions — Ascent, JobNav, and Paycycle — empower top companies and businesses like Cintas, Leidos, Chipotle, Ohio State University, and TJX Companies.
 Create confidence in your compensation. Payscale.
 To learn more, visit   www.payscale.com  .
  Job Summary 
 We are seeking an experienced Revenue Enablement Manager to design, implement, and optimize scalable learning programs that drive revenue impact and organizational effectiveness. This role sits at the intersection of execution and strategy—you will own enablement initiatives end-to-end while beginning to shape broader enablement frameworks and business strategy. Reporting to Director, Solutions Consulting & Enablement, you will partner with Revenue organization, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success to diagnose performance gaps, deliver targeted solutions, and measure impact.
  What You'll Do 
 Enablement Strategy & Program Design
   Design and launch scalable enablement programs and learning initiatives that directly impact sales productivity, product adoption, and customer retention

  Develop specialized expertise in learning methodologies and engagement techniques; apply these to assess organizational performance gaps and recommend targeted solutions

  Design and contribute to onboarding programs for new Revenue team members, including curriculum development, content creation, facilitation, practice activities, and ongoing reinforcement

  Establish or refine enablement frameworks that align with quarterly business goals and annual company strategy

  Conduct formal training needs assessments using surveys, data analysis, and stakeholder interviews to identify root causes of performance shortfalls

  Create comprehensive enablement roadmaps with clear timelines, success metrics, and resource requirements

  Revenue & Business Impact
   Measure and communicate the revenue impact of enablement programs; link training initiatives directly to key sales outcomes (pipeline, win rates, quota attainment)

  Analyze enablement effectiveness through data; design and implement KPIs to track adoption, completion, and performance outcomes

  Proactively review company goals and revenue metrics to identify enablement gaps and improvement opportunities

  Collaborate with leadership to define enablement priorities and ROI; recommend program adjustments based on business results

  Connect enablement efforts to competitive positioning and market dynamics

  Cross-Functional Leadership & Execution
   Lead cross-functional teams to develop content, run workshops, and deliver training at scale

  Navigate competing enablement priorities between Sales, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success; build influence to resolve adoption friction

  Manage stakeholder expectations and feedback loops; synthesize input from end-users and partners to continuously improve programs

  Partner with L&D, HR, and People teams on organizational change management for major enablement launches

  Coordinate with Product and Marketing on go-to-market enablement for new features and product launches

  Change Management & Adoption
   Design and execute change management strategies for major enablement initiatives

  Measure adoption and engagement; identify and address barriers to adoption through dialogue and data-driven problem-solving

  Coach team members and stakeholders on program changes; deliver constructive feedback on enablement effectiveness

  Demonstrate strong organizational change management capabilities to drive adoption and organizational alignment

  Content & Technical Excellence
   Create and oversee development of enablement content across formats: e-learning, presentations, guides, video, and knowledge management systems

  Use advanced analytics and reporting to assess training impact and identify trends

  Integrate and optimize the enablement technology stack (LMS, CRM, knowledge bases), leveraging automation and AI-powered solutions to increase personalization and efficiency

  Maintain documentation standards and processes that scale as the enablement function grows

  We'd love to talk with you if you have:
   5-7 years of experience in enablement, training, learning & development, revenue operations, or related field

  Demonstrated expertise in designing and launching training programs that have improved sales or business outcomes

  Strong analytical skills; comfort with data reporting, performance metrics, and using insights to drive decisions

  Excellent collaboration and influence skills; ability to navigate cross-functional environments and competing priorities

  Proficiency with enablement tools (LMS, CRM, knowledge management platforms) and data analytics; experience with Gong, Claude, Seismic a plus

  Experience conducting needs assessments and diagnosing root causes of performance gaps

  Ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously while maintaining quality and attention to detail

  Strong presentation and facilitation skills, with demonstrated experience delivering engaging training, workshops, and practice-based sessions to both small and large audiences

  Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to present

   Nice to Have 
   Experience with change management frameworks and stakeholder engagement strategies

  Background in sales, product, or customer-facing functions (to deepen product/market understanding)

  Familiarity with Revenue tools such as Salesforce, ZoomInfo, Outreach, Nooks, and related best practices to drive tool adoption and performance

  Track record of implementing new tools, platforms, or processes

  Knowledge of sales methodologies, buyer journeys, or go-to-market strategy

  Project management certification or experience leading large-scale organizational initiatives

   Location 
 Payscale has an employee centric remote-first model that provides you the flexibility to do your best work in a space that supports you, while also finding time to collaborate in person for the moments that matter.

In our remote-first model, employees can work from the location that works best for them. We do not have centralized corporate offices. Employees can choose to work from home, in company-paid co-working spaces, or any combination of the two that best suits their unique needs.
 If you work from home, we recommend ensuring that you can meet the following technology, equipment and workspace requirements:
   High-Speed Internet - A stable broadband or fiber connection (satellite is highly discouraged) with a minimum speed of 100 Mbps in a dedicated workspace that has a reliable Wi-Fi signal.

  Device for Multifactor Authentication (MFA/2FA) - smartphone, tablet, etc.

  When it matters (usually no more than a few times a year) we take the time to gather for in-person events.
 Payscale has employees across the US, Canada, UK, The Philippines and Romania however we are currently unable to hire in the Quebec Province, Northern Ireland, and Hawaii.
  Benefits and Perks 
 All around awesome culture where together we strive to live our 5 values:
   Data informed decision making.

  Customer first. Always.

  Succeed together.

  Relentless about results. Obsessed with excellence.

  Lead the change. Shape the standard.

  An open and inclusive environment where you’ll learn and grow through programs and resources like:
   Monthly company All Hands meetings

  Regular opportunities for executive leadership exposure through things like AMAs

  Access to continued learning & development opportunities

  Our commitment to a continuous feedback culture which allows us to drive performance and career growth

  A growing network of Employee Resource Groups

  Company sponsored volunteer hours

  And more!

   Our more standard benefits 
   Flexible paid time off, giving you the opportunity to rest, relax and recharge away from work

  14 Paid Company Holidays, includes 2 floating holidays (you choose!)

  A comprehensive benefits plan including medical, dental, life, vision, disability, and life insurance covered up to 100% by Payscale

  Health Savings Account (HSA) options and company contributions each pay period

  Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options for pre-tax employee allocations

  Annual remote work stipend to be used on wellness or home office equipment

   Equal Opportunity Employer: 
 We embrace equal employment opportunity. Payscale is committed to a policy of equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. It is our policy that employees will not be subjected to unlawful discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, or ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, marital status, sexual orientation, political ideology, and any other basis protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including but not limited to: recruitment, hiring, transfers, promotions, training, discipline, termination, compensation and benefits, performance appraisals, education, and social and recreational programs.
 We know the    confidence gap    and    imposter syndrome    can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.
 If you have a disability or impairment and need assistance with the application process, please email    recruiting@payscale.com    for support.

During your job application and interview process, we will never ask for your personal banking or financial information, social security number, or other sensitive information, if you are unsure if a message is from Payscale, please email    recruiting@payscale.com

title: Founding Clinical Coordinator, Radiography
summary: The Founding Clinical Coordinator will build and oversee the clinical education component of Stepful’s Radiologic Technology program, including curriculum alignment, clinical-site qualification, student placement, supervision, safety, and preceptor development. The role also supports accreditation and assessment, may teach clinical courses, advises students, and requires travel to partner sites in Texas while working remotely.
description:
About Stepful :
 Stepful is a workforce platform redefining how America's largest health systems build, train, and retain their talent. Since our founding in 2021, Stepful’s trained over 32,000 practice-ready healthcare workers.
 
Layering onto our successful direct-to-consumer training, Stepful partners with leading healthcare institutions to address the growing national shortage of healthcare workers. We’re improving access to quality healthcare for everyone, everywhere, and improving access to healthcare career ladders for those who need them most.
 
Our students form the talent pipelines for major employers such as NY-Presbyterian, Mt. Sinai, HCA, Providence, CVS, and Walgreens. We have partnerships with half of the top 10 health systems in the US and are in process with many more.
 
Stepful is backed by Y Combinator, Reach Capital, and AlleyCorp, with   a recent $55M Series C led by Oak HC/FT  .   We were named the #1 EdTech company in the U.S. by TIME for 2025  .
  Our values :
 We credit much of our success to our exceptional team. We’re looking for mission-driven builders who thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, and embody our four core values:
    Care first : We do whatever it takes for our students to succeed.

   Learn quickly : We test, learn with data, and iterate.

   Build together : We win when we rely on each other.

   Own it : We show up, take initiative, and show pride.

   The opportunity: 
 Stepful is launching a Radiologic Technology A.A.S. program leading to ARRT (R) certification eligibility. We're partnering directly with employers to help them build their own RadTech programs, powered by Stepful: they sponsor the education of new talent, and we bring the accreditation, curriculum, instruction, and operations. Labs and clinicals happen inside their facilities, so students train where they'll eventually work, and employers build their own talent pipelines exactly where they need them.
 You'll be the Clinical Coordinator of record for the program: you'll build the clinical education component from the ground up, decide which partner facilities are ready to take students, and make sure what happens at the bedside actually connects to what students learned in the classroom. Success in this role is measured through the program's clinical outcomes data and the term-by-term evaluation of how well clinical rotations correlate with classroom learning. You'll work alongside the Program Director, who owns overall program operations and accreditation, and you'll be supported by dedicated operations and partnerships teams.
 This role is remote with travel to partner sites in Texas required, and reports to our Imagine Programs Lead. Per accreditation requirements, the Clinical Coordinator is a distinct role from the Program Director and is not identified as a clinical preceptor at any clinical setting.
  What you'll do: 
  Clinical curriculum and site network 
   Correlate clinical and didactic education: own the alignment between what students learn in didactic and lab courses and what they're asked to do in clinical rotations, sequence clinical objectives against the curriculum, and formally evaluate how well that correlation is working each term

  Build and qualify the clinical site network: conduct and document a pre-placement evaluation of every prospective partner facility to confirm a viable learning environment and sufficient procedure volume; secure accreditor recognition of each clinical setting before any student is assigned; maintain current, signed clinical affiliation agreements; and designate at least one clinical preceptor at each recognized setting

   Placement, supervision, and safety 
   Run clinical placement and scheduling: determine student clinical placement (placement is decided solely by the program), assure equitable access to mobile, surgical, and trauma procedures, hold the 1:1 student-to-clinical-staff ratio, cap clinical involvement at ten hours per day, and orient every student to every site

  Enforce supervision and radiation safety in the clinical setting: assure direct supervision until competency is achieved and for all repeats, surgical procedures, and mobile procedures; assure indirect supervision thereafter; distribute student radiation exposure reports within thirty school days; and complete MRI safety screening before clinical experience

   Preceptor and student development 
   Develop and support clinical preceptors: onboard preceptors at each site, train them on the clinical objectives and competency evaluation system, keep them current on program policies and student progress, and serve as their day-to-day point of contact

  Track clinical competency and advise students: monitor competency progression and completed clinical hours, provide timely and documented clinical advisement, and build remediation plans for students who fall behind

   Accreditation, teaching, and travel 
   Support accreditation and assessment: contribute clinical evidence to the self-study report, annual reports, substantive change filings, and site visit preparation for accreditors; participate in the program's systematic assessment plan and the annual analysis of clinical outcomes data

  Teach: participate in didactic and/or clinical instruction, with the opportunity to teach clinical courses for the first cohort

  Maintain professional currency: keep current knowledge of radiography practice and educational methodologies through documented continuing professional development, and stay current on program policies, procedures, and student progress

  Travel to partner sites for site readiness evaluations, preceptor development, clinical visits, student advisement, and accreditation visits, weighted toward new site launches — likely up to once monthly in 2026, scaling to up to 50% travel starting 2027; all travel and program-related expenses reimbursed

   What you'll bring: 
   Reliable access to a major airport and availability to travel to Texas

  Bachelor's degree or higher from an institution accredited by an agency recognized by the U.S. Secretary of Education or CHEA

  Current ARRT R.T.(R) certification

  Current Texas GMRT certificate from the Texas Board of Medical Radiologic Technology

  Minimum two years' clinical experience in radiography

  Minimum one year's experience as an instructor in a JRCERT-accredited program

  Proficient in curriculum development, supervision, instruction, evaluation, and academic advising

  Working knowledge of the JRCERT Standards for an Accredited Educational Program in Radiography and of ABHES clinical experience requirements (or willingness to learn)

   Bonus points if: 
   Prior clinical coordinator or clinical instructor experience in a JRCERT-accredited radiography program

  Experience managing clinical education across multiple sites or health systems

   Interview Process: 
   Introductory call with Talent Acquisition

  Interview with Hiring Manager

  Take-Home Assignment

  Final Panel Interviews

   Benefits and Compensation: 
   Meaningful Equity Stake

  Subsidized Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance plan options

  401(k)

  FSA, HSA and commuter benefits

  Learning stipend

  Open vacation policy, including:

    Guidance of 15 days PTO annually

  Stepful closed the last week of December

  15 work-from-anywhere days

  10 public holidays observed for 2026

  The target base salary range for this opportunity is  $80,000 - $90,000 , and is part of a competitive total rewards package including equity and benefits. Individual pay may vary from the target range and is determined by a number of factors including experience, internal pay equity and other relevant business considerations.
  Stepful is proud to be an equal opportunity employer . We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

title: Localization Strategist (fixed-term)
summary: The Localization Strategist provides consultation, coaching, customization, and implementation support to schools and districts using Amplify’s educational products and instructional materials. The role develops scalable resources, collaborates cross-functionally to inform product iteration, mentors peers, and supports effective adoption of Amplify’s platform, with travel of up to 50–70% despite the remote designation.
description:
About Amplify 
 Amplify helps teachers bring delight and rigor to students every day. We have become a leader in K–12 literacy, biliteracy, math, and science by building inspiring teaching and learning experiences based on research. The Amplify Classroom platform combines curriculum, assessment, and supplemental learning into one coherent high-quality instructional system. A pioneer in education since 2000, Amplify has developed deep relationships in states and districts by partnering with educators to drive implementation quality and improved outcomes. Today, Amplify serves more than 18 million students and teachers across all 50 states and on six continents. For more information, visit  Amplify.com .
   Job Description:  
 The Localization Strategist plays a critical role in Amplify’s evolving customer experience model, providing consultation and services that lead to deep product adoption and impact, including program customization/contextualization; the development of additional assets and reports; and direct-to-leader and teacher knowledge and skills development. This role is part of a pioneering group of talented team members who will set the stage for Amplify's long-term customer engagement model. Individuals in this role will be creative, entrepreneurial, and reflective– identifying and codifying successful practices in real time.
 This role will be strategically embedded directly within schools and districts, engaging throughout the school year and during summer planning, helping educators and leaders reflect on their practices and supporting their effective use of Amplify's platform and instructional materials. You will serve as a consultant, coach, and content developer: partnering with curiosity, developing people, customizing content, and continuously reflecting.
 The Localization Strategist partners closely with educators, instructional leaders, and internal teams to bridge the gap between product design and classroom practice. This role is highly collaborative and works across Customer Experience, Product, Sales, and Design to both support customers and inform product design, ensuring our Amplify products best meet customer needs.
   Essential Responsibilities : 
  1. Consultation, Coaching, and Customization 
   Provide high-impact, on-site and virtual consultation and support, ensuring successful initial implementation, continuous adoption refinement, and ongoing program customization across schools and districts.

  Serve as a deep product and platform expert, delivering high-impact, embedded instructional coaching and modeling of effective use of digital tools to educators and administrators on how to effectively use, customize, and integrate Amplify tools into their instructional practice.

  Partner directly with instructional and school leaders to identify implementation needs, troubleshoot challenges, and develop tailored supports that drive strong outcomes.

  Deploy into customer environments during critical moments (e.g., back-to-school, mid-year implementation) to provide high-impact, hands-on support.

  Maintain strong ownership and follow-through across all customer engagements, proactively tracking commitments and leveraging systems to communicate progress and prioritize support across multiple schools and priorities.

  Exercise strong professional judgment to navigate complex customer contexts, consistently modeling effective usage, balancing hands-on support with capacity-building, and serving as a trusted Amplify ambassador.

   2. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Product Iteration 
   Collaborate cross-functionally with Customer Success, Sales, Product, and Design teams to align on customer needs, proactively sharing key learning, customer insights, and documented feature requests/bugs to inform product iteration and continuous improvement.

  Test and iterate on program implementation in real time, gathering feedback from educators and translating it into actionable insights for internal teams, specifically elevating learning from pilot programs to inform future strategy and product development.

  Contribute to continuous improvement of implementation strategies, helping define best practices and scalable approaches for customer support.

   3. Developing Scalable Resources & General Support 
   Design and develop customized resources (e.g., tailored guides, checklists, instructional videos) and communication materials that align to Amplify programs’ pedagogical approach and support effective implementation in bespoke, high-touch ways.

  Identify and codify the highest-leverage workflow transformations within the Localization team's day-to-day work by building a deep understanding of internal processes, workflows, and outputs

  Mentor and coach peer team members on best practices for high-impact consultation, technical solutions development, and effective cross-functional collaboration, helping to build the team's collective expertise and capacity.

  Develop custom tools, agents, automations, and skills that streamline and enhance operational effectiveness

  Recognize and document successful intervention patterns across your cohort to systematically scale best practices and ensure tools built for one specialist are reusable for their peers

  Support the development of asynchronous and other teacher support development efforts

  Perform other duties as assigned

    Minimum Qualifications:  
   Bachelor’s degree

  8+ years of related professional experience, including K–12 education, educational technology, or curriculum implementation

  3+ years of experience working directly with schools or districts in a coaching, training, or implementation support capacity

  Demonstrated expertise in instructional practices and/or curriculum implementation (Math or Literacy preferred)

  Familiarity with the Amplify platform and experience in curriculum development, having the ability to create and modify content

  Strong ability to lead professional learning and coach educators on instructional tools and platforms

  Experience troubleshooting and supporting technology-enabled instructional products

  Curiosity about and willingness to leverage AI tools in overall tooling and development

  Proven capacity for execution, prioritization, and maintaining strong organization and follow-up across multiple schools, stakeholders, and priorities.

  Ability to travel up to 50–70% of the time, including extended on-site district engagements with customers

  Excellent communication, facilitation, and relationship-building skills with both educators and district leaders

  Ability to work independently in dynamic environments while maintaining strong cross-functional collaboration

    Preferred Qualifications:  
   Experience working with Amplify programs

  Background in instructional coaching, district leadership, or change management

  Experience supporting district implementations or system-wide rollouts

  Ability to analyze implementation data and translate insights into actionable recommendations

  Experience creating educator-facing resources, training materials, and/or implementation guides

   Amplify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Amplify makes employment decisions based on qualifications and merit, and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic or status. 
  Amplify is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities, including disabled veterans. If you have a disability and need an accommodation in connection with the application or hiring process, please email   hiringaccommodations@amplify.com   . 
  If you are selected for employment, a background check will be required. As required by state and local laws and district policies, you may be required to provide additional documentation, such as proof of vaccination, or submit to enhanced background screening, such as fingerprinting. 
  Amplify is an E-Verify participant.

title: Product Marketing Lead
summary: The Product Marketing Lead owns go-to-market strategy for WRITER’s core app products and features, including positioning, messaging, launches, and competitive differentiation. The role translates enterprise AI capabilities into buyer-facing narratives and sales assets, drives feature adoption, and collaborates across product, sales, and marketing teams.
description:
🚀 About WRITER 
 WRITER is where the world's leading enterprises orchestrate AI-powered work. Our vision is to expand human capacity through superintelligence. And we're proving it's possible – through powerful, trustworthy AI that unites IT and business teams together to unlock enterprise-wide transformation. With WRITER's end-to-end platform, hundreds of companies like Mars, Marriott, Uber, and Vanguard are building and deploying AI agents that are grounded in their company's data and fueled by WRITER's enterprise-grade LLMs. Valued at $1.9B and backed by industry-leading investors including Premji Invest, Radical Ventures, and ICONIQ Growth, WRITER is rapidly cementing its position as the leader in enterprise generative AI.
 Founded in 2020 with office hubs in San Francisco, New York City, Seattle, Austin, Chicago, and London, our team thinks big and moves fast, and we're looking for smart, hardworking builders and scalers to join us on our journey to create a better future of work with AI.
  📐 About the role 
 Writer is the enterprise AI platform for agentic work, purpose-built for the Fortune 500 — and our platform is expanding fast. As a product marketing lead, you'll own the go-to-market strategy for new products and features in our Core app, helping prospects understand how WRITER empowers marketing and sales teams to transform their work, and driving new feature adoption among current customers. You'll sit at the intersection of product, sales, and marketing — translating complex platform capabilities into crisp messaging that resonates with enterprise buyers.
  🦸🏻‍♀️ What you’ll do 
   Own end-to-end product marketing for WRITER Agent and other key features of our core app, including positioning, messaging, launch strategy, and competitive differentiation – translating new agentic capabilities into clear enterprise value

  Partner with product, demand generation, content, comms, and customer marketing teams to drive go-to-market for product and feature launches

  Translate product investments into sales-ready narratives, partner with sales enablement to educate the field, and develop assets — pitch materials, one-pagers, objection-handling guides — that equip the field to sell our latest innovations

  Drive product and feature adoption through regular user communications and programs

  Conduct ongoing competitive intelligence and market research to sharpen differentiation against both point solutions and broader AI platforms
