title: Lead Instructional Designer
summary: Neon One is hiring a Lead Instructional Designer to lead instructional design strategy and customer education for its nonprofit software products. The role owns the transition to a custom LMS, builds technical curricula and interactive learning experiences, aligns learning content with product releases, and measures learner outcomes and business impact.
description:
About Neon One 
 At Neon One, we believe that technology is the key to building vibrant communities of generosity. As a leader in nonprofit software since 2004, we create intuitive solutions that help small and mid-sized nonprofits connect with people, build trust, and make good happen every day.

Our culture is powered by empathy, innovation, and a shared mission to empower organizations making a difference. We operate with a customer-first mindset, take pride in extraordinary results, and grow together by supporting each other and embracing bold new ideas. If you’re passionate about using your skills to drive real impact and want to thrive in a collaborative, fully remote environment, Neon One is the place for you.

  About the Role 
 We are seeking a strategic, highly collaborative, and technically proficient Lead Instructional Designer to drive our instructional design strategy. In this pivotal individual contributor role, you will be a technical visionary and the primary engine for moving complex learning initiatives forward. You will partner closely with the Technical Writing function to ensure seamless alignment between our product documentation and learning pathways. Additionally, you will serve as the primary stakeholder in our transition to a newly built, custom Learning Management System (LMS). By partnering directly with external developers, product managers, and subject matter experts, you will define the instructional UX, authoring requirements, and system capabilities needed to deliver a world-class customer education experience.
  Responsibilities 
    Cross-Functional Project Leadership:  Act as the central driver for learning initiatives. Build strong partnerships across departments, proactively manage stakeholder expectations, and keep complex projects moving forward on schedule without relying on direct reporting lines.

   LMS Migration & Strategic Ownership:  Act as the primary business owner for offboarding our current academy (Skilljar) and transitioning to a custom-built LMS. Define system requirements (e.g., authoring workflows, learner UX) and guide external developers to ensure the platform meets both customer needs and instructional design standards.

   Team Collaboration & Workflow Design:   Work closely with the Technical Writer, Enablement Manager, and Customer Operations Managers to establish scalable design systems, style guides, and AI-assisted content workflows that make our learning content accessible to our customer base.

   Technical Curriculum & Certification:   Architect end-to-end learning pathways, role-based certifications, and self-paced academies for admin users and enterprise clients.

   Hands-On Lab & Interactive Design:  Design scenario-based, interactive learning experiences, including simulated environments, sandbox exercises, and API/code walkthrough tutorials.

   Product Alignment & Release Management:   Partner closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and Solutions Architects to translate complex feature updates and technical specs into timely, accurate learning content.

   Telemetry & Business Impact:  Track learner telemetry (e.g., product adoption rates, time-to-value, course completion, certification pass rates) to continuously measure and prove ROI on customer and internal enablement.

   Qualifications & Skills 
    Experience:  5+ years in instructional design within a B2B SaaS, developer tooling, or high-growth tech environment. Proven project management experience with a track record of driving cross-functional initiatives as a highly autonomous individual contributor.

   Custom LMS / Systems Expertise:  Hands-on experience defining requirements for LMS implementations, migrations, or custom builds. Deep understanding of what an instructional designer needs from a platform to successfully host and track courses (SCORM, xAPI, LTI).

   Technical Aptitude:  Comfort navigating API documentation, cloud architectures, developer workflows, or SaaS platform configurations to build technical curriculum independently.

   Tooling & Tech Stack: 
   Advanced proficiency in modern authoring & media tools (Articulate 360, Camtasia, Loom, Figma).

  Strong familiarity with transitioning out of standard Customer Education / LXP platforms (e.g., Skilljar) into custom environments.

 
   Core Competencies:  Agile development methodologies, rapid prototyping (SAM), data-driven decision-making, and exceptional cross-functional stakeholder management. Must possess the consultative skills necessary to influence peers, align differing viewpoints, and maintain project momentum.

   Why Join Neon One? 
 At Neon One, our values are how we show up every day. We make good happen by putting empathy and passion at the center of our work, using technology to uplift mission-driven organizations. We stand for our customers, act with care and intention in every decision, own the solution, and grow together. We innovate fearlessly, always exploring new ways to support our community and each other.
  How We Hire 
 We use AI tools to support our recruitment process, including helping us organize applications and identify early matches based on role criteria. That said, every rejection decision is made by a human. We encourage candidates to apply authentically and avoid relying solely on AI-generated responses, especially during interviews.

This posting is for a current, open position within  Neon One .

This opportunity is offered through HighlightTA, the on-demand talent team supporting Neon One’s growth.

  Connect with us and learn more:
   Neon One on LinkedIn  
   HighlightTA on LinkedIn

title: Sales Operations Manager, Implementation
summary: Motive is seeking an operations manager to improve customer implementation and service operations through process optimization, performance analysis, and cross-functional strategic projects. The role also supports sales leadership with Salesforce reporting, forecasting, territory alignment, and operational guidance, while using data and AI-driven tools to improve efficiency.
description:
Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Role:

At Motive, our Operations team ensures the entire organization runs smoothly, scalably, and strategically. We are seeking a Business Operations Manager to join our team and focus on the Service organization, which includes the Implementation, Installation, and Customer Education business units. This role is crucial for overseeing all internal processes and systems to ensure a smooth and efficient customer experience and to drive overall business objectives and growth.

You will act as the central nervous system for the Services organization, optimizing workflows and managing operational processes across these critical teams. Your ability to think strategically, adapt quickly, and manage resources effectively will be essential for success. This role will bring a data-driven perspective to operational process management, resource allocation, and performance monitoring.

You will collaborate closely with various teams, including Sales, Support, and Product. Your mandate is to ensure the new customer experience is smooth, builds trust, and is as efficient as possible for our customers and our business.


What You'll Do:

  • Pinpoint drivers of services performance and lead initiatives to improve the new customer experience and team efficiency
  • Partner with cross functional teams to scope and execute strategic projects to reduce workflow friction and inefficiencies for the Services organization
  • Manage weekly and monthly business processes, escalating deviations from goals and expectations
  • Be the connective tissue between Services and the rest of the business
  • Ad-hoc reporting requests through Salesforce and other platforms
  • Become a trusted advisor for sales leadership, offering an operational lens on how to tackle business problems at scale

What We're Looking For:

  • 3+ years of Field Sales/Revenue Operations experience, at a high-growth SaaS company in the Mid-Market or Enterprise segments
  • Exceptional spreadsheet and data management skills to quickly structure analyses, answer key business questions, and drive decision making
  • Experience in building Salesforce reports and dashboards, knowledge in how SFDC applications integrate with each other, and ability to enable sales on SFDC best practices and related tools
  • Experience partnering with Sales Leadership on initiatives such as weekly forecasting, territory alignment, ROE, QBRs and other related projects 
  • Experience identifying and leveraging AI-driven tools and solutions to enhance sales operations efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Demonstrated ability to be a self-starter - you will take the initiative to own projects and can operate well with little guidance
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize workload and manage multiple concurrent projects in a rapidly changing, hyper-growth environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

title: Senior Manager, Customer Advocacy & Community Marketing
summary: Sprout Social is hiring a Senior Manager, Customer Advocacy & Community to lead customer advocacy and community programs within its Customer Marketing team. The role oversees a team, develops scalable customer engagement and review programs, leads adoption of AI tools, and partners cross-functionally to surface customer success stories and drive business impact.
description:
Sprout Social is looking to hire a Senior Manager, Customer Advocacy & Community to the Customer Marketing team.

Why join Sprout’s Marketing team?

At Sprout Social, we don’t just market products—we set the pace for how breakthrough brands connect with the world. As the social intelligence platform powering the future of customer connection, our Marketing team is the driving force behind turning that vision into reality. We lead with clarity and act with speed to drive market leadership, generate demand, and accelerate customer expansion, all in close partnership with core cross-functional stakeholders.

Here, you’ll have the freedom to test bold ideas, learn fast, and shape the future of the global brands we empower. We measure success by the business results we create and a shared commitment to excellence in our craft. If you’re ready to own your impact, accelerate your career, and build the definitive system for business, this is where you belong.

What you’ll do

  • Team Leadership:  Oversee a best-in-class team that develops and implements engaging user community and customer advocacy programs that build trust, drive product usage and deepen our relationships with customers at scale.
  • Champion our Customers: Inspire and engage prospects, current users and our teams across Sprout, by creating scalable and integrated advocacy, community and customer reviews programs that surface customer successes at scale, apply relevant narrative context, and promote these internally and externally as the solid foundation to our customers’ success.
  • Lead with AI: Research, experiment, and implement new technology and approaches from the rapidly evolving AI toolset not only to accelerate the work of the Customer Marketing team, but to transform the way the team works and what we deliver to the business.
  • Collaborate for Success: Partner closely with Customer Success, Social, Brand and Field Marketing, Product Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing, Customer Education, Revenue, Product Operations and Performance Marketing to align strategies and scale impact.
  • Enthusiastically Solve Ambiguous Challenges: Use expertise and influence to guide major cross-functional efforts to change how we surface customer stories internally and show up for our customers through collaboration, clean data, system integrations, automation, scalable program design and impeccable project management.

What you’ll bring

We’re looking for an experienced team leader and enthusiastic people manager, with strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the desire to get things done. You are passionate about the value of customer voices and possess an extensive understanding of building and executing customer advocacy and community management strategies to drive sharing success stories at scale.
You are highly curious, with a strong desire to understand the whys behind the whats, and thrive on building strategic cross-functional programs that grow with a rapidly changing business environment. You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, aligning stakeholders and making an impact through thoughtful collaboration and seamless execution.


The minimum qualifications for this role include:

  • 8+ years of experience in Customer Marketing, Advocacy or Community management, with 5+ years of experience in a fast-paced SaaS or B2B tech environment
  • 2+ years of experience in direct people management with remote teams
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into applicable customer marketing strategies that then are executed as effective advocacy and/or community engagement programs

Preferred qualifications for this role include:

  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to guide team in crafting compelling narratives that showcase the value of Sprout products
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced environments with competing priorities; ability to prioritize high-impact work and drive alignment across teams
  • High attention to detail and cross-functional and collaborative project management experience
  • Proven ability to develop and maintain a magnetic team culture that not only inspires and engages direct reports but also compels others across the business to want to work with you/them
  • User-level experience working with third party review sites (such as G2 or TrustRadius), community platforms (like Gainsight or Zendesk community products), and advocacy collection/management tools (such as UserEvidence and Base.ai)

How you’ll grow

Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including:

  • Completing onboarding and meeting key cross-functional partners across Marketing, Customer Success and Operations teams
  • Getting oriented to Sprout’s customer advocacy and community programs and supporting tools
  • Building a deep understanding of our customers, personas and products.
  • Understanding priorities of your role and begin identifying opportunities for team and program improvement

Within 3 months, you’ll start hitting your stride by:

  • Taking ownership of key team and cross-functional rituals 
  • Expanding your understanding of the product roadmap and in-flight programs to manage prioritization of work for the Customer Advocacy & Community team
  • Partnering with cross-functional team partners to understand shared processes and audiences 
  • Launching your first customer-facing program

Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through:

  • Driving and delivering 2027 priorities and roadmap, as well as yearly team performance reviews
  • Using your deep understanding of our customers’ success stories to identify strategic areas of opportunity to improve community and advocacy programs and processes
  • Actively tracking engagement and business impact metrics 
  • Serve as the point person across Sprout for Customer Advocacy & Community programs and processes 

Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by:

  • Influencing how Sprout approaches Customer Advocacy & Community holistically—from data and systems to program execution and reporting
  • Offering a roadmap to further evolve our ability to support elevating our customers’ success stories at scale 
  • Surprise us! Use your unique ideas and abilities to change your team in beneficial ways that we haven’t even considered yet

Note: The outlined timeline above represents an ideal scenario. Flexibility may be required based on business needs and additional projects as determined by your manager.

Our Benefits Program

We’re proud to regularly be recognized for our team, product and culture. Our benefits program includes:

  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Premium BCBSIL medical, dental (high/low plans), and vision (Eyemed) insurance for you and your eligible dependents.
  • Premium Mental Health Support: Full, free access to Modern Health for you and your dependents, including coaching, therapy sessions, and digital wellness resources.
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with a 50% company match on your first 6% of contributions (a 3% total match).
  • Financial Security: 100% employer-paid Life and Disability insurance for your peace of mind.
  • Flexible Paid Time Off: A flexible PTO policy, supplemented with additional company-wide Rest & Recharge days throughout the year.
  • Paid Parental Leave: Up to 16 weeks of paid leave for new parents to support you in expanding your family.
  • Annual Lifestyle Stipend: A $1,000 USD annual Lifestyle Spending Account to spend on your physical, mental, and financial well-being.
  • Work From Home Support: A one-time $550 USD stipend to set up your home office, plus a monthly $50 USD stipend for internet.
  • Giving Back: 16 hours of paid volunteer time annually, plus a $100 annual match for your charitable donations.
  • Additional Financial Perks: Access to pre-tax commuter benefits, subsidized child/eldercare (Care.com), discounted pet insurance (Figo), and no-cost personalized financial wellness support through Your Money Line.
  • Office Environment: Beautiful, convenient, and state-of-the-art office in Chicago’s Loop.


*This list is for informational purposes only. Benefit offerings are discretionary and subject to change and do not constitute a contract or guarantee of benefits.

Our current hiring range for this role: $146,000 – $182,500 annually. Offers are made within this range, with opportunities to grow within the broader band based on performance and impact.

title: Customer Success Engineer
summary: The Customer Success Engineer helps self-serve and Corporate customers become capable, independent users of Roboflow’s computer vision platform. Responsibilities include delivering live and one-to-one technical enablement, creating reusable educational content and programs, identifying recurring customer friction, and partnering with Product and other teams to improve customer adoption and self-service.
description:
Who We Are
 Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.
 We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety, digitizing floor plans, preserving coral reef populations, guiding drone flight, and much more.
 Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.
 Roboflowers are passionate builders who value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action. We're curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer showing our work over talking about it. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment.
 Who You Are
 You are technically curious, customer-focused, and get satisfaction from helping people become capable and confident users of complex technology. You may come from Customer Success, technical enablement, Developer Relations, Support, Solutions Engineering, or another customer-facing technical role.
 You enjoy understanding why customers struggle with a product and turning those insights into better ways of teaching thousands of customers — not simply solving the same problem repeatedly.
 You are comfortable teaching technical concepts live, creating clear educational content, and guiding customers through unfamiliar workflows. You know when to demonstrate, when to advise, and importantly when to let the customer drive the keyboard.
 You look for patterns. If several customers ask the same question, your instinct is not simply to answer it again; it is to create the guide, video, workshop, workflow, or program that means the next customer can answer it themselves.
 Empathetic to customer needs and the importance of communicating in remote relationships, you can provide clear and prescriptive guidance while maintaining the boundaries required for a scalable self-service customer experience.
 Many Roboflowers have used our tools before joining. One of the best ways to stand out amongst other applicants is to write about something you have built with Roboflow or contribute to one of our open source projects.
 We are hiring Customer Success Engineers to help our self-serve and Corporate customers become successful, independent users of Roboflow. You will have direct input on the evolution of this role, the Customer Success Engineering function, and how Roboflow enables an increasingly large community of computer vision practitioners.
 If you enjoy teaching technical concepts, building programs and content, and finding scalable ways to help customers succeed, let’s have a chat.
 What You’ll Do
 Roboflow's product-led growth customers are building an enormous variety of computer vision applications. Customer Success powers up those customers with the technical knowledge, best practices, and structured enablement they need to expand how they use Roboflow and confidently progress from experimentation into production.
 The function operates through two complementary enablement models:
    Scalable enablement  — recurring webinars, onboarding sessions, technical workshops, clinics, office hours, learning journeys, and reusable educational content designed to help large numbers of self-serve customers progress independently.

   Targeted 1:1 enablement  — structured, time-bound delivery of the Targeted Enablement Option Pack for qualifying Corporate customers who need additional guidance through core Roboflow functionality.

  The objective isn't to do the customer's work for them; it is to remove educational friction and give customers the knowledge, tools, and confidence to progress independently.
 You will teach customers how to work effectively with datasets, annotations, model training and evaluation, and the wider Roboflow platform. Just as importantly, you will identify recurring points of friction and turn them into programs and reusable assets that can benefit hundreds or thousands of future customers.
 Role And Responsibilities
   Develop, deliver, and continually improve technical enablement programs for Roboflow's self-serve customer base, covering platform onboarding, annotation strategy and quality, dataset management, model training and evaluation, workflows and deployments and workspace administration

  Host bi-weekly webinars, technical workshops, office hours, and other live educational sessions

  Develop learning journeys that guide customers towards increasingly sophisticated use of Roboflow technology

  Deliver Roboflow's structured 1:1 Targeted Enablement Option Pack for qualifying customers

  Create reusable technical enablement assets including documentation, videos, walkthroughs, recordings, and reference materials

  Identify recurring customer questions and turn them into scalable educational programs or assets

  Monitor customer activation and engagement signals to identify users and cohorts who may benefit from specific enablement programs

  Measure participation and effectiveness of enablement programs for continual improvement

  Collaborate with Product to identify and close recurring knowledge and usability gaps

  Stay current with the latest Roboflow product features, releases, workflows, and recommended best practices

   Technical Proficiency 
   Working knowledge of computer vision and machine learning, including datasets, annotation, model training, evaluation, and inference

  Comfortable using Python and working with APIs, notebooks, and common developer tooling

  Ability to become highly proficient across the Roboflow platform and demonstrate its workflows confidently to customers

  Understanding of model evaluation concepts including precision, recall, confidence thresholds, confusion matrices, and common causes of poor model performance

  Understanding of dataset quality, annotation strategy, dataset versioning, and approaches for identifying difficult or underrepresented examples

  Ability to translate technical concepts into clear, practical guidance for users with varying levels of ML experience

   Individual Skills 
   Technical Teaching: Able to explain unfamiliar technical concepts clearly and adapt the explanation to the customer's level of experience

  Pattern Recognition: Recognize recurring questions and friction across customer interactions and identify opportunities to solve them systematically

  Program Delivery: Methodical planning and delivery of structured 1:1 sessions, webinars, workshops, and other customer-facing technical programs

  Content Creation: Able to create concise, technically accurate educational material across written, recorded, and live formats

  Workload Management: Manage multiple customers progressing through structured enablement while balancing program delivery and reusable content creation

  Customer Communication: Communicate clearly and professionally before, during, and after enablement engagements, setting expectations around preparation, outcomes, and next steps

   Bonus Skills 
   Experience using the Roboflow platform or contributing to the Roboflow ecosystem

  Previous experience in Customer Success, technical enablement, Developer Relations, technical education, Solutions Engineering, or technical Support

  Experience creating technical educational content such as tutorials, videos, workshops, documentation, or developer courses

  Experience delivering webinars, workshops, technical demonstrations, or customer training

  Experience working with product-led growth or self-service SaaS customers

  Experience using product telemetry or customer activation data to inform customer engagement programs

  Who You'll Be Working With
 Our team of over 100 attracts talent like executives that wanted to return to building, founders with a 100M+ exit, Roboflow users turned team members, open source contributors, a cyclist who biked across the United States, prolific high school hackers, a CTO from 100+ engineering organization, amongst many exceptional others.
 As an early Customer Success Engineer hire, you'll work closely with Support & Success leadership and partner with Product, Sales, and Field Engineering. You won't simply inherit an established playbook — you'll help build the programs, content, tooling, and working practices that define Customer Success at Roboflow.
 Where You'll Work
 Roboflow is distributed across the US and Europe. We currently have Hubs in New York City, San Francisco and São Paulo (with plans to open more as we grow density in new cities). We provide opportunities (like team onsites in different cities) and resources (like a $4000/yr travel stipend) to work in person with other team members as much as you'd like, while also supporting remote team members. You can work from one of our Hubs (we offer a relocation bonus), work from home, work at co-working spaces, etc. We want you to work where you work best!
 When You'll Work
 Roboflow primarily operates during the daytime hours in the US and there are some synchronous meetings you’ll be expected to attend each week.
 What You'll Receive
 To determine your salary, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources. We review all salaries every six months to ensure we stay in line with the market.
 📈 In addition to our cash compensation, we offer generous perks and benefits. Below are some of the highlights:
   $4000/yr Travel Stipend to travel anywhere anytime to work alongside other Roboflowers

  $350/mo Productivity stipend to spend on things that make your work environment more productive, like high-speed internet at home or a co-working space

  Cover up to 100% of your health insurance costs for you and your partner or family

  Equity in the company so we are all invested in the future of computer vision

  📅 Within one week, you will…
   Learn about computer vision, our product, company, customers, and vision

  Complete the core self-serve Roboflow journey from dataset creation through model training and inference

  Begin shadowing customer enablement and Support interactions to understand common customer friction

  📅 Within one month, you will…
   Onboard in person with your manager (you'll come to our NY or SF Hub!)

  Become familiar with the Customer Success Engineer function, Targeted Enablement Option Pack, and its scope boundaries

  Shadow and begin participating in Targeted Enablement sessions

  Compose your first Targeted Enablement Program

  Create or significantly improve your first reusable customer enablement artifact

  Participate in 1:many enablement webinars

  📅 Within six months, you will…
   Independently own and deliver both recurring 1:many enablement programs and 1:1 Targeted Enablement engagements.

  Own and improve reusable educational content and enablement programs

  Identify recurring customer friction and turn those insights into improvements across Product, Support, and CSE

  Demonstrate measurable contribution to customer adoption and scalable reduction of repetitive enablement demand

  Not sure if this is you?
 We want a diverse, global team with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, look into our Former Founders role. We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.
 Learn More About Us
 We are building a diverse Distributed team that is distributed across the globe. Roboflow is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds, communities, and experiences.
 We provide competitive compensation and stellar benefits to accelerate your personal and work life. Learn more about what it is like to work at Roboflow by reading these blog posts.
 See our careers page for all open listings.

title: Support Analyst

 Comfort working alongside AI-assisted support platforms, including chatbots and automated ticketing suggestions

 Experience contributing to or maintaining an AI-assisted knowledge base
 Familiarity with AI integrations within CRM or helpdesk platforms (e.g., Salesforce Einstein, Zendesk AI)

 BS/BA degree in a related business or technical field, or equivalent industry experience

 Experience with ticketing and work-management platforms such as TeamSupport or Jira
 Working knowledge of SQL, databases, APIs, or reporting tools
 Experience creating knowledge-base articles, technical documentation, or customer training content

 Harris Computer is an  EEO/AA/Disability/Vets  Employer.

title: Salesforce Manager, AI & Agentforce Delivery
summary: The Salesforce Manager, AI & Agentforce Delivery leads a technical delivery team while contributing directly to client projects involving Agentforce and AI-powered solutions. Responsibilities include solution design, mentoring and performance management, staffing input, quality standards, hiring support, and enablement across client engagements.
description:
Why NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture:

At NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, we are redefining the future of business through the power of AI and groundbreaking technologies like Agentforce. As a trusted leader in AI, AWS, and Salesforce innovation, we craft intelligent solutions—integrating Salesforce Einstein, Service Cloud Voice, Amazon Connect, Agentforce and more—to revolutionize workflows, elevate customer experiences, and deliver tangible results. From conversational AI to predictive analytics, we empower organizations to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital landscape with cutting-edge, tailored strategies.

We are proud to be creating the future of generative AI and AI agents. Salesforce has launched Agentforce, and NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, was selected as the only partner for the private beta prior to launch. Post-launch, we’ve earned the distinction of being Salesforce’s #1 partner for Agentforce, reinforcing our role as pioneers in this transformative space.

Be part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture journey and help shape the next wave of AI-powered transformation. Here, you’ll collaborate with trailblazing experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and leveraging technologies like Agentforce to create impactful customer outcomes. Whether you're developing advanced AI-powered bots, streamlining business operations, or building solutions using the latest generative AI technologies, your work will drive innovation at scale. If you’re ready to make your mark in the AI space, NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture is the place for you.

As a Manager, AI & Agentforce Delivery, you will lead a team of delivery professionals who design and build Agentforce and AI-powered solutions for our clients. You'll balance hands-on project delivery with people leadership: staying close to client work as an individual contributor while managing, mentoring, and growing the teammates who report to you.

You will have the opportunity to:

  • Deliver hands-on client project work as an individual contributor, staying current with Agentforce and Salesforce delivery practices
  • Lead and own complete project technical solution design, including designing and understanding agentic topics, instructions, actions with corresponding automation/code, agent deployment methods, and supporting data structures
  • Explore the limits and push the boundaries of automated agents, finding novel solutions to drive business outcomes
  • Manage a team of Experience Architects, Technical Architects, Consultants, Developers, and/or similar technical delivery roles
  • Provide mentorship, career guidance, and regular performance feedback, including corrective action when necessary
  • Own forecasting and staffing input for your team, in partnership with delivery and operations leadership
  • Coordinate and lead solution design reviews to maintain quality and consistency across client engagements
  • Author content for, and help facilitate, enablement workshops and office hours
  • Participate in and help lead skill-based guilds that foster knowledge sharing
  • Support hiring by conducting interviews and helping update interview materials
  • Champion NeuraFlash delivery standards and best practices across your team and accounts
  • Travel up to 25% for customer projects and company events

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience delivering technology solutions, including experience with Agentforce or other generative AI-driven platforms
  • 2+ years of experience managing or mentoring delivery team members such as architects, developers, and consultants
  • Demonstrated ability to balance billable client delivery work with team leadership responsibilities
  • Experience giving performance feedback, holding career development conversations, and managing corrective action processes
  • Experience participating in hiring for technical roles, including conducting interviews
  • Strong communication skills, comfortable moving between technical delivery conversations and people-management conversations

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience designing or facilitating enablement content (workshops, office hours, guilds)
  • Certifications relevant to architect-level roles
  • Experience forecasting and managing staffing/resourcing for a technical team
  • Prior experience specifically delivering Agentforce projects
  • Familiarity with multiple foundational LLMs, prompt engineering frameworks, and AI orchestration tools
  • Understanding of enterprise AI integrations, RAG architecture, and fine-tuning strategies

What can you expect in the interview process?

  • Recruiter screen (phone) - 30 minutes
  • Peer interview (Video) - 45 minutes
  • Panel interview with real-time exercise (Video) - 60 minutes, covering both a hands-on architecture exercise and management scenario discussion
  • Leadership interview (Video) - 45 minutes

title: Senior Manager, Product Enablement
summary: The Senior Manager, Product Enablement will build and manage recurring enablement programs for Vultr’s Cloud Compute and Cloud GPU products. Responsibilities include translating technical capabilities into sales training and collateral, partnering with Product and Engineering on upcoming releases, developing competitive positioning, and measuring program effectiveness.
description:
Who We Are
 Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company.
  Vultr Cares 
   100% company-paid insurance premiums for employee medical, dental and vision plans

  401(k) plan that matches 100% up to 4%, with immediate vesting

  Professional Development Reimbursement of $2,500 each year

  11 Holidays + Paid Time Off Accrual + Rollover Plan

  Commitment matters to Vultr! Increased PTO at 3 year and 10 year anniversary + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year

  $500 stipend for remote office setup in first year + $400 each following year

  Internet reimbursement up to $75 per month

  Gym membership reimbursement up to $50 per month

  Company paid Wellable subscription

   Join Vultr 
 Vultr is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Manager, Product Enablement to build the enablement engine behind our fastest-growing product lines: Cloud Compute and Cloud GPU. The ideal candidate is a technical enablement expert with 5+ years of experience turning complex infrastructure products into content, training, and tools that sales and customer-facing teams actually use — someone who thrives in a category that reinvents itself every few months. This is a highly visible role in a high-growth technology company, which will require the ability to build recurring enablement cadences from scratch, partner directly with Product and Engineering, and keep pace with a GPU and AI infrastructure market that never sits still. This is your opportunity to join our fast growing team and leave your mark on Vultr and the future of Cloud Infrastructure.
  Key Responsibilities 
   Build and own a recurring product enablement program for Vultr's Cloud Compute and Cloud GPU portfolios, from new feature launches to monthly deep-dives

  Translate complex, fast-changing technical capabilities (GPU architectures, compute instance types, infrastructure roadmaps) into sales-ready messaging, training, and collateral

  Partner with Product Management and Engineering to get early visibility into roadmaps and turn upcoming releases into enablement content before GA

  Design and deliver certification paths, playbooks, and live/on-demand training that scale enablement across a growing go-to-market org

  Develop competitive positioning and battle cards for the Cloud Compute and GPU markets, keeping pace with a rapidly evolving AI infrastructure landscape

  Measure and report on enablement program effectiveness (adoption, certification completion, win rates) and iterate based on data

  Act as the connective tissue between Product, Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success on all things product knowledge

  Continuously evolve enablement formats and cadence to match the speed of Vultr's product velocity

   Qualifications 
   5+ years of experience in product enablement, technical enablement, or product marketing, ideally supporting a technical or infrastructure-based product line

  Proven track record building and scaling recurring enablement programs from the ground up

  Deep comfort with technical products. Able to learn GPU/compute infrastructure concepts quickly and translate them for non-technical audiences

  Experience in cloud infrastructure, AI/ML infrastructure, or adjacent technical industries strongly preferred

  Excellent written and verbal communication skills; experience creating sales collateral, training curricula, and certification programs

  Comfortable operating independently in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with evolving priorities

  Experience with enablement platforms/LMS tools and sales tech stacks (e.g., Gong, Seismic, Salesforce) a plus

   Compensation 
 $115,000 – $130,000
  Final compensation will vary depending on years of experience, background/skill set, location, and applicable laws. 
  Inclusion & Privacy 
 We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.
 We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.
 Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our   Privacy Policy  .

title: Product & Customer Marketing Manager
summary: The Product & Customer Marketing Manager owns product launches, messaging, sales enablement, and customer marketing across Aiwyn’s products. The role turns customer and product insights into launch materials, case studies, competitive tools, and customer proof to support sales wins and product adoption.
description:
About the role

 Our customers have the best stories in accounting, and we need someone to tell them. We're looking for a  Product and Customer Marketing Manager  who owns our story end to end: how we launch, how we sell, and how our customers talk about us; from launch messaging to the customer proof that wins deals. Aiwyn is the platform accounting firms run on for payments, practice management, client experience, and tax, and we work with the majority of the Top 500 firms in the country. You'll turn what our customers and product teams know into messaging, launches, and proof that helps sales win and helps firms get more from Aiwyn.

 You'll partner daily with the growth marketing manager, sales, and product: you find the story and sharpen the message, and they take it to market at scale.


 What you'll do:
 You'll own product launches, messaging, enablement, and customer marketing across our four products. A week in the life might include:

   Tiering an upcoming release and writing the launch brief that Product, Sales, CS, and Marketing all work from

  Interviewing a firm's leadership team about what changed after going live, and pulling out the proof points for a case study

  Building a message map for a new feature and testing it with the sales team

  Running an enablement session on a launch, then updating the pitch deck and one-pagers

  Refreshing competitive battlecards after a deal review

  Managing our customer reference program so sales always has the right firm to call

  Drafting a launch press release or an award submission

  Ghostwriting a LinkedIn post or byline for one of our executives

  Bringing what you hear from customers back to Product so it shows up on the roadmap

  Writing the internal launch announcement so every team knows what shipped and why it matters


   How you'll make an impact:  You'll own outcomes that show up in the business: win rate, product adoption, and how consistently our message lands in the field. We'll be clear about the goals and just as invested in helping you reach them.
 

 What we're looking for:
 You have 4 plus years of product and customer marketing experience in B2B SaaS, and you've owned launches from brief to enablement to results. You're as comfortable interviewing a managing partner as you are sitting in a product review, and you can take a complex feature and explain, in one sentence, why a busy firm leader should care.

 Customer marketing is part of who you are. You know how to find a great story, earn a customer's trust to tell it, and turn it into proof sales uses every week.

 Strong writing is essential. You'll write message maps, launch briefs, enablement content, press releases, and executive posts, and each one needs its own voice.


 Requirements:
   4 plus years of product and/or customer marketing experience in B2B SaaS

  A track record of owning product launches end-to-end, including tiering, messaging, and sales enablement

  Customer marketing experience with case studies, references, advocacy, or customer advisory programs

  Experience marketing to back-office buyers such as finance, operations, or accounting (accounting or professional services experience is a strong plus)

  Writing and storytelling samples you're proud to share

  Experience building competitive intelligence and battlecards

  Comfort presenting to sales teams and customers

  AI tools are part of how you work every day, and you can walk us through your workflow

  Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, and Canva

  Startup experience preferred, but not required

  What to expect
 You'll report to our director of marketing and work with Product, Sales, and Customer Success every week. We're a small, high-performing team, and it shows in how we work: the pace is quick, priorities shift as we learn what's working, and everyone contributes beyond their lane.
 You'll fit right in if you love a good launch day, get a kick out of hearing a customer describe a win in their own words, and want your work to show up in closed deals. We're building something meaningful alongside our customers, and we'd love for you to help shape how the world hears about it.

 Benefits and Perks: 
   The big-picture value proposition of this role is simple: join us, and you'll be paid competitively to have freedom in solving worthwhile, challenging problems alongside other A-players at a fast growing SaaS startup led by an experienced and successful co-founding team with industry experience.

  Other benefits include:
    Adventure travel stipend  - you receive a $1,000 travel reimbursement on your work anniversary each year. We encourage our team to recharge and explore the world beyond their home office walls.

   Remote, work-from-anywhere culture 

   Flexible PTO 

   World Class health benefits  - we believe in fostering flourishing teams by providing benefits that go beyond the usual standards - Health, vision, dental, HSA/FSA, and mental health support.

   Stock options  - every Full Time Employee has ownership in Aiwyn's future and success.

   401(k) matching 

   Our Values: 
    Relentless by Design 

   Owners not Renters 

   Trust at the Core 

  Aiwyn is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.
 Candidate information will be treated in accordance with our CCPA privacy notice which can be found here:  https://www.aiwyn.ai/ccpa

title: Director of Alliances
summary: DataHub is hiring a Director of Alliances to lead its partnership strategy across co-selling, systems integrator certification, and co-marketing. The role owns partner programs, agreements, enablement, pipeline generation, and cross-functional coordination to turn partnerships into measurable revenue.
description:
DataHub is an AI & Data Context Platform adopted by over 3,000 enterprises, including Apple, CVS Health, Netflix, and Visa. Innovated jointly with a thriving open-source community of 13,000+ members, DataHub's metadata graph provides in-depth context of AI and data assets with best-in-class scalability and extensibility.

The company's enterprise SaaS offering, DataHub Cloud, delivers a fully managed solution with AI-powered discovery, observability, and governance capabilities. Organizations rely on DataHub solutions to accelerate time-to-value from their data investments, ensure AI system reliability, and implement unified governance, enabling AI & data to work together and bring order to data chaos.

About DataHub

DataHub transforms enterprise data into trusted context, enabling intelligent decision-making by humans and AI agents. The company was founded by the creators of the popular DataHub open source product that has more than 16,000 contributors and is used by thousands of organizations. The company’s flagship product, DataHub Cloud, is the leading context management platform trusted by the Global 2000 to ensure that context is always relevant, reliable, and continuously refreshed across the entire data estate.

The Role

DataHub | Reports to Chief Marketing Officer

Partnerships are a core lever in DataHub's growth. We're hiring a Director of Alliances to own our partnership strategy end to end: building the systems that let partners help us close deals faster, deliver complete solutions, and generate new pipeline.

You'll build and run three interlocking motions: co-selling with hyperscalers and technology partners, certifying systems integrators to implement DataHub, and co-marketing with partners to source net new opportunities. This is a builder role. You'll design the playbooks, negotiate the agreements, and run the day to day partner relationships that turn strategy into revenue.

What You'll Own

Partner-Influenced (Co-Sell)

  • Build and run a structured, repeatable co-sell playbook with hyperscalers and other strategic technology partners
  • Register deals, introduce account executives to partner counterparts, and drive joint pursuit of opportunities
  • Own hyperscaler alliance relationships, including specialization and co-sell scoring programs
  • Grow the share of deals that are meaningfully influenced by a partner

Partner-Fulfilled (Certification)

  • Stand up a certification program for systems integrators, covering technical enablement, implementation, and specialized delivery tracks (such as compliance or migration work)
  • Build enablement content, technical training, and a tiered partner scoring model
  • Manage relationships with a portfolio of SI and GSI partners
  • Grow the number of certified partners who can independently deliver DataHub implementations

Partner-Sourced (Co-Marketing)

  • Identify and prioritize target accounts using partner pipeline, look-alike data, and joint account mapping
  • Plan and execute joint marketing programs, from webinars to executive events, tailored to technical, business, and economic buyer personas
  • Build joint partner pages, co-branded content, and the tracking infrastructure needed to attribute partner-sourced pipeline
  • Grow the volume of net new opportunities sourced through partners

Program and Relationship Management

  • Own the partnership roadmap and planning cadence, coordinating across sales, marketing, and product
  • Negotiate and manage partnership agreements
  • Represent DataHub at partner and industry events, including partner participation in DataHub's own conference and field events
  • Partner closely with the technical enablement and events functions to deliver a complete partner experience

What You'll Bring

  • 7+ years in partnerships, alliances, or channel roles at an enterprise software or data infrastructure company
  • Direct experience building or scaling co-sell programs with hyperscalers (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure)
  • Experience standing up SI/GSI partner programs, including certification and enablement
  • A track record of turning partnerships into measurable pipeline and revenue, not just signed agreements
  • Comfort operating at both strategic and hands on levels: you can build a three year alliance strategy and also personally register a deal in APN
  • Strong cross functional collaborator, able to align sales, marketing, and product around shared partner goals
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for partner negotiations and executive reporting

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with the data catalog, data governance, or metadata management space
  • Experience with compliance or regulatory frameworks relevant to regulated industries
  • Existing relationships within the AWS, Google Cloud, or major SI partner ecosystems

Reporting and Location

This role reports to the Chief Marketing Officer and works closely with sales leadership, product marketing, and the technical enablement team.

 

Benefits and Perks

We invest in people so they can do their best work and enjoy doing it. Our benefits reflect the way we build: practical, thoughtful, and designed to support long-term growth.

Competitive compensation

We offer salaries that reflect your skills, experience, and the impact you make. You bring value—we make sure you're recognized for it.

Equity for everyone

Every team member receives an ownership stake in the company. When we grow, you grow with us.

Remote Work

All roles are remote unless otherwise specified in the job description. Review the job description to confirm if the role you are interested in is remote or hybrid.

Location flexibility

Home office, coworking space, or something in between? We support your ideal setup. You’ll receive a monthly coworking stipend to use whenever you need a change of pace or in-person collaboration time.

Comprehensive health coverage

Your well-being matters. We cover 99% of medical, dental, and vision premiums employees, and 65% for dependents.

Flexible savings accounts

We offer FSAs to help cover planned or unexpected healthcare costs. You can also opt into a Dependent Care FSA to support family needs.

Support for every path to parenthood

Through Carrot Fertility, we provide inclusive fertility benefits and family-forming support. All U.S. employees have access, regardless of age, gender identity, or family structure.

Time off that works for you

We trust you to take the time you need. Our unlimited PTO and sick leave policy is designed for flexibility, rest, and real life.

 

Why Join Us

DataHub is at a rare inflection point: we’ve achieved product-market fit, earned the trust of leading enterprises, and secured backing from top-tier investors like Bessemer Venture Partners and 8VC. The context platform market is expected to grow from $1B to $9B in the next five years—and we’re leading the way.

By joining our team, you’ll:

  • Tackle high-impact challenges at the heart of enterprise AI infrastructure
  • Ship production systems that power real-world use cases at global scale
  • Collaborate with a high-caliber team of builders who’ve scaled some of the most influential data tools in the world
  • Build the next generation of AI-native data systems, including conversational agents, intelligent classification, automated governance, and more

If you're passionate about technology, enjoy working with customers, and want to be part of a fast-growing company changing the industry, we want to hear from you!

title: Sales Enablement Specialist
summary: The Sales Enablement Specialist will build and run onboarding for new Account Executives and Sales Engineers, creating curricula, role-based learning paths, certifications, and ramp reporting. The role uses Salesforce and Gong to measure onboarding effectiveness, identify coaching gaps, maintain enablement content, and support launch readiness and ongoing enablement programs.
description:
About 7AI
 7AI is the foundational AI security company. Founded in 2024 by Cybereason co-founders Lior Div and Yonatan Striem-Amit, we came out of stealth in February 2025 to take on the non-human work of the SOC. Our platform pairs a federated SIEM with AI agents that detect, investigate, respond, and hunt, plus dedicated threat hunting and threat intelligence, with humans on the loop.
 Backed by $166 million in total funding from investors including Index Ventures and Blackstone, we're building the AI foundation for security operations in the agentic era, and we're still early. That's the appeal: you'll join at a pivotal stage where your work shapes what 7AI becomes, alongside security veterans who've built this before. Our culture runs on respect, collaboration, and a shared bar for excellence, all pointed at one goal, delivering real outcomes for the customers who trust us to defend them.
 Overview
 7AI is building the onboarding program for a sales team that's still writing its own playbook. As our Sales Enablement Specialist, you'll own onboarding for every new Account Executive and Sales Engineer, turning what our sales leaders, SEs, and product team know into curriculum, learning paths, and certifications people can actually use. You'll build the reporting that shows whether it worked, not just whether reps sat through it. This is a build role: expect to ship a first version fast, watch what happens in Gong and Salesforce, and improve it in the field rather than waiting for a finished program.
 What You'll Do
   Build and run the onboarding program for new AEs and SEs, working from the structure and priorities you set with the Head of Strategy & Enablement.

  Turn subject matter expertise from sales leadership, SEs, and product into structured curriculum, role-based learning paths, and certifications.

  Instrument ramp metrics in Salesforce and build the reporting that shows whether onboarding is working.

  Use Gong and Salesforce to surface coaching gaps and skill patterns, and bring recommendations for what to build next.

  Maintain the enablement content library and keep it current as the product and market move.

  Support launch readiness and ongoing enablement programming for the existing team.

  Partner with SE leadership so AE and SE onboarding stay one coordinated program.

  What We're Looking For
   2+ years in sales enablement, revenue enablement, or sales/revenue operations.

  You've built a program, process, or curriculum from a blank page, on your own or as the primary builder under a more senior owner, and can walk through it end to end.

  You're comfortable turning other people's expertise into something teachable. Most of the security and product content here will come from our sales leaders, SEs, and product team.

  You can build the reporting behind a metric and explain what it tells you. You can answer "did this change rep behavior" with evidence, not just a completion rate.

  You're fluent with AI tooling in a build context: building repeatable workflows, not just occasional prompting.

  You'd rather ship a v1 into the field and iterate than wait for a finished program.

  You're curious about security. No prior cybersecurity experience required, but you're ready to go deep on our product and buyer in the first 90 days.

  You thrive at a company still writing its own playbook.

title: North America Market Solutions Director
summary: Skillsoft is seeking an experienced North America Market Solutions Director to lead regional Market Solutions teams, drive ARR growth, retention, expansion, customer experience, and consistent execution across the customer lifecycle. The role manages and coaches market leaders, oversees solutioning and customer outcomes, leads transformation and shared-channel teams, and partners with global and cross-functional leadership to establish scalable operating practices.
description:
At Skillsoft, we believe skills fuel growth. Our mission is to empower every organization and every learner to turn constant change into continuous growth. As part of the team, your skills will help organizations understand what skills they have, what they need next, and how to apply them in ways that drive real performance and progress.

 

North America Market Solutions Director

Skillsoft is hiring an experienced North America  Market Solutions Director to make an impact and drive ARR growth, improve retention, drive a great customer experience, and guide teams through change with clarity and pace. We are seeking a strong operator, coach, and change agent who can turn strategy into repeatable execution across five North America markets.

The NA Market Solutions Director will have the opportunity to be a player / coach and deliver regional results and own the Customer Experience and growth engine for North America. Overseeing the regional Market Solutions Leaders and ensuring consistent, disciplined execution across the customer lifecycle to include presales, adoption, expansion and renewal. This role operates as an executive people leader, global practice owner, and partners closely with the North America VP of Sales as the region's primary Go To Market change leaders for the region sustaining team confidence, clarity, and pace through continued change.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead the Geographical Market Solutions Teams

  • Manage, coach, and develop the MSLs across the geography; set clear performance standards and accountability.
  • Ensure Market Solutions Leaders (MSLs) execute the end-to-end customer solution lifecycle (Sale → Value → Expand → Renew) with MEDDPICC rigor and value-realization discipline.
  • Build a high-performance, coaching-first culture aligned to Skillsoft's Enterprise Leadership Skills; build team capabilities systematically.
  • Guarantee the MSL’s align Solutions Partners across markets to match opportunity size, complexity, and urgency.

Coach Solutioning Capability and Lead Through Transformation

  • Coach MSLs and their teams on advanced solutioning - executive discovery and problem framing, solution architecture and design, value narrative and business case development, and platform and ecosystem expertise
  • Steer the team through an organization in transformation: guide teams through evolving roles, new operating models, and shifting customer expectations with clarity, confidence, and pace
  • Support MSLs in developing the CSM function as a strategic advisor capability - fluent in skills intelligence, data-led insight, executive engagement, and outcome-based partnership rather than reactive account management
  • Collaborate with and support the MSLs in developing Solution Partners as expert customer-facing advisors - deep in product and platform, disciplined in solution design methodology, and credible with C-suite buying committees
  • Drive adoption of AI-enabled workflows and tooling to expand strategic capacity and reduce administrative load

Deliver Regional Revenue and Customer Outcomes

  • Co-own regional targets with the North America Geo Sales Leader (AVP): ARR growth, retention, expansion, NPS, and platform conversion.
  • Oversee regional performance management cadences to drive continuous improvement and results; escalate and resolve at-risk accounts; enable growth across accounts.

Own the Global Component – Shared / Channel Teams (example only of Global Component)

  • Define the charter and target operating model for global shared/channel solution teams.
  • Establish rules of engagement between shared CSM pools, MSLs, direct sales, and channel partners.
  • Build channel enablement content and playbooks for solution positioning through partners.
  • Design coverage tiers so tier-2/tier-3 customers receive scalable, high-quality solution support.
  • Report on channel-sourced ARR and shared-team utilization to the Global Solutions Leader.

Drive Cross-Regional Consistency

  • Serve as a member of the Global Solutions Management team alongside peer GMSLs, the Solutions IP Team lead, and the Program Manager.
  • Responsible for ensuring global standards are applied in-region while allowing appropriate local tailoring for market realities.
  • Share regional insights back into the global system — customer patterns, competitive intel, and solution feedback — to inform IP and roadmap.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with the Solutions IP Team to translate defined solutions and POVs into repeatable, market-ready plays.
  • Interlock with Professional Services regional leadership on clean presales-to-delivery handoffs.
  • Partner with Product, Marketing, and Enablement to close feedback loops from field to global functions.
  • Support the Program Manager in keeping data clean, systems used, and operating rhythm consistent.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 12+ years of progressive management experience in enterprise PaaS spanning some combination of Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Consulting/Pre-Sales, and/or Professional Services.
  • Overseeing Professional / Managed Services and Solutioning (or consulting) experience with demonstrated results driving long-term customer growth with services engagements based on business cases.
  • Proven track record of delivering ARR growth, retention, and expansion in a platform and solutions-based selling motion.
  • Proficient in Salesforce and Business Intelligence (BI) tools.
  • Deep fluency in MEDDPICC (or equivalent), value-based selling, and end-to-end customer lifecycle management.
  • Experience as a practice or system builder — designing repeatable processes, tools, or capability models adopted at scale.
  • Possess a strong operational rigor with proficiency in forecasting, pipeline inspection, and data-driven outcomes
  • Have a deep familiarity with North America market dynamics.
  • Executive presence with proven ability to engage C-suite customers and internal senior leadership.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Experience operating in a matrixed global organization and collaborating with strong partnership across Product, Professional Services, Revenue Operations, and Marketing.
  • Familiarity with the Learning technologies and L&D functions, learning/talent ecosystems, and AI-enabled workforce transformation.

Target base salary range for this job requisition is anticipated to be approximately $215,000 - $239,000 annualized.

We also offer Enterprise benefits including but not limited to: medical, dental, vision, and paid time off.

The company may modify salaries, salary ranges and/or Pay Plans from time to time as it deems necessary.

 

Skillsoft uses AI-enabled tools to screen applications. Recruitment and hiring decisions are made by Skillsoft personnel and are not based solely on automated processing.

Skillsoft is trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 1000, and supports a global community of more than 105 million learners. Learn more at skillsoft.com.

title: Vp, Product Marketing
summary: The VP of Product Marketing will define EvenUp’s product marketing strategy and go-to-market engine for its AI-powered legal solutions. The role leads product launches, sales enablement, competitive positioning, market analysis, and customer evidence programs while building and mentoring a high-performing product marketing organization.
description:
EvenUp is on a mission to close the justice gap using technology and AI. We empower personal injury lawyers and victims to get the justice they deserve. Our products enable law firms to secure faster settlements, higher payouts, and better outcomes for victims injured through no fault of their own in vehicle collisions, accidents, natural disasters, and more.
 We are one of the fastest-growing vertical SaaS companies in history, and we are just getting started. EvenUp is backed by top VCs, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Bain Capital Ventures, SignalFire, and Lightspeed. We are looking to expand our team with talented, driven, and collaborative individuals who seek to have a lasting impact. Learn more at   www.evenuplaw.com  .
 The  VP of Product Marketing  will report to the CMO and define the strategic narrative and GTM engine for our expanding portfolio of AI-powered legal solutions, acting as a force multiplier for our revenue engine while scaling the marketing organization for sustained, long-term growth. Reporting to the CMO, this seasoned leader will build and lead the product marketing organization to translate complex technical breakthroughs in AI into compelling, high-conversion value propositions that resonate deeply with law firm leaders and legal professionals across the SMB, Mid-Market, Enterprise, and Strategic segments.
 This leader must craft a multi-year marketing strategy that compounds our brand and category position, effectively balancing urgent quarterly goals with the foundational work required to scale EvenUp into a full-scale system-of-record. They will paint a compelling, unified vision for the marketing team, ensuring that every launch cycle, sales enablement asset, and customer evidence program directly supports our mission to close the justice gap.
 Success requires precise communication, as this person will influence cross-functional leaders in Product and Sales to align on roadmap priorities and market signals. They must possess the expertise to differentiate our AI in a crowded legal-tech landscape, grounding our narrative in tangible customer value. Ultimately, this individual will build and mentor a cohesive team, fostering the talent density necessary to sustain our rapid trajectory.

  What You’ll Do: 
   Own and execute EvenUp’s product marketing strategy, ensuring our positioning, GTM plan, and activation evolves as we scale our product

  Partner with EPD leadership to drive launch cycles for new features and platform products, focusing on adoption metrics and revenue impact.

  Partner with sales on the development of sales enablement content, competitive positioning, and customer evidence programs that accelerate deal velocity across all market segments.

  Analyze market and user signal to inform the product roadmap, ensuring that customer pain points are at the center of our development prioritization.

  Scale and mentor a high-performing product marketing team, fostering deep cross-functional partnership between Marketing, Product, and Sales.

   What We Look For: 
   12+ years of experience in product marketing, with a proven track record of scaling high-growth B2B SaaS organizations.

  Experience leading product marketing for AI-native or technical products where complex workflows were a core component of the value proposition.

  Strong track record of partnering with Sales leadership to drive GTM alignment and achieve measurable revenue growth.

  Deep understanding of how to translate technical capabilities into clear, concise, and persuasive messaging that resonates with non-technical end users.

  Proven ability to influence executive leadership and navigate complex, cross-functional organizational environments.

   Benefits & Perks: 
 As part of our total rewards package, we offer attractive benefits and perks to our employees, including:
   Choice of medical, dental, and vision insurance plans for you and your family.

  Additional insurance coverage options for life, accident, or critical illness.

  A home office stipend.

  401(k) for US-based employees and RRSP for Canada-based employees.

   (Please note the above benefits & perks are for full-time employees) 
   Notice to Candidates:
