title: Solutions Architect
summary: OpenRouter is seeking a Solutions Architect to serve as the technical backbone of its sales organization for enterprise AI infrastructure solutions. The role involves leading technical discovery, solution design, architecture discussions, proofs of concept, deal support, and cross-functional collaboration with Product, Engineering, and Customer Engineering.
description:
About OpenRouter 
 OpenRouter is the open AI routing and infrastructure layer that enterprises use to access, manage, and optimize the best large language models across providers—without lock-in, capacity constraints, or unnecessary cost. We power some of the most advanced AI teams in the world by giving them the flexibility to move fast, scale confidently, and stay future-proof as models evolve.
 As enterprise adoption of AI accelerates, OpenRouter sits at the center of how organizations operationalize LLMs across research, product, and production workloads.
 

  About the Role 
 As a Solutions Architect, you'll be the technical backbone of our sales organization — partnering with Business Development Managers and Product Managers to translate complex customer requirements into winning technical strategy. You'll work directly with engineering, infrastructure, and platform teams at our largest prospects and customers, helping them understand how to architect, integrate, and scale their LLM usage on OpenRouter.
 This is a hands-on, customer-facing technical role. You'll run technical discovery, lead architecture conversations, build and support proofs of concept, and be the trusted technical voice in complex, multi-stakeholder deals — while also feeding what you learn back into Product and Engineering to make OpenRouter better.
 

  What You'll Do 
    Own the technical side of the sales cycle.  Partner with Business Development Managers and Product Managers on strategic and enterprise opportunities, leading technical discovery, solution design, and architecture discussions with customer engineering and infrastructure teams.

   Run and support proofs of concept.  Scope POCs with customers, help them stand up integrations, troubleshoot issues in real time, and drive POCs to a clear technical win.

   Translate business needs into technical solutions.  Understand a customer's infrastructure, model usage, and constraints, and map them to the right OpenRouter architecture, routing strategy, and deployment approach.

   Be the credible technical voice in the room.  Build trust with engineers, architects, and technical decision-makers by speaking their language — on compute, networking, security, and infrastructure as well as on LLMs.

   Support deal strategy.  Help Business Development Managers and Product Managersand account teams navigate technical objections, security reviews, and procurement requirements that come up in enterprise and infrastructure deals.

   Build reusable technical assets.  Create demos, reference architectures, POC frameworks, and technical enablement content the broader sales team can use.

   Partner cross-functionally.  Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Customer Engineering to bring customer and market signal back into the roadmap, and to make sure customer feedback shapes what we build next.

   Stay technically sharp.  Keep pace with the fast-evolving LLM landscape — new models, providers, infrastructure patterns, and the tools your customers are already using.

  
 What We're Looking For 
   7+ years in a technical, customer-facing role in B2B SaaS — as a Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or senior technical Account Executive — with a strong track record supporting complex enterprise deals.

  Deep experience with developer-centric infrastructure: cloud, Kubernetes, virtualization, networking, storage, or open-source infrastructure platforms.

  Comfort going deep with technical stakeholders (engineers, architects, infrastructure teams) as well as business stakeholders, and the ability to move fluidly between the two.

  A track record of driving technical wins in the sales cycle — POCs, architecture reviews, security reviews — that translate into closed business.

  Strong hands-on technical curiosity: you build things, break things, and stay current because you want to, not just because the job requires it.

  Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  Experience operating in a fast-growing, evolving environment where product, process, and priorities shift as the company scales.

  
 Nice to Haves 
   Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, hardened/secure images, or private cloud infrastructure.

  Personal projects involving AI agents, self-hosted models, or infrastructure tinkering (e.g., running models or VMs on home lab hardware like a Raspberry Pi).

  Experience selling or supporting sales into healthcare, financial services, or other regulated industries.

  Experience building technical enablement or POC programs from scratch at an early-stage or high-growth company.

  Familiarity with the LLM ecosystem (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, open-source models) and multi-provider routing concepts.

   If you don't think you meet all of the criteria below but still are interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box, and we're looking for someone who is excited to join the team.

title: Senior Director, Product & Customer Marketing
summary: Solink is hiring a Senior Director of Product and Customer Marketing to define category positioning, lead go-to-market strategy for major launches, and build competitive intelligence, sales enablement, and Analyst Relations programs. The role also owns customer marketing, advocacy, references, adoption, expansion, and retention initiatives while building and coaching a high-performing team and influencing executive-level strategy.
description:
Senior Director, Product & Customer Marketing
  Level:  M5
 Location:  CAD or US | Eastern or Pacific Timezone
 Reports To:    Michael Scott | Chief Marketing Officer  
 Department:   Marketing
 Type:  Permanent | Full-Time
 Vacancy Status:   This is an active, approved role and we are currently hiring for this position.
  About Solink 
 At Solink, our mission is to  safeguard what matters most . We provide businesses with the tools to  know sooner and act faster  by transforming video security into real-time operational insights.
 Our cloud-based platform integrates seamlessly with your existing cameras and systems, turning them into intelligent sensors that detect and interpret key moments. This empowers teams to make data-driven decisions, enhance security, and improve operational efficiency.
 Trusted by over 35,000 locations across 60+ countries - including brands like McDonald’s and JYSK - Solink delivers clarity when it counts. Our solutions help businesses reduce shrink, optimize performance, and respond proactively to potential threats.
 We're growing rapidly, earning industry recognition, and scaling with purpose. We’ve been recognized by Deloitte’s Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, Business Intelligence Group, and as one of Ottawa’s Best Places to Work. And we’re just getting started!
  About The Role 
 Solink is looking for a (head of) Senior Director, Product Marketing and Customer Marketing to create category leadership and sharpen our positioning - accelerating adoption, differentiation, and revenue across our key products. This is a newly unified leadership role, bringing Product Marketing and Customer Marketing together so the story we tell to prospects and the story we tell to existing customers reinforce each other.
 You'll own positioning and messaging, lead go-to-market strategy for major launches, run competitive intelligence and win/loss, scale sales enablement, and stand up an Analyst Relations (AR) program - while also owning how we market to and grow our existing customer base through advocacy, references, and expansion programs.
 This is a senior, executive-facing role for someone who can define a category, arm a sales team to win, and build a team and function from a strong existing base of product marketers.
  What You’ll Be Doing 
  Positioning & Messaging 
   Own product positioning, messaging, and narrative across Solink’s platform and key products and industries we serve.

  Develop and defend a category point of view that differentiates Solink from adjacent and competing solutions.

  Test and refine messaging with customers, prospects, and sales to ensure it resonates and converts.

   GTM Strategy 
   Lead go-to-market strategy and execution for major feature and product launches, partnering with Product, Demand Gen, Sales, and Customer Success.

  Build launch playbooks and processes that scale across a growing product portfolio.

  Identify opportunities to grow adoption and ARPU through positioning, packaging, and GTM for new features and add-ons.

   Competitive Intelligence 
   Own Solink’s competitive intelligence program, keeping a current, accurate view of the competitive landscape.

  Run a win/loss program that turns deal outcomes into sharper positioning and enablement.

  Educate internal teams - Sales, Marketing, Product - on competitive threats and how to respond to them.

   Sales Enablement 
   Build and scale sales enablement content — battlecards, pitch decks, objection handling, and training — that drives rep proficiency and win rate.

  Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and RevOps to ensure enablement keeps pace with the roadmap and competitive landscape.

  Measure and improve enablement adoption and its impact on ramp time and win rate.

   Analyst Relations (AR) 
   Build Solink’s Analyst Relations program from the ground up, establishing relationships with relevant industry analysts.

  Prepare briefings, RFI/RFP responses, and positioning materials for analyst evaluations and reports.

  Translate analyst feedback into product, positioning, and GTM recommendations for leadership.

   Customer Marketing & Advocacy 
   Own customer marketing strategy - references, case studies, testimonials, and advocacy programs that support both sales, demand gen, channel and brand.

  Partner with Demand Gen and Customer Success on programs that drive adoption, expansion, and retention among existing customers.

  Build a scalable customer reference and advisory program to support field marketing pg growth, competitive deals and category-building efforts.

   A Little Bit About You 
   10+ years of experience in product marketing, with meaningful experience in customer marketing, competitive intelligence, or analyst relations.

  A proven track record building category positioning that differentiates a product in a competitive market.

  Experience leading go-to-market strategy and execution for major product launches end-to-end.

  Experience building or scaling a sales enablement function, with measurable impact on win rate or ramp time.

  Comfort building new functions from scratch, including Analyst Relations or customer advocacy programs.

  Strong executive communication skills, with experience presenting positioning and strategy to CMO, executive, and board-level audiences.

  Experience building and coaching a team of product and/or customer marketers.

   What Success Looks Like 
   Solink has a clear, differentiated category position that Sales, Marketing, Channel, and Product all use consistently.

  Major launches land on time with strong adoption and a measurable revenue contribution.

  Sales wins more competitive deals, supported by sharp, current competitive intelligence and enablement.

  Solink has an active, credible presence with relevant industry analysts.

  Existing customers become a growing source of references, advocacy, and expansion revenue.

   Nice to Haves 
   Experience in physical security, video surveillance, IoT, or a related B2B technology industry.

  Experience building an Analyst Relations function in a company that didn’t previously have one.

  Experience scaling a product or customer marketing function as a company grows past $100M+ ARR.

  Familiarity with sales enablement and customer marketing platforms (e.g., HubSpot, SalesForce, Highspot, Seismic, Gainsight).

   Role Expectations 
 This is an M5 level role. At Solink, individuals at this level set the strategic direction for a major function, translating executive priorities into scalable execution, building organizational capability through the leaders and teams they develop, and are accountable for delivering sustained business outcomes.
  In This Role, You'll Be Expected To: 
   Own the long-term strategy, operating model, and performance of Product & Customer Marketing, translating CMO and executive priorities into clear roadmaps and measurable outcomes.

  Build and grow a high-performing team, developing future leaders and building strong marketing capability across the function.

  Partner with the CMO and cross-functional executives (Sales, Product, Customer Success) to influence company-wide GTM priorities and strategic initiatives.

  Establish scalable systems, playbooks, and operating rhythms — launch process, sales enablement, win/loss, AR, customer advocacy — that improve effectiveness beyond any single program.

  Represent Product & Customer Marketing internally as the senior authority on positioning and category strategy, building trusted relationships across the organization.

   What Success Looks Like: 
   Product & Customer Marketing is recognized as a strategic, executive-level function with a clear seat at the GTM table, not a service arm to Sales or Demand Gen.

  The team and leaders you build operate with growing autonomy and are developing toward their own next level.

  The systems and playbooks you establish scale beyond you and are adopted company-wide, outlasting any single launch or campaign.

   Security Requirements 
   Candidates must undergo a criminal records check upon hire;

  Be a Canadian Citizen (dual citizens included), or eligible to work in Canada;

  Be willing to comply with Solink’s own security policies and standards.

   Our Values 
 We do things the Solink way:
    Act with URGENCY  – Our customers move fast, so we do too.

   Deliver with QUALITY  – We sweat the details and hold a high bar.

   Win with TEAM  – No egos. Just outcomes, built together.

   Lead with TRUST  – We earn it through clarity, consistency, and care.


  These aren’t just words—they shape how we hire, lead, and grow.
  Why Solink? 
 We’re not just building tech - we’re building a place where great people do great work.
    Clarity and trust : Where the role allows, we support flexibility in how and where work gets done - and we’re upfront about what’s required.

   Meaningful equity : Every full-time, permanent employee has a stake in our growth.

   Comprehensive benefits : Fully paid health & dental (no waiting period) + $500 health spending account.

   Wellness support : Monthly reimbursement for fitness, wellness, or mental health programs.

   Growth through merit : Advancement is based on contribution, initiative, and the ability to raise the bar - together.

   Candid culture : Clear expectations, honest feedback, and no politics.

   Social connection : From So-learns to Solink-o and So-lunches, we stay connected in ways that actually feel fun.

   What to Expect from the Hiring Process 
 We respect your time and value transparency. Here’s a general idea of what to expect:
   Intro call with our Talent Team

  Interview with the Hiring Manager

  Role-relevant task or case (if applicable)

  Final interviews with cross-functional team members

  Reference Checks

  Offer & onboarding 🎉

   Please note: this is subject to change at any point in the recruitment process based on the needs of the business. 
  How to Apply 
 Submit your resume and a short cover letter via our [  Careers Page  ]. Let us know what excites you about this role, and how you’d help move Solink forward.
   NOTICE: Solink    uses artificial intelligence (AI) to screen, assess, and/or select candidates for this position. 
   Solink is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. If you require accommodation during the selection process, please let us know.

The role includes marketplace publishing, sales enablement, Microsoft-focused marketing, client success stories, and influencing cross-functional teams to drive demand and growth.
description:

Do you want to work on teams where people roll up their sleeves to take on tough problems together, and regularly blow the doors off our clients with their outstanding teamwork? If you answered yes to those questions, 3Cloud might just be for you!

At 3Cloud, we hire people who aren’t afraid to experiment or fail. We hire people who are willing to give direct and candid feedback to their managers, leaders, and team members. title: Director, Sled Solutions Engineering
summary: Skydio is seeking a Director of Solutions Engineering for state and local government, education, and corrections across the United States and Canada. The role leads a multi-team organization, owns technical outcomes and coverage models, supports customer deployments and integrations, and represents customer requirements to Product and Engineering. It is remote, requires approximately 30% travel, and includes responsibility for public sector procurement, technical wins, proofs of concept, and team growth.
description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from  utility inspectors  to  first responders ,  soldiers in battlefield scenarios , and  beyond .
  About the Role: 
 Skydio is seeking an experienced Solutions Engineering leader to join our team as Director, Solutions Engineering for SLED. This role owns the technical outcome for state and local government, education, and corrections across the United States and Canada. It is a leader of leaders role: you will build and run a multi-team organization through a year of significant growth, and the bar you set for hiring and technical quality is the one the whole vertical inherits.
 This is a remote role. Travel of approximately 30% is required to support customer engagements, field activities, deployments, team onsites, and company events.
 This role reports to the VP, Solutions Engineering.
  About the Team 
 The SLED Solutions Engineering team is the technical arm of Skydio's state and local go-to-market motion. We sit between the agency and the product: turning operational problems into program designs, proving capability in the field, and making sure Skydio's products are used, integrated, and flown at scale.
 The team is measured on technical win rate, trial and proof of concept outcomes, program expansion, site assessment quality, and the requirements we push back into the product organization.
 Solutions Engineers are critical members of the Skydio organization and work closely with Key Account Leaders, Engineering, and Product to support deal progression, customer confidence, successful deployments, and the long-term success of Public Safety sUAS programs. As Director you are the technical counterpart to the VP of SLED Sales, and you own the coverage model that pairs the two organizations together.
  How You’ll Make an Impact: 
  Lead the leaders 
   Recruit, hire, and develop Senior Managers, and create the path that takes strong Solutions Engineers into their first management role.

  Hold each manager to a segment outcome rather than an activity count, and coach them on coaching.

  Scale the organization without losing the bar. Hiring velocity in the first half of the year is the single largest execution risk in the plan.

  Own the operating rhythm of the vertical: forecast reviews, capacity decisions, and the escalation path when demand for technical resources exceeds supply.

   Drive technical wins 
   Own the technical win across all of SLED, and own the coverage model that pairs Solutions Engineering to the sales organization seat for seat. Defend it, or revise it with evidence, each planning cycle.

  Partner with the VP of SLED Sales as the technical counterpart on segmentation, territory design, and headcount, and bring a defensible position rather than a request.

  Represent SLED in forecast, planning, and executive reviews, and bring technical risk forward early rather than at the end of the quarter.

   Own the SLED problem set 
   Own site assessment quality as a performance measure. Solutions Engineers are the DRI for verifying a dock location before deployment, and the quality of the resulting installation reflects on the team.

  Hold the bar on proofs of concept: structured deployments tied to an active opportunity with measurable operational value, not casual evaluations.

  Guide integration and airspace strategy — CAD and dispatch, video and evidence management, streaming platforms, BVLOS approvals, waivers, COAs, and docked operations.

  Maintain command of the public sector procurement path, including cooperative contracts, grant funded programs, and public sector buying cycles.

   Represent the customer inside Skydio 
   Be the aggregated voice of the customer to Product and Engineering. Turn field observations into prioritized, defensible requirements rather than a list of one-off asks.

  Build the enablement content, reference architectures, and reusable technical assets that let the team scale, and maintain first-hand product knowledge through frequent hands-on use.

   What Makes You a Good Fit: 
   8+ years of relevant technical experience, including time in a customer-facing technical role.

  2+ years leading leaders. A track record of managing managers, or of managing a team large enough to have required a second layer.

  A record of building organizations through fast growth — hiring, onboarding, and retaining technical people at volume.

  Strong understanding of drone technology, Public Safety sUAS operations, and regulatory compliance, including Drone as First Responder concepts of operation and dock based remote operations.

  Working knowledge of Public Safety technologies, including CAD, VMS, and related software platforms, and the ability to lead integration discussions.

  Fluency in the commercial side of the business: coverage models, forecast discipline, deal strategy, and the judgment to know when to commit technical resources and when to decline.

  Experience with state and local government procurement, including cooperative contracts, grant funded programs, and public sector buying cycles.

  Excellent written and verbal communication. You can brief an operator, a program manager, and a senior executive without changing the facts.

  Lead by example. Willing to do whatever is needed to get a customer situation resolved.

   Nice to Have 
   Prior public safety service as a sworn officer, firefighter, or agency UAS program lead.

  Experience standing up a Drone as First Responder program from waiver through go-live, and with dock-based, remote, and BVLOS operations at scale.

  Familiarity with grant funding pathways and cooperative purchasing vehicles used by state and local agencies.

  Working knowledge of Salesforce, Palantir, Databricks, or equivalents.

  Track record of building and scaling a technical team through a period of rapid growth.

   What Is Required 
   Ability to travel approximately 30% of the time.

  Ability to lift up to 60 lbs unaided.

  Obtaining FAA Part 107 certification within the first 60 days of employment is strongly encouraged for all Skydio employees and required for certain positions.

   Compensation:  At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. The annual base salary range for this position is $196,000 - $245,000*. Fundamentally, we believe that equity is the key to long-term financial growth, and we ensure all regular, full-time employees have the opportunity to significantly benefit from the company's success. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to enroll in the Company’s group health insurance plans. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to receive the following benefits: Paid vacation time, sick leave, holiday pay and 401K savings plan. This position and all associated benefits are subject to applicable federal, state, and local laws, as well as the Company’s policies and eligibility criteria.
 *Compensation for certain positions may vary based on the position’s location.
 At Skydio we believe that diversity drives innovation. We have created a multidisciplinary environment that embraces the power of diverse perspectives to create elegant solutions for complex problems. We are committed to growing our network of people, programs, and resources to nurture an inclusive culture.
 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by federal, state or local anti-discrimination laws.
 For positions located in the United States of America, Skydio, Inc. uses E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit  https://www.e-verify.gov/

title: Senior Sales Enablement Manager, Smb & Mid-market
summary: Fetch is seeking a Senior Sales Enablement Manager to support its SMB and Mid-Market sales teams. The role will build segment-specific sales motions, onboarding paths, playbooks, training, coaching, and measurement programs while partnering cross-functionally to improve seller productivity and commercial performance.
description:
What we’re building and why we’re building it.    
  Fetch helps people live rewarded every day, with a vision to become the rewards destination for everyone. We turn everyday activities into meaningful rewards, whether it’s grocery shopping, grabbing a quick meal, or playing a favorite mobile game. To date, we’ve awarded more than $1 billion in Fetch Points to our users.  
  Each day, more than 13 million receipts are submitted on Fetch, providing visibility into over $212 billion in gross merchandise value. This creates the largest retail-agnostic, SKU-level view of household spending, powering Fetch as an outcomes-based advertising platform that helps brands acquire and retain lifelong consumers.  
  The Fetch app is available on the App Store and Google Play, with more than 6 million five-star reviews from a highly engaged and loyal user base.  
   It’s not just our users who believe in Fetch: with investments from Softbank, ICONIQ, DST, Greycroft, and partnerships ranging from challenger brands to Fortune 500 companies, Fetch is reshaping how brands and consumers connect in the marketplace. When you work at Fetch, you play a vital role in a platform that drives brand loyalty and creates lifelong consumers with the power of Fetch points. User and partner success are at the heart of everything we do, and we extend that same commitment to our employees.   
   At Fetch, we value curiosity, adaptability, and the confidence to explore new tools, especially AI, to drive smarter, faster work. This is a builder role for someone who can move between strategy and execution diagnosing what is getting in the way of performance, translating complex offerings into practical sales guidance, and partnering closely with leaders and managers to reinforce the right behaviors in the flow of work.

  Track time-to-readiness and time-to-productivity, using results to improve the ramp experience and remove friction for new hires.

  Own the creation and ongoing maintenance of every required MM/SMB version of broader training, package guidance, pitch decks, playbooks, talk tracks, and seller tools. 
  Translate shared offerings into the right MM/SMB execution—including package variances and more accessible entry levels, cold-outreach and new-business discovery motions, segment-relevant positioning, and role-specific pitch guidance. 
  Build practical segment playbooks that include buyer needs, outreach and discovery guidance, positioning, talk tracks, package selection, objection handling, proof points, measurement guidance, and execution steps.

  Convert launches and one-time trainings into reusable learning, coaching tools, and reinforcement that drive sustained adoption and behavior change. 
  Maintain accurate, easy-to-use segment content in Letter AI in partnership with the broader enablement content owner and established governance standards. 
  
   Enablement Peer & Cross-Functional Partnership   
    Work closely with the Sales Enablement Manager serving other verticals to co-plan the roadmap, preserve consistent core messaging and methods, and identify MM/SMB versioning needs before broader programs are finalized.

  Equip frontline managers with coaching guides, call-review frameworks, readiness checkpoints, and team exercises that reinforce the segment motion. 
  Develop deep working relationships with GTM partners responsible for product launches, media units, and Moments, representing MM/SMB requirements while plans, packages, and activation details are still being shaped. 
  Influence cross-functional plans so new products and activations have a compelling, executable fit for MM/SMB customers rather than requiring late-stage retrofitting. 
  Partner closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Revenue Operations, AIM, and other subject-matter experts to turn complex inputs into clear seller actions. 
  Create a reliable feedback loop between the field and cross-functional partners so messaging, packages, processes, and training improve as the businesses evolve. 
  Represent SMB and Mid-Market enablement needs in broader Sales Enablement planning while reusing shared programs and standards wherever they create scale. 
  
   Measurement & Continuous Improvement   
    Define and track success measures for onboarding, training, package adoption, and seller proficiency, including leading and lagging indicators. 
  Track MM and SMB participation and completion across required trainings, following up with sellers and managers to close gaps and maintain clear visibility into readiness. 
  Monitor Gong adoption and use call reviews, manager observation, assessments, content usage, seller feedback, and commercial performance data to determine whether training is being applied in the field. 
  Use observed field behaviors to target reinforcement, coaching, content updates, and future training rather than treating completion as the finish line. 
  Use Letter AI, Gong, Salesforce, and AI-enabled workflows to improve learning, surface performance insights, and make enablement easier to access in the flow of work. 
  
   Qualifications   
    8+ years of experience in Sales Enablement, Revenue Enablement, Sales Training, or a comparable commercial role; experience supporting SMB and/or Mid-Market sales teams is strongly preferred. 
  Demonstrated success building or improving onboarding, playbooks, training, coaching, or sales motions that produced measurable changes in seller performance. 
  Strong understanding of high-velocity SMB selling and consultative Mid-Market selling, with the judgment to tailor enablement to different cycle lengths, buyers, and levels of deal complexity. 
  Ability to simplify complex products, pricing, packaging, and processes into clear guidance sellers can confidently use with customers. 
  Experience using data and qualitative insights to diagnose performance gaps, prioritize programs, and measure impact. 
  Strong facilitation, coaching, program management, and stakeholder-management skills. 
  Ability to operate independently and build structure in a fast-paced, evolving environment. 
  Experience with LMS/CMS platforms, CRM, conversation intelligence, and AI-enabled sales or learning tools. 
  Prior quota-carrying sales experience or meaningful experience coaching sellers in-role is strongly preferred. 
  
   What Success Looks Like   
    A clear, repeatable SMB sales motion is documented, taught, reinforced, and improved as the new team scales. 
  Customized onboarding and ramp paths for Mid-Market Growth, Mid-Market New Business, and future SMB roles remain current and help sellers reach meaningful readiness milestones faster.

title: Senior Manager, Solutions Engineering  State, Local, Educational (sled) Small Cities
summary: Skydio is seeking a Senior Manager, Solutions Engineering leader to build and lead its SLED Small Cities technical team. The role owns technical wins, team hiring and development, customer demonstrations, site assessments, integrations, public-sector procurement support, and customer representation, with approximately 30% travel required.
description:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from  utility inspectors  to  first responders , soldiers in battlefield scenarios , and  beyond .
  About the Role: 
 Skydio is seeking an experienced Solutions Engineering leader to join our team as Senior Manager, Solutions Engineering for SLED Small Cities. The motion is transactional and high volume, coverage runs at one Solutions Engineer to two Key Account Leaders, and the agencies are small enough that a single well-run demonstration often decides the outcome.
 This is a remote role. Travel of approximately 30% is required to support customer engagements, field activities, deployments, team onsites, and company events.
 This role reports to the Director, Solutions Engineering – SLED.
  About the Team: 
 The SLED Solutions Engineering team is the technical arm of Skydio's state and local go-to-market motion. We sit between the agency and the product: turning operational problems into program designs, proving capability in the field, and making sure Skydio's products are used, integrated, and flown at scale.
 The team is measured on technical win rate, trial and proof of concept outcomes, program expansion, site assessment quality, and the requirements we push back into the product organization.
 Solutions Engineers are critical members of the Skydio organization and work closely with Key Account Leaders, Engineering, and Product to support deal progression, customer confidence, successful deployments, and the long-term success of Public Safety sUAS programs.
  How You’ll Make an Impact: 
  Lead the team 
   Hire, onboard, coach, and retain your team, with clear ownership and coverage across the territories in your segment, and develop people beyond the seat they are in.

  Set the bar for technical quality — demos, trial plans, site assessments, and customer-facing documentation that hold up in front of a chief, a sheriff, or a city council.

  Own capacity across your segment. Decide where Solutions Engineering time goes, say no when it needs to be said, and make the tradeoffs visible to leadership.

   Drive technical wins 
   Own the technical win across a two to one coverage model. Leverage is the job, and what cannot be templated, recorded, or reused will not scale here.

  Serve as the senior technical escalation point on critical pursuits, deployments, and customer issues. Jump in and work the problem yourself, and be in the field when it matters.

  Partner with Sales leadership on pipeline, forecast, and account planning, and on the land-and-expand motion that turns a first dock into a citywide program.

   Own the Small Cities problem set 
   Stand the team up. Most of the seats are open, the operating model does not exist yet, and much of the segment is carried by Inside Sales working remote first.

  Own site assessment quality as a performance measure. Solutions Engineers are the DRI for verifying a dock location before deployment, and the quality of the resulting installation reflects on the team.

  Hold the bar on proofs of concept: structured deployments tied to an active opportunity with measurable operational value, not casual evaluations.

  Guide integration and airspace strategy — CAD and dispatch, video and evidence management, streaming platforms, BVLOS approvals, waivers, COAs, and docked operations.

  Maintain command of the public sector procurement path, including cooperative contracts, grant funded programs, and public sector buying cycles.

   Represent the customer inside Skydio 
   Be the aggregated voice of the customer to Product and Engineering. Turn field observations into prioritized, defensible requirements rather than a list of one-off asks.

  Build the enablement content, reference architectures, and reusable technical assets that let the team scale, and maintain first-hand product knowledge through frequent hands-on use.

   What Makes You a Good Fit: 
   5+ years of relevant technical experience, including time in a customer-facing technical role (solutions engineering, field engineering, or applications engineering).

  1+ years leading a technical team, formally or as a technical lead with hiring and mentorship responsibility. First-time managers with a demonstrated record of leading and developing people will be considered.

  Strong understanding of drone technology, Public Safety sUAS operations, and regulatory compliance, including Drone as First Responder concepts of operation and dock based remote operations.

  Working knowledge of Public Safety technologies, including CAD, VMS, and related software platforms, and the ability to lead integration discussions.

  A track record of hiring, onboarding, and developing technical people, and of keeping them.

  Comfort operating inside a Sales organization, including owning a quota, deal strategy, and the judgment to know when to commit technical resources and when to decline.

  Excellent written and verbal communication. You can brief an operator, a program manager, and a senior executive without changing the facts.

  Lead by example. Willing to do whatever is needed to get a customer situation resolved.

   Nice to Have: 
   Prior public safety service as a sworn officer, firefighter, or agency UAS program lead.

  Experience standing up a Drone as First Responder program from waiver through go-live, and with dock-based, remote, and BVLOS operations at scale.

  Familiarity with grant funding pathways and cooperative purchasing vehicles used by state and local agencies.

  Working knowledge of Salesforce, Palantir, Databricks, or equivalents.

  Track record of building and scaling a technical team through a period of rapid growth.

   What Is Required: 
   Obtaining FAA Part 107 certification within the first 60 days of employment is strongly encouraged for all Skydio employees and required for certain positions

  Ability to travel approximately 30% of the time.

  Ability to lift up to 60 lbs unaided.

   Compensation:  At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full-time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. The annual base salary range for this position is $172,000 - 215,000* plus commission. Fundamentally, we believe that equity is the key to long-term financial growth, and we ensure all regular, full-time employees have the opportunity to significantly benefit from the company's success. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to enroll in the Company’s group health insurance plans. Regular, full-time employees are eligible to receive the following benefits: Paid vacation time, sick leave, holiday pay and 401K savings plan. This position and all associated benefits are subject to applicable federal, state, and local laws, as well as the Company’s policies and eligibility criteria.
 *Compensation for certain positions may vary based on the position’s location.

description:
Field Marketing Manager, US 
  Location:  Remote (US), Eastern time zone preferred
 Travel:  ~30% for conferences, dinners, and regional events

  About Haast 
 We're building one of the first agentic systems for enterprise legal and compliance teams that actually automates their manual work. End-to-end. Delivering 80% faster compliance reviews and 4x productivity gains.
 We recently closed a $12M USD Series A (Peak XV Partners, DST Global, Airtree) and are ramping hard; building the infrastructure that will completely re-define how enterprises think about compliance.
 Think Canva for design. Atlassian for projects. Haast for compliance.
  Why This Role Exists 
 As Haast enters the US market after building traction in Australia, we know buyers don't find us by accident. They see us at the right conference. They get pulled into the right campaign. They hear from a rep with the right message at the right moment. All of that has to come together for a fast moving financial services buyer to actually pick Haast.
 This role owns that work end to end: events, campaigns, ABM, digital activation, email, and the enablement that gets sales the tools and timing they need.

title: Product Marketing Manager, Advertising
summary: The Product Marketing Manager, Advertising will use advertiser insights, market analysis, and product knowledge to shape positioning, support product priorities, and execute go-to-market initiatives. Responsibilities include developing messaging, coordinating product launches, creating advertiser-facing and sales enablement content, tracking adoption metrics, and partnering cross-functionally to address risks and improve customer outcomes.
description:
About the team 
 OpenAI’s mission is to ensure the responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence. In support of that mission, the Marketing team helps deeply understand customer audiences and market dynamics, influence the development of the right products, build sustainable and customer-aligned monetization models, and drive awareness, adoption, and usage across OpenAI’s products and platform.
 We take a data-driven approach to understand markets, develop monetization strategies, and uncover customer needs that shape product strategy and messaging. We partner closely with Sales, Partnerships, Product, Engineering, Research, Comms, and Design to deliver a cohesive end-to-end customer experience and lead go-to-market efforts for new product launches across channels.
 About the role
 We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager, Advertising to help bring together advertiser insights, market understanding, and product knowledge to inform positioning, support product priorities, and execute go-to-market initiatives that drive adoption and measurable business impact.
 You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Partnerships to understand advertiser needs, translate complex AI capabilities into clear customer value, and bring new products and features to market. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong analytical thinking with hands-on execution, can independently drive clearly scoped workstreams, and is eager to grow their strategic ownership in a fast-moving environment.
 In this role, you will:
   Contribute to the product and marketing strategy for a defined area of OpenAI’s advertising business in partnership with senior product marketers and cross-functional partners.

  Build an understanding of advertisers through customer research, market analysis, and competitive insights, identifying opportunities to improve positioning, adoption, and the customer experience.

  Develop and maintain positioning and messaging for assigned products or features, translating complex capabilities into clear narratives for different advertiser audiences and use cases.

  Partner with Product and Engineering to synthesize advertiser feedback and market insights that inform roadmap discussions and product decisions.

  Execute go-to-market plans for new products and features, independently owning defined workstreams from planning through launch and post-launch adoption.

  Create advertiser-facing content and sales enablement materials, including product narratives, sales decks, one-pagers, FAQs, case studies, and launch communications.

  Partner with Sales, Partnerships, Data Science, and Analytics to track success metrics, assess launch and adoption performance, and recommend improvements.

  Identify advertiser concerns and launch risks related to performance, safety, policy, and trust, escalating them appropriately and incorporating guidance into customer communications.

  Coordinate cross-functional partners around deliverables, responsibilities, and timelines, proactively surfacing dependencies and resolving blockers within the scope of your initiatives.

  Contribute to repeatable approaches for launches, messaging, and enablement by documenting learnings, developing templates, and sharing effective practices with the broader team.

  You might be a great fit if you…
   Have experience contributing to product marketing strategies and bringing products, features, or programs to market, ideally in advertising, marketing technology, platforms, data, or AI.

  Have experience applying structured problem-solving approaches in product marketing, strategy or management consulting, investment banking, corporate strategy, venture capital, or a similarly analytical environment.

  Have familiarity with advertiser goals and the advertising ecosystem, including areas such as measurement, targeting and relevance, creative, auctions, and performance.

  Can synthesize customer research and market insights into clear positioning, actionable recommendations, and well-executed go-to-market programs.

  Communicate clearly and persuasively, translating technical concepts into accessible customer value for different audiences.

  Are comfortable using qualitative and quantitative evidence—including customer interviews, surveys, adoption data, and experiments—to support decisions and improve results.

  Bring structure and sound judgment to ambiguous problems, independently managing scoped initiatives while seeking input when priorities or tradeoffs are unclear.

  Build productive working relationships across Product, Engineering, Sales, Partnerships, and other teams, contributing to alignment without relying on formal authority.

  Are highly organized, attentive to detail, and comfortable managing multiple workstreams in a fast-moving environment.

  Enjoy learning from others, sharing insights, and helping improve how the team approaches launches, storytelling, and execution.

   About OpenAI 
 OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 
 We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

title: Product Marketing Manager
summary: The Product Marketing Manager will lead and support launches for new products, features, and platform capabilities, developing positioning, messaging, launch plans, and sales enablement materials. The role partners with Product, Engineering, Growth, Sales, and other teams while conducting customer, market, and competitive research to turn technical capabilities into clear customer value.
description:
Founded in 2012, Bugcrowd is the preemptive security platform that unifies exposure discovery and assessment, offensive testing, and intelligence shaped by AI and human insight to help organizations avoid, discover, and validate real-world risk. Bugcrowd helps security teams move faster by identifying the exposures that matter most so they can act first and stay ahead of attackers. By combining the power of humans and AI, teams can preempt attack paths and prevent breaches. Based in San Francisco and New Hampshire, Bugcrowd is supported by General Catalyst, Rally Ventures, Costanoa Ventures, and others. Visit www.bugcrowd.com.

Job Summary

The Product Marketing Manager plays a central role in how Bugcrowd brings new products, features, and platform capabilities to market. This role sits within the Marketing team and reports into Brand, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Growth, and Revenue teams to shape messaging, support launches, and turn technical depth into clear, credible stories for customers. It's a hands-on role for someone who can create clarity in ambiguity, bring structure to complex work, and move ideas from insight to execution. Success in this role requires strong judgment, thoughtful collaboration, and the ability to make complex ideas clear and compelling.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Own and support launches for new features, product updates, and select platform capabilities, including launch planning, audience definition, messaging development, and cross-functional coordination.
  • Develop messaging and evolve our positioning for assigned product areas, translating technical capabilities into clear customer value and distinct stories that resonate in the market.
  • Conduct customer and market research through interviews, win/loss analysis, competitive intelligence, community listening, and hands-on product exploration.
  • Create enablement materials for the Sales team, including launch briefs, battlecards, FAQs, pitch support, and internal guidance.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Design, Brand, Growth, Sales Enablement, and Customer Experience to keep initiatives moving from planning through launch.
  • Monitor competitive activity and market trends, and share insights that inform launch strategy, positioning, and broader product marketing recommendations.

Education, Experience, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • 3+ years of product marketing experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, or another technical category.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting product launches or major go-to-market initiatives from planning through execution.
  • Strong writing and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into clear, credible messaging for a range of audiences.
  • Ability to conduct and synthesize customer, product, and market research into actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Strong project management, prioritization, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to move work forward independently.
  • Experience marketing technical products, cybersecurity solutions, or offerings for highly regulated industries is preferred.

Working Conditions & Physical Requirements

The ideal candidate must be able to complete all physical requirements of the job with or without reasonable accommodation.

Sitting and / or standing - Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time

Carrying and / or lifting - Must be able to carry / move laptop as needed throughout the work day.

Environment - remote, work-from-home 100% of the time.

Pay Range Disclosure

The base pay range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to Qualifications, Geographical Location, Education/certifications, Experience, Skill Sets, Training, and other business and organizational needs. 

At Bugcrowd, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range for the position of Product Marketing Manager is: $83,200 - $110,000.

This position may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary bonus program or commission plan, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Culture

  • At Bugcrowd, we understand that diversity in the workplace is vital to a company’s success and growth. We strive to make sure that people are included and have a sense of being part of making Bugcrowd not only a great product but a great place to work.
  • We regularly hear from both customers and researchers that Bugcrowd feels like a family, and we strive to maintain that internally as well.
  • Our team consists of a broad range of people: musicians, adventure sports junkies, nature lovers, parents, cereal enthusiasts, night owls, cyclists, artists—you get the point.

At Bugcrowd, we are solving security threats and vulnerabilities that are relevant to everyone, therefore we believe solving these problems takes all kinds of backgrounds. We value the perspectives and experiences people from underrepresented backgrounds bring.

Disclaimer

This position has access to highly confidential, sensitive information relating to the technologies of Bugcrowd. It is essential that the applicant possess the requisite integrity to maintain the information in the strictest confidence.

The company is authorized to obtain background checks for employment purposes under state and federal law. Background checks will be conducted for positions that involve access to confidential or proprietary information (including trade secrets).

Background checks may include Social Security verification, prior employment verification, personal and professional references, educational verification, and criminal history. Applicants with conviction histories will not be excluded from consideration to the extent required by law.

Any personal data you submit in connection with your application will be processed in compliance with Bugcrowd's Privacy Policy, which you may review here: https://www.bugcrowd.com/privacy.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Bugcrowd is EOE, Disability/Age Employer. 

Individuals seeking employment at Bugcrowd are considered without regards to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. 

Bugcrowd is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. In keeping with our commitment, Bugcrowd will take the steps to assure that people with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. Accordingly, if reasonable accommodation is required to fully participate in the job application or interview process, to perform the essential functions of the position, and/or to receive all other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact HR at ADA at bugcrowd.com.

Apply at: https://www.bugcrowd.com/about/careers/

title: Marketing Communications Manager
summary: The Marketing Communications Manager will develop and execute integrated marketing communications programs that strengthen brand visibility, generate demand, and support business priorities. Responsibilities include campaign strategy and execution, content development, marketing automation and lead nurturing, event planning, stakeholder coordination, budget and agency management, and performance measurement.
description:
Company Description
  Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. 
  The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in agroscience Contract Research Organisation services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. 
  In over 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 58,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of 900 laboratories in over 54 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products. 
 Job Description
 The Marketing Communications Manager will lead the development and execution of integrated marketing communications programs that advance business priorities, strengthen brand visibility, and generate measurable demand. Reporting to the Marketing Director, this hands-on role will partner closely with marketing colleagues, sales, operations, technical subject matter experts, agencies, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate complex capabilities into clear, compelling campaigns, content, and sales tools. The successful candidate will bring strong strategic thinking, hands-on execution, and a proven ability to influence across teams without direct authority.
  Summary of Key Skills 
  Integrated marketing communications strategy and campaign execution
 Demand generation, lead nurturing, and campaign performance optimization
 Clear, persuasive writing for technical, B2B, and audience-specific messaging
 Problem solving, sound judgment, attention to detail, and adaptability in a fast-paced environment
 Cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder influence without direct authority
 Project management, budget oversight, vendor coordination, and deadline accountability
 Marketing automation, CRM, analytics, and KPI reporting

  Develop and execute integrated marketing communications strategies, campaigns, and lead the annual medical device services marketing plan process aligned to business objectives, audience needs, and growth priorities.
 Lead campaign planning from strategy through execution, including value proposition development, creative briefs, messaging, content mapping, activation plans, and performance measurement.
 Create, edit, and manage high-impact content across channels, including web pages, email campaigns, paid media, sales enablement materials, thought leadership assets, presentations, social media, webinars, and event materials.
 Partner with marketing colleagues, sales, technical SMEs, leadership, agencies, and external vendors to ensure cohesive messaging, strong execution, and alignment across target audience touchpoints.
 Manage marketing automation, email marketing, lead nurturing, inbound lead processes, and lead scoring in partnership with sales and digital teams.
 Plan and execute tradeshows, events, webinars, and promotional campaigns, including messaging, graphics, schedules, speaker coordination, and post-event follow-up in coordination with the marketing tradeshow specialist.
 Own campaign performance tracking, KPI reporting, budget management, and optimization recommendations to improve engagement, lead generation, and marketing effectiveness.
 Uphold brand standards and ensure consistent, compelling messaging across all marketing materials, digital channels in partnership with the marketing digital specialist, sales tools, and external communications.
 Manage agency relationships, project timelines, deliverables, and budgets to ensure work is completed on time, on brand, and aligned to business goals.
  Qualifications
  The Ideal Candidate 
    Has 8 to 10 years of progressive marketing communications experience, preferably in a B2B, technical, scientific, life sciences, medical device, biopharma, or regulated industry environment.
 Brings a proven track record of developing campaigns that drive measurable engagement, demand generation, and qualified lead growth.
 Combines strategic thinking with strong execution, moving confidently from planning and messaging through activation, measurement, and optimization.
 Is a resourceful problem solver who can navigate ambiguity, remove barriers, and keep complex projects moving forward.
 Influences effectively without authority by building trust, aligning stakeholders, and communicating recommendations with clarity and confidence.
 Writes clearly and persuasively, with the ability to translate complex technical information into audience-focused marketing messages.
 Works well in a collaborative, fast-paced environment while maintaining strong organization, attention to detail, and accountability for deadlines.
 
   Education and Experience 
  Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, journalism, public relations, business, or a related field required.
 8 to 10 years of experience in marketing communications, campaign management, demand generation, content marketing, or a related marketing role required.
 Demonstrated experience with Adobe Creative Cloud, Canva, CRMs, and marketing automation platforms
 Experience in life sciences, medical device, biopharma, laboratory services, healthcare, manufacturing, technology, or another technical B2B environment preferred.
 Experience managing agencies, vendors, budgets, and cross-functional marketing projects.
  Additional Information
 The position is full-time, Monday-Friday, 8:00am-5:00pm, with overtime as needed. Location: East Coast & Midwest — Boston, MA; Lancaster, PA; Jacksonville, FL; St. Louis, MO; Remote options available
  Excellent full time benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options
 Life and disability insurance
 401(k) with company match
 Paid vacation and holidays

title: Technical Solutions Consultant (pre-sales)
summary: Blockstream is seeking a Technical Solutions Consultant (Pre-Sales) to help financial institutions evaluate, design, and adopt enterprise software solutions. The role involves technical discovery, solution architecture, demonstrations, Proofs of Concept, RFP support, and serving as a trusted technical advisor while collaborating with sales, product, engineering, security, delivery, and consulting teams.
description:
Blockstream   was founded in 2014 by   Dr. Adam Back   and a group of fellow cryptographers and engineers passionate about Bitcoin and its potential to change the future of finance. We have become a market leader in Bitcoin security and Layer-2 technologies. Our products are designed to make financial systems more efficient, secure, and robust.
 We are seeking a  Technical Solutions Consultant (Pre-Sales) , a customer-facing technical expert responsible for helping financial institutions evaluate, design, and adopt Blockstream's enterprise software solutions.
 Operating within the Consulting Services organization, the Solutions Engineer partners closely with Enterprise Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Delivery teams to support the customer journey from technical discovery and solution architecture through product demonstrations, Proof of Concepts (PoCs), and technical validation.
 This is not a traditional pre-sales role. You will spend significant time working directly with customers, often onsite, understanding their business, technical, and regulatory requirements, designing enterprise-grade solutions, and acting as a trusted technical advisor throughout the sales cycle. You will help financial institutions understand how Blockstream's products solve complex business challenges while ensuring proposed solutions are scalable, practical, and aligned with customer needs.

  What You'll Be Doing (Responsibilities): 

  Customer Engagement & Technical Sales 
   Partner with Enterprise Sales to support strategic opportunities across financial institutions.

  Lead technical discovery workshops to understand customers' business, operational, regulatory, and technical requirements.

  Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders, including CIOs, CTOs, Enterprise Architects, Operations, and Engineering teams.

  Deliver compelling product demonstrations, technical presentations, and solution walkthroughs.

  Support Proof of Concepts (PoCs), solution validation activities, and technical evaluations.

  Serve as the primary technical advisor throughout the sales process.

   Solution Design & Architecture 
   Design end-to-end solution architectures leveraging Blockstream's enterprise software products.

  Translate customer requirements into scalable technical solutions and implementation approaches.

  Define solution assumptions, integration approaches, deployment models, and technical dependencies.

  Collaborate with customers to identify implementation risks and recommend best practices.

   Commercial & Deal Support 
   Lead or contribute to responses for RFPs, RFIs, technical questionnaires, and security assessments.

  Support commercial discussions by providing technical expertise and solution positioning.

  Help package Blockstream products into repeatable enterprise offerings, demonstrations, and implementation approaches.

  Clearly communicate the value proposition and differentiators of Blockstream's products.

   Cross-Functional Collaboration 
   Partner with Product Management, Engineering, Security, Delivery, and Consulting teams.

  Feed customer and market feedback back to Product Management.

  Help improve demos, technical collateral, reference architectures, and solution playbooks.

  Contribute to repeatable implementation methodologies and sales enablement materials.

   5-8 years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, Technical Consulting, or Enterprise Software Pre-Sales.

  Experience supporting enterprise software sales within banking, financial services, fintech, or technology infrastructure environments.

  Strong understanding of enterprise software architecture, APIs, integration patterns, cloud technologies, and modern software deployment models.

  Experience designing end-to-end enterprise solutions for complex customer environments.

  Strong presentation, communication, and storytelling skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both business and technical audiences.

  Experience delivering customer workshops, technical demonstrations, and executive presentations.

  Experience supporting RFPs, RFIs, technical proposals, and solution validation.

  Ability to work collaboratively across Enterprise Sales, Product, Engineering, Consulting, and Delivery teams.

  Self-starter with proven ability to manage multiple customer engagements while delivering a high-quality customer experience.

  Willingness to travel regularly to customer locations.

   Languages: 
   Excellent English skills required.

   Location: 
   New York (Remote)

  Background in blockchain, Bitcoin, digital assets, tokenization, or fintech.

  Knowledge of core banking platforms, financial market infrastructure, or enterprise integration technologies.

  Familiarity with Layer-2 technologies and digital asset infrastructure.

  Experience in enterprise software organizations serving regulated industries.

  Track record of feeding customer and market feedback into product strategy.
