summary: Blend360 is seeking a Senior Director, Ad Tech Solutions to serve as the technical bridge between enterprise partners, sales teams, and data monetization product and technical organizations. The role leads technical discovery and solutioning, supports senior client conversations, translates complex ad tech capabilities into business solutions, and coordinates cross-functional experts. It also owns sales and partner enablement materials, including FAQs, training content, technical documentation, match-test results, and solution summaries.
description:
Company Description
 At  Blend360 , we help organizations transform complex data into actionable insights through modern cloud platforms, advanced analytics, and AI-driven solutions. We partner with leading enterprises across healthcare, telecommunications, financial services, and retail to build scalable, high-impact data ecosystems that drive smarter business decisions. 
 Job Description
 Blend360 is leading a zero-to-one data monetization platform build and launch for a major US-based telecommunications company. Our team is responsible for the build, delivery, and commercialization of every aspect of the platform, from AI-driven intelligence to product development and go-to-market motions. 
 Blend360 is looking for a Senior Director, Ad Tech Solutions to serve as the technical bridge between our enterprise partners, sales teams, and the data monetization product and technical organization. This is a highly visible, customer-facing role for someone who understands the ad tech and martech ecosystem, can navigate complex enterprise conversations, and knows how to translate technical capabilities into solutions that solve real business problems. 
 You’ll be the go-to technical partner throughout the sales process—working alongside sales to understand opportunities, solution data monetization products and capabilities against client needs, and bring the right technical experts into the conversation at the right time. You’ll participate directly in enterprise partner calls, help shape solution strategy, and ensure clients have a clear understanding of what the data monetization  platform can do, how it works, and how it can create value for their business. 
 Just as importantly, you’ll own the documentation and enablement that supports the commercial organization. From FAQs and training materials to match-test results and technical solution summaries, you’ll turn complex product and technical information into clear, useful resources that sales teams and partners can actually use. You’ll work across Product, Testing, Integrations, Identity, and other technical teams to bring the right expertise together and keep everyone aligned. 
 This is a role for a strategic, technically credible relationship builder who is equally comfortable whiteboarding a solution with an internal technical team, answering questions on an enterprise partner call, and helping a sales leader position a solution for a major opportunity. 
 What You’ll Do 
   Serve as the primary technical liaison between enterprise client teams, Sales, and Latis product and technical experts. 

    Partner with Sales to understand client challenges and solution data monetization products, capabilities, and data against active sales opportunities. 

    Lead technical discovery and solutioning conversations with prospective and existing enterprise partners. 

    Participate in and support senior-level client and partner calls, providing technical expertise, answering questions, and helping move opportunities forward. 

    Translate complex technical capabilities into clear, partner-ready solutions, stories, and recommendations. 

    Coordinate across Product, Testing, Integrations, Identity, Data, and other subject-matter experts to bring the right people and capabilities into each opportunity. 

    Own the creation and ongoing development of sales and partner enablement materials, including FAQs, training content, technical documentation, match-test results, and solution summaries. 

    Help sales teams understand how to position data monetization capabilities, anticipate technical questions, and navigate enterprise client conversations. 

    Partner with internal teams to ensure proposed solutions are technically sound, clearly documented, and aligned with what data monetization can deliver. 

    Identify recurring client questions, objections, and technical needs and translate them into opportunities to improve product documentation, enablement, and the overall sales motion. 

    Bring structure and clarity to complex opportunities where requirements, stakeholders, and technical considerations may be evolving. 

    Act as a trusted technical advisor to both internal stakeholders and enterprise partners throughout the sales and solutioning lifecycle. 

  Qualifications
   10+ years of relevant experience in ad tech, martech, data platforms, marketing technology, or a closely related field. 

    Significant experience in customer-facing technical roles, such as Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Technical Consulting, Solutions Architecture, or a similar function. 

    Deep familiarity with the ad tech and/or martech ecosystem, including the data, identity, audience, measurement, and technology layers that support modern advertising. 

    The ability to take a complex technical capability and translate it into a practical solution tied to a client's business needs. 

    Strong enterprise presence and experience working directly with senior client and partner stakeholders. 

    Demonstrated ability to support complex sales opportunities, from discovery and solution design through technical validation and close. 

  Additional Information
 The starting pay range for this role is $230,000- $260,000. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent on several factors including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, certifications, training, and location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range and determining factors for compensation are considered for each individual circumstance. BLEND360 also offers a competitive benefits program to meet the health and financial well-being of our team and their families. You can look forward to a range of benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401K, PTO, paid holidays, commuter benefits, spending accounts, life insurance, disability coverage, and EAPs.

title: Marketing Enablement Manager
summary: The Marketing Enablement & Project Manager supports North American marketing services and practice development by bringing marketing capabilities and solutions to market, creating sales enablement materials, and coordinating cross-functional projects. The role manages projects from initiation through completion, supports go-to-market and governance processes, prepares leadership communications, and partners with teams across marketing, sales, product, legal, risk, and analytics.
description:
Company Description
 Blend is a premier AI services provider, committed to co-creating meaningful impact for its clients through the power of data science, AI, technology, and people. With a mission to fuel bold visions, Blend tackles significant challenges by seamlessly aligning human expertise with artificial intelligence. The company is dedicated to unlocking value and fostering innovation for its clients by harnessing world-class people and data-driven strategy. We believe that the power of people and AI can have a meaningful impact on your world, creating more fulfilling work and projects for our people and clients.
 Job Description
 Our client is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and execution-focused  Marketing Enablement & Project Manager  to support its North American Marketing Services and Practice Development team. This role is responsible for helping bring marketing capabilities and solutions to market, developing sales enablement materials, and coordinating cross-functional projects from concept through completion.
 The ideal candidate is a strong project manager and stakeholder partner who thrives in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities and multiple concurrent initiatives. You'll work closely with internal teams to connect the dots, drive projects forward, navigate approval processes, and ensure deliverables are completed on time.
 This is a highly collaborative, self-directed role that supports the broader marketing and business development organization. Success requires strong organizational skills, executive presence, excellent communication, and the ability to move seamlessly between strategic context and hands-on execution.
   The Details:  
  Location: Fully remote within the U.S.
 Duration: Approximately a 6-month consulting role through Blend with the possibility of extension (must be able to work on Blend’s W2 without sponsorship)
 Benefits: We do offer benefits to our full-time consultants, including Health, Vision, Dental, 401K plan, Life Insurance, Employee Assistance Programs, and an incredibly supportive team cheering you on!
    What you’ll do:  
  Marketing Enablement & Sales Support 
  Create and maintain sales enablement materials, presentations, one-pagers, training resources, and other materials that help frontline sales teams communicate marketing services, products, and capabilities.
 Develop educational content that translates new offerings and complex marketing solutions into clear, compelling, and actionable messaging.
 Support the creation of business development presentations, executive-level decks, and materials used to communicate value propositions and business outcomes.
 Partner with internal stakeholders to prepare sales teams for new product launches, capabilities, and service offerings.
 Help develop and organize training materials that enable internal teams to effectively position and sell new solutions.
   Project & Stakeholder Management 
  Own projects from initiation through completion, ensuring deliverables, timelines, and stakeholder expectations remain aligned.
 Manage multiple initiatives simultaneously while navigating changing priorities and requests from leadership.
 Develop project plans, coordinate milestones, track progress, and proactively identify risks, dependencies, and potential roadblocks.
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather information, resolve challenges, and drive projects across the finish line.
 Facilitate communication and follow-up among stakeholders, ensuring accountability and momentum throughout the project lifecycle.
 Take initiative to identify what needs to be done, determine the appropriate next steps, and move work forward with minimal oversight.
   Marketing Capabilities & Go-to-Market Support 
  Support the development and commercialization of new marketing capabilities, products, and service offerings.
 Coordinate cross-functional activities required to bring new capabilities to market, including internal review, approval, and readiness processes.
 Partner with privacy, legal, risk, and other relevant stakeholders to help navigate governance and approval requirements.
 Connect the dots across teams, processes, and deliverables to support the successful launch of new marketing solutions.
 Assist with the development of repeatable processes, materials, and frameworks that support broader team enablement and solution delivery.
 Support marketing initiatives related to customer acquisition, engagement, retention, and lifecycle marketing.
   Leadership Communication & Business Support 
  Prepare updates, presentations, and progress reports for leadership and other internal stakeholders.
 Present project updates and materials to leadership with confidence, clarity, and professionalism.
 Respond effectively to ad hoc requests and shifting business needs while maintaining organization and attention to detail.
 Build strong working relationships across marketing, sales, product, risk, legal, creative, analytics, and other partner teams.
 Leverage AI-enabled productivity tools, such as Microsoft Copilot or similar solutions, to improve efficiency, support content development, and streamline workflows.
  Qualifications
  Required Qualifications 
  5+ years of experience in marketing, marketing enablement, product marketing, project management, consulting, financial services marketing, agency account management, or a related field.
 Demonstrated experience managing projects from start to finish, including planning, coordination, execution, and delivery.
 Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with individuals across different teams and levels of an organization.
 Experience developing high-quality PowerPoint presentations, sales enablement materials, training resources, and executive-level communications.
 Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and changing priorities simultaneously.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
 Ability to work independently, take ownership of deliverables, and proactively identify solutions to move projects forward.
 Comfortable presenting to leadership and communicating project updates, recommendations, and key information with executive presence.
 Strong attention to detail and the ability to translate complex information into clear, accessible materials.
   Preferred Qualifications 
  Experience in financial services, banking, payments, fintech, or marketing technology.
 Background in lifecycle marketing, customer acquisition, direct marketing, audience targeting, or campaign strategy.
 Experience supporting sales enablement, product launches, go-to-market initiatives, or marketing capability development.
 Familiarity with privacy, legal, compliance, risk, or governance approval processes.
 Experience developing marketing strategies, business development presentations, or materials designed to support revenue growth.
 Prior experience working with large financial services organizations or payments companies.
 Experience using AI-powered productivity tools, including Microsoft Copilot or similar technologies, to support marketing and project execution.
  Additional Information
  The pay range for this role is $60-65 per hour. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent on several factors including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, certifications, training, and location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range and determining factors for compensation are considered for each individual circumstance. BLEND360 also offers a competitive benefits program to meet the health and financial well-being of our team and their families. You can look forward to a range of benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401K, PTO, commuter benefits, spending accounts, life insurance, disability coverage, and EAPs. 
  A diverse workforce is a strong workforce 
To deliver growth at BLEND360 and for our clients, we believe as a Talent Solutions Company, we have a responsibility and unique opportunity to positively impact the workforce. Diversity has played a critical role in our history, our growth, and continues to have a profound impact on our success.  We are determined to have equality in the workplace, within our team and as an extension of our clients’ team.
  BLEND360 is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Head of Product Marketing (senior)

Responsibilities include developing positioning and launch narratives, creating content and sales enablement materials, collaborating cross-functionally, directing video and content strategy, and using market and customer insights to optimize messaging.
description:

You will partner with GTM leadership, product, engineering, and sales to translate complex technology into clear value, while setting direction and coordinating external agencies to execute.

title: Customer Success Lead
summary: The Customer Success Lead serves as an escalation point for customer support agents, handling complex and sensitive cases and advocating for customers across support tickets and public channels. The role also improves support quality and processes through trend analysis, agent training, documentation, Help Center content, and contributions to customer success projects.
description:
About Us: 
 Monarch is a powerful, all-in-one personal finance platform designed to help make the complexity of finances feel simple again. Since launching in 2021, we've become the top-recommended personal finance app by users and experts. Our goal? To take the stress out of finances so our members can focus on what truly matters.
 We are a team of do-ers led by experienced entrepreneurs who are passionate about helping our members reach their financial goals. We're hyper focused on building a product people love, and on finding every edge that helps us do that better. AI is core to how we operate: every person on the team uses it as a partner to sharpen judgment, move faster, and expand what's possible. We're not looking for tool mastery, we're looking for fluency and curiosity. What matters is that AI is part of how you work today and that you're actively raising your own bar on how to use it well.
 As a fully remote company (even before COVID!), we welcome applicants from almost anywhere. Our team collaborates synchronously mostly from 9 AM – 2 PM PT and embraces asynchronous work to stay connected across time zones.
 Join us on our mission to transform lives by  simplifying money, together. 
  The Role 
 As a Customer Success Lead, you'll be the escalation point and source of expertise for the agents handling our customer tickets. You'll proactively step in on our most complex and sensitive customer conversations, and drive improvements through training, documentation, and process work across CS. The ideal candidate brings strong communication skills, a customer-first mindset, and an eye for the patterns behind individual tickets.
  What You'll Do 
  Escalations and customer advocacy 
   Triage agent escalations, resolving or routing as appropriate and coaching agents in the process

  Communicate directly with customers on complex or sensitive cases requiring specialized support

  Own customer issues that reach us publicly rather than through a support ticket, including app store reviews, community forums, and social channels

   Agent enablement and process improvement 
   Audit ticket queues to flag QA issues, process inefficiencies, and tickets requiring escalation

  Surface emergent trends that require a broader solution, with the context needed to act on them

  Engage in training for new agent cohorts and ongoing enablement for the existing team

  Create and maintain internal documentation, process guides, and training materials that help agents resolve more on their own

  Own accuracy and clarity of customer-facing Help Center content

  Take on scoped pieces of CS department projects, from process changes to improvements in the team's internal tooling

   What You'll Bring 
   3+ years in customer-facing support roles, at least 2 of which included email/async support for an online consumer product (B2C SaaS)

  Clear written communication, with the ability to effectively write help articles, training materials, or de-escalation emails

  Excellent customer instincts and strong de-escalation skills, including those surfaced from public view (app store reviews and community forums)

  Self-direction in a remote, async environment; takes action where needed and flags early when stuck

  Ownership beyond ticket scope, with the ability to identify emergent support trends and propose improvements to QA, training, or content

   Nice to Haves 
   Personal finance (PFM) knowledge

  Experience supporting a subscription-based consumer app, including billing, account, renewal, and cancellation questions

  Experience with AI-assisted support tooling and workflow automation

  Experience contributing to a formal agent training, onboarding, or QA program

   Typical Process 
   Recruiter Video Call

  Hiring Manager Video Call

  Virtual "Onsite" (2 rounds)

  Take Home Assignment

  Final Interview

  Reference Checks

  Offer!

   Benefits : 
   Work wherever you want! As a  fully  remote company with no central office, we want you to work wherever you are happiest and most productive. Whether that’s out of your home, a co-working space, or elsewhere.

  Competitive cash and equity compensation in a hyper growth, early stage company 🚀.

  Stipend to set-up your ideal working environment.

  Competitive Benefit Plans for employees based on your location (e.g. in the US we offer: Medical, dental and vision benefits and the ability to contribute to a 401k plan).

  Unlimited PTO.

  3 day weekend every month! We take off the “First Friday” every month to focus on rest, recuperation, or just having fun!

   Equal Opportunity & Non-Discrimination 
 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy and gender identity), sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or genetic information.
  Applicant Notices 
  California & San Francisco:  Pursuant to the California Fair Chance Act and the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment. We comply with all applicable fair chance hiring laws.

 Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours.  Experian is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer for all groups protected under applicable federal, state and local law, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.
  Benefits/Perks:

description:

Founded by former National Security Agency (NSA) cyber operations experts who applied their learnings to bring national security-grade technology solutions to commercial customers around the world, Blackpoint Cyber is in hyper-growth mode,  fueled by a recent $190m series C round. 
  The Role: 
 We are looking for a  Support Engineer III  with experience in software technical support, particularly in environments utilizing Zendesk automation and complex software workflows. This is a hybrid role: you'll provide expert-level technical assistance to our customers while also building and optimizing the automation and processes that power our support operations.
 You will be responsible for handling complex issues escalated from Tier 1 and Tier 2 teams, requiring a deep understanding of our software, underlying microservices, and support tools. If you're passionate about delivering exceptional customer service, solving intricate technical problems, and are skilled in support automation, we want you on our team.
 
 Responsibilities and Expectations:

   5+ years of experience in a Technical Support or Customer Support role, with a focus on complex software environments.

  Blackpoint Cyber welcomes and encourages applications from qualified individuals of all races, colors, religions, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, marital status, or any other legally protected status. We are committed to equality of opportunity in all aspects of employment.

title: Senior Data Engineer - Analytics
summary: The Senior Data Engineer (Analytics) turns healthcare operational data into certified dimensional models, governed metrics, and business-ready reporting. The role owns analytics models and definitions, Power BI dashboards and reports, data quality and observability, orchestration, documentation, and AI-assisted workflows, working closely with business stakeholders.
description:
Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering unmatched value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country. Deployed by over 85 health plans, including many of the top 20, and representing more than 270 million lives, Machinify brings together a fully configurable and content-rich, AI-powered platform along with best-in-class expertise. We’re constantly reimagining what’s possible in our industry, creating disruptively simple, powerfully clear ways to maximize financial outcomes and drive down healthcare costs.

As a Senior Data Engineer (Analytics) you own the layer where messy operational data becomes a number a business leader will act on. You’ll sit with the people who run our business, learn how the work actually happens, and turn that into certified models, metric definitions that survive scrutiny, and reports people use. Our analytics warehouse unifies four platforms into one measurement model across dozens of unique client workflows.

This is a data modeling and measurement enabling role more than a pipeline development role, though such skills will be helpful. Expect real time on calls with finance, operations, and client-facing teams, and real time in dbt, SQL, and Power BI. If you won’t ship a dashboard you can’t reconcile, you’ll fit in great.

What You’ll Do

  • Run discovery with business stakeholders. Find the real need behind the request and turn it into acceptance criteria you can build against.
  • Model noisy healthcare operational data into certified dimensional models across our Databricks bronze → silver → gold architecture in dbt and SQL. Our sources disagree with each other in ways that are interesting rather than trivial. Sorting that out is most of the job.
  • Own metric definitions. One measure, one definition, one place, documented so a non-engineer can read it. Today a single operating metric can be re-derived in a dozen models; collapsing that into a governed semantic layer is yours.
  • Build and own the visualization layer. Power BI semantic models, dashboards, and paginated reports, including refresh health and semantic-model currency. We want real visualization judgment: the right chart for the question, a hierarchy an executive can read in ten seconds, and a reason for every choice.
  • Own observability for your models. Freshness and latency detection, statistical anomaly detection, and value-drift monitoring, plus the data tests, regression guards, and CI checks that keep a defect you just fixed from coming back.
  • Own orchestration for what you build. dbt Cloud job design, Airflow DAGs, scheduling, dependency ordering, dependable incremental runs.
  • Write it down. Design documents, model documentation, a CI-enforced knowledge base, and business-readable handoff packets, so whoever inherits your work doesn’t have to re-derive it.
  • Automate the recurring work. We codify repeating work into repeatable, testable, AI-assisted workflows instead of checklists in someone’s notes. You should be comfortable directing LLMs and supervising what they produce.

What You Bring

  • 6+ years across analytics engineering, BI engineering, data engineering, or business analysis, with production ownership of the models and metrics you built.
  • Expert SQL and strong dimensional modeling instincts. You spot a grain mismatch in someone else’s model before you run it.
  • Production dbt: models, tests, macros, exposures, documentation, and CI. You have opinions about project structure and can defend them.
  • Hands-on with a cloud lakehouse or warehouse. Databricks and Spark SQL preferred; Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift transfer well.
  • Real visualization talent. You’ve owned a BI semantic layer and the reports on top of it, not just the tables underneath. Power BI and DAX strongly preferred; Looker/LookML, Tableau, MetricFlow, or Cube are credible substitutes. Bring dashboards you designed and be ready to say what you left out.
  • Stakeholder fluency. You can run a requirements conversation with a non-technical owner, turn a vague complaint into a testable definition, explain a data problem as business risk, and tell someone their metric is wrong without losing them.
  • A reconciliation reflex. When two numbers disagree you don’t average them, escalate them, or trust the newer one. You find out why.
  • Git and pull-request discipline as normal practice rather than overhead.
  • Python where it’s genuinely the right tool (API calls, file parsing, statistics, report generation), and the judgment to reach for SQL where it isn’t.
  • Comfort with high autonomy in a fast, async, Slack-first environment. You decide inside your lane and inform, rather than queuing decisions for permission.
  • Strong writing. Much of your impact is a document, a definition, or a chart someone reads without you in the room.

Bonus points for

  • Healthcare data: claims (837/835/UB04), DRG and coding review, payment integrity, provider contracts, or revenue cycle.

title: Senior Market Development Manager- Gi And Endo-surgical Innovation
summary: The Senior Market Development Manager leads commercial strategy for GI and endosurgical innovations from product development through early commercialization. Responsibilities include validating product-market fit, shaping go-to-market and market-creation strategies, building stakeholder relationships, informing product and clinical roadmaps, and developing launch plans covering market access, pricing, sales structure, and territories.
description:
Company Description
 It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at  Intuitive . As a global leader in  robotic-assisted surgery  and  minimally invasive care , our technologies—like the  da Vinci surgical system  and  Ion —have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.
 We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.
 The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.
 If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help  transform the future of healthcare , you’ll find your purpose here.
 Job Description
  Primary Function of Position  
 The Senior Market Development Manager is a market-facing commercial leader for  new indications, customer bases, markets and platforms  — operating across the full spectrum from product development through early commercialization. This role builds early go-to-market strategy, validates product market fit, ensures the commercial perspective informs upstream decisions, and builds the market infrastructure required for successful future Intuitive launches.   This individual will focus on GI and endosurgical innovation. 
 This role is deeply integrated with  engineering, product, clinical, regulatory, market access and corporate strategy teams  in both existing business units and future forward— serving as the commercial anchor in cross-functional forums and embedding market insight into product, clinical evidence, and market access roadmaps. Success requires equal fluency and trust in the external market and the internal development cycle.
 The Senior Market Development Manager works directly with  physicians, hospital executives, payers, and societies  to identify unmet needs and shape clinical and commercial strategy. Where markets must be created rather than captured, this role is tasked with designing strategies to shift  patient pathways, referral patterns, and clinical beliefs  to unlock demand and accelerate commercial success.
  Essential Job Duties  (Specific responsibilities and tasks an individual would be expected to perform in the role. Additional job duties may be determined by functional people manager)
   Serve as market-facing commercial lead throughout the upstream development cycle; bring commercial guidance to inform strategy and optimize launch success

  Refine product market fit with market insight

  Generate deep market, customer, and clinical insights; translate into actionable product and commercial recommendations aligned with the largest unmet clinical needs

  Partner with engineering, product, clinical, and corporate strategy teams to define and execute go-to-market strategy from product development through early commercialization; serve as the commercial anchor in cross-functional forums and influence product roadmap and prioritization

  Identify and engage KOLs, society leadership, and key stakeholders to shape market entry, build pre-market advocacy, and market seeding priming early adoption

  Support clinical and economic evidence-building to enable market access, value articulation, and regulatory/ reimbursement strategy; support transfer into ROI and economic value models

  Understand existing commercial strategy and ways of working across Intuitive- find opportunities to leverage existing expertise to accelerate adoption in new domains.

  Develop market creation strategies where skillsets are not transferable— design approaches to change patient referral pathways, shift clinical beliefs and behaviors, and build demand in spaces where historic strategic success may be less transferable

  Originate and develop creative market entry strategies for new clinical spaces — write the playbook for indications where no established commercial model exists

  Synthesize complex inputs into clear strategic recommendations for senior leadership

  Develop commercialization strategy for new indications, including salesforce structure, go-to-market model, pricing, territory design, and sales incentive plan frameworks

  Qualifications
  Required Skills and Experience: 
   10 years of experience in Sales, Marketing, Strategy, or Market Development in MedTech

  Prior leadership experience required, including direct or matrixed leadership

  Demonstrated success operating in early-stage, ambiguous, or emerging market environments

  Capacity to rapidly upskill in clinical and technical knowledge base

  Experience building and executing go to market/ market creation strategy

  Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams without formal authority

  Experience building and leveraging KOL, society, and executive-level relationships

  Strong analytical, communication and executive presentation skills

  Ability to identify trends, distill themes, and translate customer preference to strategic priorities

  Familiarity with clinical pathways, hospital economics, capital strategy, and enterprise decision-making

   Required Education and Training: 
   Bachelor’s degree required

   Working Conditions: 
   Global travel required

   Preferred Skills and Experience: 
   GI experience

  Exposure to early product development, market shaping, or pre-launch commercialization working with engineers

  Experience with surgical and/or endoscopic procedures preferred

  Strategic clinical and reimbursement experience; payer fluency

  Global or international experience

  • Executive Engagement: Ability to consult, influence, and drive decision-making with senior leadership and executives. Strong initiative-taking and project ownership skills.
  • Exceptional Collaboration: Ability to effectively partner with Product Management, Technical Enablement Teams, Operations, and Technical Leadership to bridge the gap between "product built" and "product supported/sold."

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Technical Field Expertise: Demonstrated experience supporting, enabling, or working directly with technical sales, architecture, professional services, or technical support teams.
  • Architectural Fluency: Strong understanding of how to translate technical product specs and "how-it-works" logic into field-consumable materials (playbooks, troubleshooting guides, configuration SOPs).

About the Job:

The Senior Technical Enablement Program Manager is a crucial team member for the Technical Enablement Programs organization. This role owns the creation and delivery of dedicated programming to support the overarching efforts of our technical enablement team. You are the conductor of enablement programming to ensure role efficacy and the steward of deep product expertise across all of our technical audiences. You will work directly with the technical enablement program managers team to implement our most important programs.

In this role, you will go upstream and collaborate with technical leadership, Operations, Product, Product Marketing, the CTO organization, and our broader enablement teams to ensure that as our processes evolve and our product grows, our technical field teams have the deep-dive knowledge required to effectively position, implement, and support our solutions.

Responsibilities:

The Architect

  • Ensure Technical Efficacy: Be the voice of the technical field on New Product Introductions. You'll rapidly absorb complex architectural changes and translate them into actionable, high-impact technical requirements—answering the essential questions for our technical teams: "How do we deploy this?" "How do we troubleshoot it?" and "What are the known limitations?"
  • Build the Technical Toolkit: Convert product updates into the "Survival Guide" the field uses every day. This includes everything from implementation playbooks and API documentation summaries to troubleshooting trees and technical checklists.
  • (Co)Design Impactful Programs: You are the strategic mind building programs that ensure our technical teams have the product, process, tool, and best practice knowledge needed for excellence. From onboarding to ongoing enablement and strategic initiatives, you drive our teams to success with measurable, worldwide programming.
  • Drive Operational Alignment: Partner with key stakeholders in Operations, Strategic Programs, the CTO organization, and technical leaders directly to ensure global alignment across technical roles, elevating best practices and driving both efficiency and consistency.

The Builder

  • Technical Liaison: Serve as the strategic hub between technical leadership (who defines role-based gaps), implementation groups, the Content Creation team, AI tool builders, and more. Some days will be heavily focused on Program Management—making sure critical projects that benefit the broader enablement team cross the finish line. Other days will be more hands-on—influencing requirements, rapidly prototyping, or whipping up content yourself. You will translate complex technical workflows into precise content requirements and lab scoping documents for production. When you’re at your best, our SMEs spend more time in the field and less time on content.
  • Facilitate Key Sessions: You’re not just a partner behind the scenes; you are the face of technical enablement programming for your audiences. You lead key enablement sessions, can create a killer deck, and get to know your audience well.
  • Lifecycle Knowledge Manager: Working with our content builders and governance teams, you take full responsibility for the key materials needed for our technical roles to succeed. You will consistently review, refresh, and retire outdated guides and documentation to ensure our technical knowledge base is always current and accurate.

The Impact Maker

  • Enablement Impact: Go beyond delivery by actively measuring the effectiveness of technical enablement programs. Use field data, engagement metrics, and audience feedback to drive constant improvement, optimizing for technical proficiency and quantifiable success in the field.
  • Stakeholder Consultant: You are the face of and strategic thought leader for technical enablement for our internal audiences. You build effective relationships with field leaders, individual contributors, supporting teams, and enablement leadership. You are these teams’ trusted advisor in all aspects of technical enablement.

title: IT Support Engineer (hybrid, 90-115k)
summary: The IT Support Engineer will provide global support across the US, UK, and Belgium, managing requests, access, devices, onboarding and offboarding, office technology, and vendor escalations. The role also involves improving IT processes, documentation, automation, request tracking, and compliance controls supporting ISO and SOC certifications.
description:
IT Support Engineer — Global (based in New York)
 About Conveo
 Conveo is an AI-powered qualitative research platform. Our AI moderates real interviews at scale, so insights teams can run qual research with the speed and reach of quant — without losing the depth that makes qual worth doing.
 We've raised a Series A ($50M) and we're headquartered in London, with a team across Belgium and the US. We hold ISO 27001, ISO 27701 and SOC 2 Type II certifications, with ISO 42001 in progress.
 How we work
    AI-first, genuinely.  We use AI across the whole company, not just in the product.

   Automate the boring parts.  If a process runs often, it shouldn't be manual.

   Small team, real ownership.  You'll own systems outright, not a slice of someone else's queue.

   Distributed by design.  Being in a different time zone from your colleagues shouldn't be a handicap.

  About the role
 This is a  global IT role, based in New York. 
 You'd be the second person on Conveo's IT team, working alongside our IT Manager in London and reporting to him. You'd take day-to-day ownership of support, devices, access and the office - freeing the IT Manager to focus on strategy, security and governance.
 Why New York? Presence and coverage. Our US team is growing, and they should be able to reach someone in their own hours rather than wait for the next London morning. With one of us in each region, IT's combined working day stretches across both.
 You'd inherit a modern stack — Okta with SSO and SCIM, Google Workspace, Iru for macOS management,Notion, 1Password, Vanta and a whole load of Internal AI agents — and a lot of room to shape what comes next.
 What you'll do
  Support the team, wherever they are 
   Be a first point of contact for colleagues across the US, UK and Belgium - patient and clear with people who don't share your technical vocabulary

  Triage and resolve requests end-to-end, from password resets to complex access problems, fixing causes rather than symptoms

  When something bigger breaks, drive it to resolution, keep people informed before they ask, and document the root cause

  Own vendor escalations, and know when to bring in the IT Manager — you'll be the only IT person in your time zone for much of the day

   Run identity, access and the employee lifecycle 
   Administer Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, Notion and 1Password day-to-day

  Handle access requests through our approval workflow, and keep our SaaS inventory accurate

  Run onboarding and offboarding end-to-end for any region

   Own devices and the office 
   Manage our macOS fleet through Iru — blueprints, configuration profiles, security baselines — plus BYOD enrolment and hardware lifecycle

  Help engineers with development environment issues: tooling, permissions, machine setup

  Own office AV, meeting booths and hardware, and hold the standard that calls start on time without anyone fiddling with cables

  Shape the office into somewhere people choose to come, because collaborating there is easier than doing it from home

   Improve how IT runs 
   Design the processes that repeat - onboarding, access requests, provisioning

  Decide what should be automated and what shouldn't. Judgement about where a human needs to approve something matters as much as knowing what can be handed off

  Build how we track IT work. We don't have a request tracking system and we want one but we don't want to become a ticket-driven company. Visibility not bureaucracy

  Turn repeat questions into self-service. Write the documentation once — clear internal guides and a knowledge base that colleagues and our helpdesk tooling can both answer from.

   Keep IT compliant 
   Operate the IT controls that sit behind ISO 27001, ISO 27701, SOC 2 and ISO 42001 — access reviews, evidence collection, joiner-mover-leaver records, so audits are seamless rather than a scramble

    Help answer customer security questionnaires and vendor assessments. Clear, accurate answers about how we actually run things.

  Where this role can grow
  Security and compliance ownership.  You'd start by supporting our certifications, evidence, access reviews, control operation across ISO 27001, ISO 27701, SOC 2 and ISO 42001, and grow into being accountable for a defined set of controls.
  Deeper identity work.  User lifecycle management, joiner-mover-leaver automation, and access governance and designing the policy and procedures
  AI governance.  Conveo runs on AI internally as well as selling it. There's a growing body of work around how we govern our own agent and tool usage, access, data boundaries, audit trails.
  The automation roadmap.  More say in what gets built and in what order, and eventually owning the decision rather than proposing it.
 What you bring
 The stack is learnable. The temperament isn't.
    You genuinely like helping people.  Not "tolerates end users" — you enjoy unblocking someone and explaining it in a way that leaves them better off. Personable, approachable, empathetic. This is the one we won't compromise on.

   Meticulous, and calm when things break.  Access provisioning is a security control, not an errand — a sloppy mistake is an incident. You know what to handle yourself and what needs another pair of eyes.

   Comfortable working across time zones.  Much of your support happens in writing, with colleagues you may rarely meet. You write things down without being chased.

   You think in processes.  You notice when something's being done the slow way, and can describe a better version clearly enough that someone else could build it.

   You care about the physical environment.  Working AV and a well-set-up office aren't beneath you — they're most of how people experience IT.

   Solid IT fundamentals — macOS, networking basics, SaaS administration — and hands-on experience with an identity provider and Google Workspace. Okta or Entra ID, or a track record of picking things like this up fast.

   You've run onboarding and offboarding before — groups, roles, access changes, secure deprovisioning.

   Comfortable working autonomously  in a fast-changing environment, without a defined procedure for everything.

  Nice to have
   Startup experience — somewhere small and fast-moving, where the answer to "who owns this?" was often "you, now"

  Agentic AI — you've used AI agents in your own work and have a view on where they're reliable and where a human still needs to approve

  Supporting a distributed or multi-country workforce

  familiarity with SOC 2, ISO 27001, 27701 & 42001

  Setting up request tracking from scratch, especially somewhere that wanted visibility without bureaucracy

  An early-stage IT function where the processes were still being built

  Interview process

title: Sr Product Trainer
summary: The Senior Product Trainer leads internal product training and operational enablement for teams implementing, supporting, and operating WestCX solutions. Responsibilities include developing role-based curricula and reusable learning assets, facilitating training, supporting product and implementation readiness, maintaining knowledge repositories, and measuring training effectiveness.
description:
The Senior Product Trainer, Internal Support & Implementations, leads internal product training for the teams responsible for implementing, supporting, and operating WestCX solutions. This role ensures that employees have the product knowledge, technical understanding, workflows, and job aids needed to deliver consistent outcomes across onboarding, implementation, go-live, and ongoing support.
 The Senior Product Trainer serves as the primary internal training partner for product readiness and operational enablement. This role translates complex product capabilities, configuration requirements, implementation processes, integrations, and support procedures into practical, role-based learning experiences for Support, Implementations, Customer Success, and other operational teams.
 The Senior Product Trainer partners closely with Product Management, Product Marketing, Engineering, Quality Assurance, Implementations, Support, and Operations to prepare teams for new products, enhancements, releases, and changing customer requirements. The role develops repeatable curricula, facilitates training, supports implementation readiness, and maintains searchable training and knowledge assets that improve time to proficiency and reduce reliance on individual subject-matter experts.
 Organizational Alignment
    Department:  Product Marketing and Training

   Reports to:  Senior Director, Product Marketing

   Primary partners:  Product Management, Product Marketing, Engineering, Quality Assurance, Implementations, Client Support, Customer Success, Sales Engineering, and Operations

   Role focus:  Internal product training for Support and Implementations

  Key Responsibilities
 Product Readiness and Training Strategy
   Own the internal training strategy for new products, major enhancements, releases, and implementation capabilities.

  Partner with Product Management and Product Marketing to understand product value, use cases, features, integrations, limitations, readiness status, and intended customer outcomes.

  Define the training, documentation, and readiness requirements needed before a product or enhancement is released to operational teams.

  Maintain role-based learning paths for Support, Implementations, Customer Success, and other impacted internal audiences.

  Identify knowledge gaps and recommend training, documentation, process, or product improvements that improve operational readiness.

  Support and Implementations Enablement
   Develop and deliver training that prepares Support and Implementations teams to configure, deploy, troubleshoot, maintain, and explain WestCX products.

  Translate product functionality into practical workflows, scenarios, troubleshooting approaches, configuration guidance, and escalation paths.

  Support implementation readiness activities, including training needs assessments, environment preparation, workflow demonstrations, user acceptance testing support, go-live preparation, and transition to steady-state operations.

  Create training for both legacy products and evolving platform capabilities, ensuring that content reflects current processes and clearly identifies differences between product lines or operating models.

  Partner with Support leadership to establish the product knowledge, break/fix procedures, documentation, and escalation guidance required for effective ongoing support.

  Support train-the-trainer programs and develop internal champions who can reinforce learning within their teams.

  Curriculum and Content Development
   Design and maintain instructor-led, virtual, self-paced, and blended learning programs.

title: Senior Lead, Procurement Excellence & Market Intelligence

 Sandisk understands how people and businesses consume data and we relentlessly innovate to deliver solutions that enable today’s needs and tomorrow’s next big ideas. With a rich history of groundbreaking innovations in Flash and advanced memory technologies, our solutions have become the beating heart of the digital world we’re living in and that we have the power to shape.
 Sandisk meets people and businesses at the intersection of their aspirations and the moment, enabling them to keep moving and pushing possibility forward. We do this through the balance of our powerhouse manufacturing capabilities and our industry-leading portfolio of products that are recognized globally for innovation, performance and quality.

These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward.
 Job Description
 The Senior Lead, Procurement Excellence & Market Intelligence plays a critical role in advancing the effectiveness, capabilities, and strategic impact of the Procurement and Logistics organization. This position is responsible for developing category market intelligence, leading procurement and logistics onboarding and capability development programs, managing procurement learning tools and methodologies, owning organizational communications and recognition programs, and driving high-priority strategic initiatives.
 The role serves as a central resource for category teams, procurement leaders, and logistics stakeholders by delivering actionable market insights, enhancing organizational capabilities, promoting best practices, and supporting continuous improvement. The ideal candidate combines procurement expertise, analytical rigor, project leadership, strong communication skills, and a passion for organizational development.
 ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
 Category Market Intelligence & Strategic Insights
  Develop and maintain a structured market intelligence program supporting key procurement categories.
 Monitor supplier markets, commodity trends, cost drivers, technology developments, supply-demand dynamics, capacity constraints, and geopolitical risks.
 Produce regular market intelligence reports, category updates, and executive-ready summaries.
 Support category managers and sourcing teams with market research, supplier landscape analysis, benchmarking, and competitive intelligence.
 Identify emerging risks and opportunities that may impact category strategies and sourcing decisions.
 Develop and maintain category intelligence repositories, dashboards, and knowledge resources.
 Partner with category managers and procurement leadership to translate market intelligence into actionable sourcing recommendations.
 Support executive reviews and business planning efforts with market and industry insights.
  Procurement & Logistics Capability Development
  Design, implement, and continuously improve onboarding and capability development programs for Procurement and Logistics team members.
 Develop and maintain training curricula supporting key procurement and logistics competencies, including:  Strategic Sourcing
 Negotiation
 Supplier Relationship Management
 Category Management
 Contracting Fundamentals
 Risk Management
 Procurement Analytics
 Supply Chain and Logistics Fundamentals
 Business Acumen and Stakeholder Engagement
 
 Facilitate training sessions, workshops, learning forums, and knowledge-sharing events.
 Establish role-based learning paths and career development frameworks.
 Partner with functional leaders to identify capability gaps and development priorities.
 Measure and report training effectiveness, participation, and capability improvement outcomes.
 Manage procurement and logistics knowledge management resources, templates, playbooks, and best-practice content.
  Procurement Learning Tools & Methods
  Serve as the business owner for procurement and logistics training platforms, learning tools, capability assessments, and development methodologies.
 Maintain and enhance onboarding materials, learning content, training resources, and knowledge repositories.
 Evaluate and implement new learning technologies, digital content solutions, and knowledge-sharing approaches.
 Promote adoption of standardized procurement methodologies, tools, and best practices through training and education.
 Support continuous improvement initiatives by documenting processes, updating playbooks, and incorporating lessons learned into training materials.
 Ensure learning content remains current with evolving business needs, market conditions, and procurement practices.
  Organizational Communications & Recognition
  Own the monthly Procurement and Logistics Key Progress Update (KPU) process.
 Collect, validate, and synthesize updates from category teams, procurement operations, logistics teams, and functional stakeholders.
 Develop executive-ready communications highlighting accomplishments, cost savings, supplier achievements, market developments, risk mitigation activities, capability-building initiatives, and strategic priorities.
 Manage distribution of monthly updates to Procurement and Logistics employees, leadership, and key business stakeholders.
 Continuously improve communication formats, content quality, and reporting mechanisms to increase stakeholder engagement and visibility.
 Develop presentations, newsletters, leadership messages, and communication materials that reinforce organizational priorities and successes.
 Lead the Procurement and Logistics recognition program, including nomination processes, award criteria, selection governance, and recognition communications.
 Partner with Procurement and Logistics leadership to foster a culture of engagement, collaboration, continuous improvement, and recognition.
 Develop programs that celebrate individual, team, and organizational accomplishments while reinforcing desired behaviors and values.
  Strategic Projects & Continuous Improvement
  Lead special projects and strategic initiatives on behalf of Procurement and Logistics leadership.
 Support procurement transformation efforts, organizational effectiveness initiatives, and operating model improvements.
 Conduct research, benchmarking, financial analysis, and business case development related to strategic priorities.
 Coordinate cross-functional initiatives involving Procurement, Logistics, Finance, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and other business partners.
 Develop executive presentations, recommendations, project updates, and leadership communications.
 Track project milestones, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder communications.
 Identify and implement opportunities to improve organizational efficiency, effectiveness, and stakeholder experience.
 Support annual planning, strategic reviews, and other leadership-driven initiatives.
  Stakeholder Engagement
  Build strong relationships across Procurement, Logistics, Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations, Finance, and business functions.
 Facilitate collaboration and knowledge sharing across global teams.
 Serve as a trusted resource for market intelligence, training, communications, and best practices.
 Influence stakeholders through data-driven insights, effective communication, and strong project leadership.
 Promote alignment across teams by ensuring consistent messaging, transparency, and knowledge dissemination.
  Qualifications
 REQUIRED:
  Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Finance, Engineering, Economics, or related field.
 7-10 years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, category management, supply chain, consulting, organizational development, or related business functions.
 Experience supporting category strategies through market research and data-driven analysis.
 Demonstrated experience developing training programs, onboarding processes, organizational capability initiatives, or learning content.
 Strong project management and stakeholder management skills.
 Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
 Advanced analytical skills and ability to synthesize complex information into actionable recommendations.
 Advanced proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, reporting tools, and data visualization platforms.
  PREFERRED:

 CPSM, ISM, CIPS, PMP, or related professional certification.
 Experience in technology, electronics, semiconductor, manufacturing, or other complex global supply chain environments.

 Experience with learning management systems, knowledge management tools, and internal communications programs.

title: Instructional Designer
summary: The Instructional Designer develops online courses that meet the university’s academic, accessibility, and course-design standards. The role collaborates with subject matter experts and media developers, applies instructional design and assessment strategies, and reviews content to support effective learning experiences.
description:
The Instructional Designer is responsible for designing and developing online courses that align with Excelsior University’s academic standards and best practices for adult learning. Working closely with SMEs, instructional technologists, media developers, and other members of the Instructional Design and Development team (IDD), the Instructional Designer ensures that course content is pedagogically sound, accessible, and aligns with Excelsior’s course design standards. The ideal candidate has experience in higher education course development and expertise in instructional design principles, online learning technologies, and assessment strategies. This role plays a key part in maintaining course quality and supporting Excelsior’s commitment to delivering an exceptional learning experience for students.
 Duties and Responsibilities: 
 • Collaborate with SMEs to design and develop engaging online courses.
• Apply instructional design principles to structure content and create relevant, engaging learning experiences.
• Guide SMEs in analyzing and assessing the application of appropriate and effective instructional strategies, tools, and assessments to achieve identified learning outcomes.
• Ensure course content aligns with Excelsior’s course design standards, accessibility guidelines, and online learning best practices.
• Partner with media developers to create high-quality course materials, including videos, simulations, and interactive elements.
• Review and refine course content to ensure clarity, coherence, and alignment with learning objectives.
• Collaborate with other instructional designers to enhance Excelsior’s course development methodologies and resources.
 Qualifications:  To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 
 • Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, or a related field.
• 3+ years’ experience designing and developing online courses for higher education.
• Strong knowledge of instructional design models (e.g., Backward Design, Bloom’s Taxonomy).
• Strong relationship-building skills.
• Familiarity with best practices for online learning and adult education.
• Ability to guide SMEs in structuring content for effective online delivery.
• Experience with learning management systems (LMS), preferably Canvas.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 • Master’s degree in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, or a related field.
• Experience developing courses for non-traditional, adult learners.
• Prior experience working in a centralized course development model.
• Proficiency in accessibility standards and universal design for learning (UDL).
• Experience using data and learner analytics to inform course improvements.
  The hiring salary range for this position is $68,000.00 - $74,000.00. The hiring salary range above represents the University's good faith estimate at the time of posting.

title: PostgreSQL Solution Architect - Presales
summary: The PostgreSQL Solution Architect supports the sales cycle as a customer-facing technical advisor, leading discovery, solution design, demonstrations, technical validation, and responses to technical RFPs and security questionnaires. The role also helps establish Spinnaker Support’s PostgreSQL practice by shaping migration approaches, reusable technical assets, and field enablement, drawing on expertise in PostgreSQL operations and Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration.
description:
Spinnaker Support provides global enterprise software support, managed services, and project-based consulting to many of the world’s most recognized and respected brands. Founded in 2008, our customer focus, business integrity, exacting standards, and depth of expertise have earned us the trust and loyalty of over 1,300 organizations located in 104 countries. Our dedicated international team works closely with every customer to ensure they receive exceptional, customized services that clear the way for their operational success. Today, Spinnaker Support is proud to be the industry’s highest-rated provider for third-party software support services for Oracle, SAP and VMware.

Spinnaker Support has an immediate opening for a PostgreSQL Solution Architect (SA) to join our team in the US.  

The Postgres Solution Architect serves as a trusted technical advisor throughout the sales cycle and as an early technical leader for Spinnaker Support’s PostgreSQL practice. The role helps prospective and existing customers understand the value of PostgreSQL support, modernization, Oracle-to-PostgreSQL and other migration paths, long-term maintenance, and enterprise operating models in support of their business and technical objectives. Partnering closely with Account Executives, Product, Marketing, Delivery, Engineering, and Customer Success to deliver discovery, solution design, demonstrations, technical validation, and repeatable practice assets.

This role is also central to establishing Spinnaker Support’s PostgreSQL practice in the US. Beyond supporting individual sales opportunities, the Postgres Solution Architect will help shape repeatable solution patterns, customer discovery methods, Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration approaches, field enablement, and technical credibility for a new strategic growth area.

The ideal candidate combines strong PostgreSQL expertise, customer-facing communication skills, and the ability to translate complex technical capabilities into clear business outcomes. This role supports opportunities across the United States and requires collaboration across multiple countries, cultures, and stakeholder groups.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with sales teams to qualify opportunities and identify customer business drivers, technical requirements, and decision criteria
  • Lead technical discovery conversations with customers and prospects to understand current environments, challenges, and future-state goals
  • Assess Oracle-to-PostgreSQL opportunities, including current-state architecture, application dependencies, schema and code compatibility, extensions, data movement, cutover strategy, testing approach, and target operating model
  • Deliver tailored product demonstrations, technical presentations, workshops, and proof-of-value engagements
  • Design solution approaches that align Postgres capabilities with customer requirements, architecture, and operational priorities
  • Respond to technical portions of RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires in collaboration with internal stakeholders
  • Support customer evaluations by addressing architecture, performance, Oracle-to-PostgreSQL and other migration paths, application compatibility, extension strategy, security, integration, operational support, and long-term maintainability questions
  • Act as a trusted advisor on database modernization, platform strategy, and best practices related to PostgreSQL environments
  • Advise on PostgreSQL enterprise support, incident and escalation handling, patch and minor-version maintenance, extension and tooling assessment, backup and recovery strategy, high availability, performance engineering, security, and operational readiness for production workloads
  • Collaborate with Product and Product Marketing to communicate field feedback, market needs, and competitive insights
  • Work with Sales, Product, and Delivery to translate discovery findings into appropriately scoped services, support models, estimates, assumptions, exclusions, and handover materials that can be delivered reliably after contract signature
  • Maintain a strong understanding of the PostgreSQL ecosystem, including community PostgreSQL, major cloud providers, open-source tooling, relevant extensions, commercial PostgreSQL vendors, migration partners, and emerging competitors, and use that knowledge to position Spinnaker’s differentiated value clearly with customers
  • Contribute to enablement assets, demo environments, reusable collateral, and internal knowledge sharing

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
  • A minimum 8+ years hands-on experience with PostgreSQL administration, architecture, performance tuning, query optimization, high availability, backup/recovery, security, extensions, replication, upgrade planning, patch management, and production operations
  • In addition to this, 5+ years of experience in solution consulting, sales engineering, database consulting, or technical pre-sales
  • Experience with Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration, including architecture assessment, application and schema compatibility, migration tooling, performance validation, cutover planning, and post-migration support requirements
  • Experience supporting customer conversations around cloud infrastructure, especially AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and executive audiences
  • Experience leading technical demonstrations, workshops, and proof-of-concept or proof-of-value engagements
  • Strong written communication skills for proposals, technical responses, and customer follow-up
  • Ability to work across US time zones and travel as needed

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, containers, DevOps workflows, and automation tools
  • Exposure to enterprise sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Challenger, or value-based selling
  • Experience in open-source database, PostgreSQL ecosystem, enterprise support, database migration, cloud database, or data infrastructure markets

Success Measures

  • Technical win rate and influence on pipeline progression
  • Quality and impact of customer-facing technical engagements
  • Contribution to achievement of bookings, revenue, and pipeline targets
  • Sales team and customer feedback on responsiveness and effectiveness
  • Development of scalable technical assets, discovery templates, reference architectures, Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration assessment materials, demo environments, competitive battlecards, and field enablement materials that improve sales quality and delivery readiness

We are committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. As such, compensation will ultimately be in line with the labor market data, and the location in which the position is filled. title: Senior Director, Client Education - Healthcare SaaS

description:

 Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.
 Job Description
 The Senior Director, Client Education provides strategic and operational leadership for the Learning & Development function that serves Experian Health's external clients across the product portfolio.
 You will own the vision, roadmap, and execution of a scalable, high-quality client education program spanning instructor-led training, on-demand eLearning, video tutorials, learning labs, and the client Learning Portal.
 You will be accountable for building and leading a team of instructional designers and client educators, operationalizing modern learning practices, and championing innovation including the responsible use of AI to increase the speed, quality, and scale of learning content.
 You will be a senior escalation point and expert, ensuring learning experiences remain current amid frequent product changes while measurably improving client capability, confidence, and satisfaction.
  Improve client adoption, self-service use, product proficiency, and customer satisfaction through measurable education programs and learning experiences.
 Lead the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for our Client Education program across multiple Experian Health products.
