title: Content Lead
summary: The Content Lead will own Browserbase’s content-led growth engine, setting strategy across blogs, documentation, social media, SEO, paid distribution, and launches to increase awareness and drive growth. The role includes leading a cross-functional team, developing the company’s market narrative, creating developer-focused content, building technical partnerships, and representing Browserbase in executive communications, PR, and launches.
description:
About Browserbase 
 Browserbase is the complete platform to build and deploy agents that browse and interact with the web like humans. We’re on a mission to make AI work for people by operating the systems built for humans. We provide one API key for agents to search and fetch information, fill out forms, and replicate user actions. We run 50M+ sessions/month for 10,000+ customers including Ramp, Deepmind, Clay, Vercel, and Notion.
 We're a Series B startup that's tripled our headcount in 2 years, and are continuing to grow, fast. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, CRV, and Notable Capital, our team is building on our CEO's    founding vision   to power the world's best AI tools and help everyone automate the web.
 About the Role
 We're looking for a Content Lead to own our content-led-growth engine. This role would oversee all awareness activities across blogs, docs, socials, SEO, and launches to fuel our top of funnel. You'll craft the point of view that makes developers and technical buyers understand our category and product.
 You’re a great fit for this role if you’ve been in Product Marketing, Content Strategy, Growth Engineering, or Brand Marketing. You love telling stories, writing, and have great taste. And of course, you’ve been an engineer or can market to one.
 What you'll do
    Drive the content strategy  and bar for Browserbase across organic & paid channels to hit our growth goals and measure success.

   Define the market  we’re operating in and the thought leadership we need to own it, in partnership with our Product Marketers.

   Run and grow a team  that spans content, product marketing, and developer experience.

   Review and create content  that developers actually want to read and share.

   Work on strategic technical partnerships  for where Browserbase can integrate with other tools. This includes integrations, documentation, and co-marketing.

   Partner with Sales, Product, and Growth  making sure content performs, converts, and is useful across the funnel.

   Represent Browserbase  in high-visibility moments like launches, executive writing, PR, and Partnerships.

  What we're looking for
   7+ years in content or brand marketing at a developer-facing company, with execution and strategy.

  A track record of building content programs that moved pipeline and revenue.

  Fluency across Twitter, LinkedIn, Reddit, and Hacker News.

  Strong SEO instincts and comfort with paid content and distribution, not just organic.

  Excellent writing and editing, with a clear point of view on what makes writing good.

  Experience managing and growing a team.

  A real interest in the browser automation and AI agent space, and the judgment to translate that into a market narrative.

  You've led content at a company through a major market shift or category creation.

  You've written or ghostwritten for executives.

   Benefits 
   Competitive salary + meaningful early-stage equity

  Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents

  401(k)

  Daily catered lunches with a fully-stocked kitchen

  Beautiful office in downtown San Francisco

  All the AI tools + credits you want

  Regular team offsites and company events

title: Content Lead
summary: The Content Lead will own Endex's brand narrative and content across its website, launches, customer stories, product education, social channels, and sales enablement. The role partners with founders, product, GTM, and sales teams to explain a technical AI product to buyers, build audience and pipeline, and measure content performance.
description:
Who We Are 
 Endex builds AI agents that handle complex, end-to-end work for the world's most demanding teams. Today we're deployed across leading financial institutions and Fortune 500 companies, embedded in the tools and workflows they rely on. We operate at the frontier of agentic knowledge work, partnering closely with top AI research labs and backed by the OpenAI Startup Fund. We're on a mission to build the most capable digital coworker in the world.
  About the Role 
  Location:  New York City
 Commitment:  5-6 Days In-Person
 We're looking for someone who can make a technical product obvious to demanding buyers. As Content Lead at Endex, you'll own how we tell our story: the website, launches, customer stories, product education and social. You'll work directly with our founders, product and GTM teams to shape how the market understands agentic work and where Endex fits in it.
  Your Key Responsibilities 
    Own the Narrative:  Define how Endex talks about itself across every surface. Set the voice, sharpen the positioning and keep it consistent as the product and market move.

   Ship Launches:  Plan and write product announcements, release notes and launch campaigns. Turn new capabilities into stories buyers understand in one read.

   Build Customer Stories:  Work with customers to capture how their teams actually use Endex. Turn real deployments into case studies and proof points our sales team can use.

   Explain the Product:  Create demos, walkthroughs, videos and guides that show what agents can do across email, Teams, Excel, Word and PowerPoint. Make the complex feel obvious.

   Grow Our Channels:  Own the website, blog, LinkedIn and X. Build an audience of the people we sell to and the people we want to hire.

   Enable GTM:  Partner with sales on decks, one-pagers, email sequences and competitive positioning. You're not just producing content. You're helping close deals.

   Measure What Works:  Track what drives pipeline, engagement and inbound. Double down on what works and cut what doesn't.

   What We're Looking For 
    Proven content leader:  3-8 years writing and shipping content for a B2B or technical product. Your portfolio shows range across launches, long-form and social.

   Exceptional writer:  You write clearly, cut ruthlessly and match voice to audience. Your first draft is better than most people's final.

   Technically fluent:  You can learn how agentic systems work well enough to explain them accurately. You're comfortable interviewing engineers and turning what they say into something anyone can follow.

   Credible with experts:  You can write for analysts, operators and executives without talking down or overselling. You earn trust with specifics.

   Strong opinions on the story:  You have ideas about how Endex should show up in the market. You're not shy about sharing them.

   Relentlessly resourceful:  You move fast, ship often and figure things out without a playbook.

   Versatile problem-solver:  You're intellectually curious, quick to learn and eager to take on new challenges across a wide range of responsibilities.

   Nice to Have 
   Early-stage startup experience

  Experience writing about AI, developer tools or enterprise software

  Video, design or editing skills

   Full-Time Benefits 
   Health & Dental Insurance

  Monthly Wellness Stipend

  401K Matching

  Competitive Salary + Equity

title: Content Lead
summary: Avoca is hiring its first Content Lead to build and own the company’s content function, strategy, and end-to-end content programs. The role focuses on SEO and AI-search visibility, customer and original research content, demand generation, and measuring impact on qualified pipeline while collaborating with Product Marketing, Brand, and Sales.
description:
About Avoca 
 Avoca is transforming how home service companies engage with their customers. Our AI-powered conversational agents handle every high-value inbound call, from booking jobs, qualifying leads, and driving higher revenue, all at a speed and consistency unmatched by human call centers.
 We're a Series B startup backed by Kleiner Perkins, Meritech Capital, General Catalyst, and other top-tier investors, with $125M raised and a $1B valuation. We grew 10x in 2025 and have scaled to 130+ employees in under two years across our NYC headquarters and Santa Barbara office.
 In a $1T+ market where 85% of missed calls go to competitors, we're building the category-defining platform for AI-driven customer engagement, serving the largest brands in home services. With high-energy, in-office teams in both locations, every hire here has an immediate and visible impact.
  About the Role 
 We’re hiring Avoca’s first dedicated Content Lead to build our content function from the ground up and make Avoca the trusted source for how home services businesses grow and use AI.
 You’ll own how Avoca earns attention and gets discovered — from how we show up across Google and AI search to the customer stories, original research, and points of view that shape how the home services market thinks. Your work will help Avoca show up when buyers are actively looking for answers while giving home services leaders a reason to follow, trust, and engage with us before they enter a sales process.
 This is a highly hands-on role. You’ll set the strategy and drive content from idea through research, creation, distribution, and measurement. You’ll interview customers and subject-matter experts and turn Avoca’s expertise, data, and customer results into content that’s useful, compelling, and worth people’s attention.
 You’ll use AI to increase the speed and scale of the content operation while maintaining a high bar for originality, accuracy, and quality. Above all, you’ll approach content as a growth engine — thinking beyond traffic and engagement to how it creates and captures demand, supports campaigns, and drives qualified pipeline.
 You’ll report directly to the Head of Growth and work closely with Product Marketing, Brand, and Sales.
  What You’ll Do 
   Build and own Avoca’s content strategy, identifying the questions, topics, stories, and points of view we should own based on customer needs, competitive whitespace, and revenue potential

  Grow Avoca’s visibility across Google and AI search by mapping how buyers look for answers, creating authoritative content, and strengthening our presence across the sources AI answer engines trust and cite

  Own and execute the content program end to end—researching, interviewing, writing, and editing high-intent pages, guides, customer stories, original research, lead generation assets, and social content

  Turn content assets into demand generation campaigns across multiple channels (e.g., search, paid email, outbound)

  Define and track performance across search and AI visibility, qualified traffic, conversions, opportunities, and influenced pipeline

  Build AI-first workflows that accelerate research, creation, optimization, repurposing, and distribution without compromising originality, accuracy, or editorial quality

   What You’ll Bring 
   5+ years of experience in content marketing, organic growth, or a related role, ideally at a fast-growing B2B technology company

  A portfolio of excellent work and a track record of building content programs that generate qualified traffic, conversions, and pipeline

  Strong, current knowledge of SEO and AEO/GEO, including how companies earn visibility and citations across AI search

  Exceptional writing, interviewing, and narrative skills, with the ability to find a compelling angle and make complex ideas clear and engaging

  Strong editorial judgment: you can distinguish genuine insight from generic content and turn rough ideas into work that is credible, useful, and distinctively Avoca

  Experience creating content across the buyer journey, from high-intent organic pages to customer stories, original research, and other authority-building content

  Strong commercial and analytical instincts, including an understanding of demand generation and the ability to use performance data to improve results

  Deep fluency with AI tools and a track record of using them to materially increase the quality, speed, and volume of content

   Who You Are 
   You have a strong instinct for what makes a story worth telling and know how to draw differentiated insights and proof points out of customers and subject-matter experts

  You’re a zero-to-one builder who is energized by creating the strategy, standards, workflows, and measurement for a new content function

  You’re commercially curious. You want to understand why customers buy, what prevents them from buying, and how content can create momentum throughout the buyer journey

  You think about distribution and conversion from the beginning, not after something is published

  You’re AI-native and constantly redesigning how you work to produce better content faster without accepting generic output, weak reasoning, or unsupported claims

  You stay ahead of how AI answer engines are changing buyer behavior, content discovery, and distribution—and translate those shifts into Avoca’s approach

  You combine high standards with speed, knowing when to refine, when to ship and learn, and where your effort will have the greatest impact

  You’re high-agency, resourceful, collaborative, and excited to work in person in NYC with an ambitious team

   Bonus Points 
   Experience marketing to SMB or mid-market buyers in a high-velocity sales motion

  Experience in vertical SaaS, home services, or another industry-specific market

  Hands-on experience with AI-search, SEO, and content tools such as Profound, Semrush, Google Search Console, or GA4

  Experience turning proprietary data or original research into content that earns attention, links, and citations

  Experience creating video-first customer stories or translating written ideas into compelling video content

   Benefits 
   Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance

  Company-sponsored 401(k) through Vestwell

  Flexible PTO plus U.S. federal holidays

  Company-wide off-sites

  Daily in-office lunch through Parkday

  Monthly wellness stipend

  Dinner covered when working late

  Commuter benefits and late-night rideshare

  Standing desks and workspace accommodations available on request

  All core tools and software provided

  
 Compensation:  The expected base salary for this role is $160,000-$210,000 with final compensation based on experience, skills, and qualifications determined during the interview process. Avoca’s total compensation package includes base salary, bonus, equity, and a comprehensive suite of benefits and perks. Our Recruiting team will share the full details as you progress through our hiring process.
  Why Avoca 
 At Avoca, you’ll be part of a team that’s building a category-defining company at the center of a massive market opportunity. We’re a fast-moving, collaborative team with a culture designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and impact.
  Avoca provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability.

title: Content Lead
summary: White Circle is seeking a Content Lead to own content strategy and editorial direction for its AI safety platform. The role involves interviewing customers and technical stakeholders, creating and publishing technical and non-technical content, developing product launch narratives, supporting go-to-market efforts, and building repeatable content processes.
description:
About White Circle
  White Circle  is an AI Safety company building the safety, reliability, and optimization layer for AI systems. At the core of our platform are policies – simple natural-language rules that define what an AI model should and shouldn’t do. We automatically test, enforce, and continuously improve these policies at scale.
   We’ve raised $11M from top funds, founders, and senior leaders at OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace, Mistral, DeepMind, Datadog, Sentry, and others

  We process over one hundred million API calls every month

  We fine-tune and train our own LLMs so they run faster and cheaper than any open or proprietary model

  We’re a small, highly focused team. If you want to work deeply on hard problems, see your work ship to production quickly, and influence how AI safety is actually built – you’re the one we need.
 What you'll do
   Own White Circle's content strategy and editorial direction

  Turn customer conversations into case studies, customer stories, and reference materials

  Interview customers, partners, founders, and engineers to uncover insights worth sharing

  Write and publish long-form content across Medium, Substack, LinkedIn, X, and our website

  Develop technical and non-technical content explaining AI safety, evaluation, governance, and reliability

  Create launch narratives for new products, features, and research initiatives

  Work closely with GTM team to support sales conversations and market positioning

  Help founders maintain a consistent public voice across LinkedIn, X, conferences, and other channels

  Build repeatable processes for content creation, publication, and distribution

  Experiment with new formats, channels, and ways of reaching technical audience

  We're looking for someone who
   Is an exceptional writer

  Can take a complex technical topic and explain it clearly without oversimplifying it

  Knows how to find interesting stories inside products, customers, and technology

  Has strong editorial judgment

  Can independently identify what is worth publishing and what isn't

  Is comfortable interviewing executives, engineers, researchers, and customers

  Has experience creating content for technical audiences

  Can move comfortably between strategic thinking and hands-on writing

  Is fluent in English

   A big plus 
   You have an engineering, computer science, or technical background

  You have built an audience through writing

  You've worked at a developer tools, AI, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, or enterprise software company

  You've written content that materially influenced product adoption, company positioning, or revenue generation

  Why White Circle
   Meaningful equity package

    Paid time off in line with your local regulations, no matter where you work from

  Best medical insurance in France

  All the hardware, tools, and services you need

  Covered subscriptions for AI agents and IDEs

  Team off-sites twice a year: we’ve recently been to the Alps and to Saint-Tropez

  How we hire
   Intro call with HR (25 min)

  Take-home assignment

  Final conversation with our CEO and Head of Design (45 min)
 * an additional interview with one or more team members may be added depending on the interview process 


   Along with your application, please send us 3 pieces of writing you're most proud of and tell us why you chose them.

title: Senior Content Designer
summary: The Senior Content Designer will architect content strategies, taxonomies, governance frameworks, and communication systems for complex, high-risk financial trading products. The role leads regulatory and AI-content governance, designs content for new financial instruments and trading workflows, mentors junior designers, and partners with cross-functional stakeholders on regulated fintech initiatives.
description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. We're looking for an exceptional Futures Risk Program Manager to help shape the future of our core platforms, products, and customer experiences. FinTech is one of the most complex and rapidly evolving spaces in technology, and the challenges we're tackling require deep innovation, critical thinking, and scale that don't always have strong precedents.

You'll take on a highly influential role shaping vision and execution across key strategic initiatives. You'll partner with cross-functional leaders, contribute to high-impact decisions, guide complex projects from concept to completion, and mentor others on the team. This is a role for someone who leverages modern tools and cutting-edge methodologies as a core part of how they solve problems, and raises the bar for everyone around them.

This role is based in our Chicago, IL, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

title: Senior Content Designer
summary: Ibotta is seeking a Senior Content Designer to own end-to-end content design for complex B2B and consumer product areas. The role includes developing scalable content systems and standards, using research and behavioral data to guide decisions, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to improve product experiences. It is a hybrid position based in Denver, Colorado, requiring three days in the office.
description:
Ibotta is seeking an experienced  Senior Content Designer  to join our UX team and contribute to our mission to Make Every Purchase Rewarding. As part of our team, you'll shape the language, structure, and flow of the experiences that help millions of shoppers save money and help our brand clients and publishers grow their businesses. Reporting to the Director of UX Research, you will partner closely with product management, product design, UX research, and engineering to craft content that makes complex products feel simple, trustworthy, and easy to use. This role is crucial in ensuring our products speak with a clear, consistent voice, regardless of where a user accesses our tools.
 This is a senior-level role with the opportunity to raise the bar for content design at Ibotta. You’ll contribute to building scalable systems and best practices while also rolling up your sleeves on high-visibility product work. The ideal candidate is a strong systems thinker who partners easily across disciplines and can flex between hands-on craft and strategic influence.
 This position is located in Denver, Colorado as a hybrid position requiring 3 days in office (Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday). Candidates must live in the United States.
  Not based in Denver? We will offer a relocation bonus to help make your move to the Mile High City a smooth one. 
  What you will be doing: 
   Own end-to-end content design for complex, ambiguous product areas that span both B2B and consumer domains.

  Establish and evolve content standards, voice and tone guidelines, and reusable patterns that scale across squads and product surfaces.

  Use behavioral data and user research to pressure test content decisions, iterating based on evidence and expertise.

  Identify content gaps and opportunities proactively.

  Raise the quality bar for content by reviewing and providing feedback on the work of UX, product management, and engineering team members.

  Work with UX leadership to evangelize the value and process of content design.

  Embrace and uphold Ibotta's Core Values: Integrity, Boldness, Ownership, Teamwork, Transparency, & A Good Idea Can Come from Anywhere 

   What we are looking for: 
   4 to 6 years of experience in content design, UX writing, content strategy, or a related field. Ideal candidates will have experience within a consumer-facing tech product or marketplace/platform environment.

  Ideal candidates will have experience with conversational design.

  Bachelor's degree in English, Communications, Journalism, Human-Centered Design, a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

  A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end content design work that demonstrates your writing process, problem-solving skills, examples of polished UI copy, and a measurable impact on the user experience.

  Excellent facilitation and communication skills, with the ability to present and defend content decisions to cross-functional and senior stakeholders.

  Experience building or scaling content systems, style guides, or governance frameworks across multiple teams or products.

  Familiarity with design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma), collaboration/documentation tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence), and AI tools (e.g. Claude Code, OpenAI Codex).

  A deep curiosity for understanding users and empathizing with their problems, paired with the judgment to know when data should override a strong opinion.

   About Ibotta ("I bought a...") 
 Ibotta (NYSE: IBTA) is a leading performance marketing platform allowing brands to deliver digital promotions to over 200 million consumers through a network of publishers called the Ibotta Performance Network (IPN). The IPN allows marketers to influence what people buy, and where and how often they shop – all while paying only when their campaigns directly result in a sale. American shoppers have earned over $2.6 billion through the IPN since 2012. The largest tech IPO in history to come out of Colorado, Ibotta is headquartered in Denver, and is continually listed as a top place to work by The Denver Post and Inc. Magazine.
 To learn more about what our Tech teams are doing day to day, visit   Building Ibotta on    Medium.com  
  Additional Details: 
   This position is located in Denver, CO, and includes competitive pay, flexible time off, a benefits package (including medical, dental, and vision), a Lifestyle Spending Account, an Employee Stock Purchase Program, and 401k match. Denver office perks include paid parking, snacks, and occasional meals. 

  Base compensation range: $131,000 - $153,000. Equity is included in the overall compensation package. This compensation range is specific to the United States labor market and may be adjusted based on actual experience.

  Ibotta is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Ibotta's employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected status.

  Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

  Applicants are accepted until the position is filled.

  For the security of our employees and the business, all employees are responsible for the secure handling of data in accordance with our security policies, identifying and reporting phishing attempts, as well as reporting security incidents to the proper channels.

title: Senior Content Designer
summary: The Senior Content Designer leads content strategy, UX writing, information architecture, and content quality across Brightspeed’s eCommerce funnels and customer journeys. Responsibilities include developing scalable content frameworks and systems, simplifying complex information, partnering cross-functionally, using AI-assisted content methods, measuring content performance, and mentoring design partners.
description:
Company Description
 At Brightspeed, we are reimagining how people live, work, play and connect by providing fast, reliable internet connections and an awesome customer experience in twenty states throughout the Midwest and South.
 Backed by funds managed by Apollo Global Management, our vision is to accelerate the upgrade of copper to fiber optic technologies, bringing faster and more reliable internet service to many rural markets traditionally underserved by broadband providers, while delivering best-in-class customer experience.
 Be a part of the team that will make this vision a reality….designing and building a world class fiber network and creating a customer experience second to none.
  Check us out on the web! 
 Job Description
 The Senior Content Designer, Product Design, eCommerce is a senior individual contributor responsible for the content strategy, experience language, information architecture, and content quality across Brightspeed’s eCommerce ecosystem. This role looks across multiple funnels and customer journeys to define the overall content approach, connect related experiences, identify patterns, and ensure customers receive clear, consistent, and helpful guidance from discovery through purchase, account creation, installation, and post-order moments. 
 This role is strategy-led. The Senior Content Designer is expected to understand the full digital ecosystem, define content frameworks across funnels, influence product and design direction, and guide how content supports business goals, customer comprehension, conversion, accessibility, and long-term experience quality. This role uses AI-assisted tools to improve content strategy, content operations, and conversational customer experiences while maintaining accuracy, clarity, accessibility, and customer trust. 
 The Senior Content Designer also acts as a mentor and coach for other content and product design partners. This person helps raise the quality of the team’s content work through critique, standards, documentation, reusable patterns, and practical guidance. They are accountable for connecting the details of interface copy to the broader customer journey and ensuring content decisions scale across the eCommerce experience. 
 IMPACT 
  Content Strategy Across Funnels  
   Own content strategy across multiple eCommerce funnels, including acquisition, service qualification, plan comparison, cart, checkout, account creation, installation scheduling, order confirmation, post-order education, and related self-service journeys. 

    Identify how content decisions in one part of the journey affect customer comprehension, conversion, support needs, and downstream experience quality in other funnels. 

    Apply AI-assisted methods to content analysis, exploration, prototyping, or conversational experiences, and help establish clear, responsible content practices for AI-enabled interactions. 

    Create content frameworks, journey-level messaging strategies, decision trees, naming systems, and information architecture recommendations that help customers understand options and complete tasks with confidence. 

    Partner with product design, product management, analytics, research, marketing, legal, and engineering to shape experience strategy before detailed execution begins. 

    Use customer insights, funnel data, usability findings, experimentation results, and stakeholder input to identify content gaps and prioritize improvements. 

    Balance business requirements, legal constraints, brand voice, product complexity, and customer needs when defining content direction. 

   Experience Architecture & UX Writing Leadership  
   Lead content design for complex, ambiguous, or high-impact eCommerce initiatives that require systems thinking across pages, flows, platforms, and customer states. 

    Define the role of content in the experience, including page hierarchy, customer guidance, progressive disclosure, comparison logic, error recovery, and decision support. 

    Write and refine high-value interface content including headlines, CTAs, labels, helper text, product education, comparison language, error messages, confirmation content, and transactional guidance. 

    Translate complex product, pricing, eligibility, installation, promotional, legal, or technical information into clear and customer-friendly experiences. 

    Ensure content decisions support accessibility, plain language, inclusive language, responsive design, and measurable customer outcomes. 

    Create content annotations, rationale, content models, and handoff documentation for engineering, QA, product, legal, and business partners. 

   Mentoring, Coaching & Team Elevation  
   Coach and mentor content designers, product designers, and cross-functional partners on content design best practices, UX writing, journey thinking, and customer-centered communication. 

    Lead content critiques, content reviews, and working sessions that improve the quality, consistency, and strategic value of the team’s work. 

    Help less experienced content designers move from task execution to stronger journey awareness, rationale, and systems thinking. 

    Create reusable guidance, templates, standards, and examples that make strong content decisions easier for the broader team. 

    Model strong stakeholder communication by explaining content strategy, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations clearly to both working teams and leadership. 

   Content Systems, Governance & Measurement  
   Contribute to content standards, voice and tone guidance, reusable UX writing patterns, and content components within Brightspeed’s design system. 

    Define and maintain patterns for forms, errors, alerts, CTAs, plan cards, comparison tables, checkout steps, eligibility states, confirmation messages, and post-order guidance. 

    Identify outdated, inconsistent, duplicated, or conflicting messaging across funnels and recommend governance improvements. 

    Partner with analytics and experimentation teams to evaluate content performance and identify opportunities to improve clarity, conversion, and task completion. 

    Support content inventories, audits, journey maps, and documentation that give the team a clear view of the broader content ecosystem. 

  May perform other duties as assigned.
 Qualifications
  YOU WILL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU  
   Hold a bachelor’s degree in English, Communications, UX, HCI, Design, Journalism, Content Strategy, or a related field, or bring equivalent practical experience. 

    Bring 7 or more years of experience in content design, UX writing, product content strategy, or digital content design. 

    Have practical experience using AI within a professional content-design or content-strategy workflow and can speak confidently about at least one relevant example. 

    Have experience shaping content strategy across multiple digital funnels, customer journeys, or product areas. 

    Have a portfolio that demonstrates strategic content design, journey-level thinking, systems thinking, UX writing craft, and measurable experience improvements. 

    Can simplify complex product, pricing, legal, technical, or operational information into clear customer-facing experiences. 

    Can mentor other designers, lead critiques, and raise the quality of content work across a team. 

    Understand product design workflows and can collaborate fluently with UX/UI designers, product managers, engineers, researchers, analysts, marketing, and legal partners. 

    Are comfortable working in Figma and reviewing content directly within design files. 

    Understand accessibility, plain language, inclusive language, responsive design, content governance, and design systems. 

    Can lead content decisions in ambiguous situations and communicate strategic rationale with confidence. 

   A PLUS IF YOU HAVE  
   Experience in telecommunications, broadband, utilities, subscription services, regulated digital experiences, or complex eCommerce ecosystems. 

    Experience with checkout, cart, plan comparison, promotions, service qualification, account creation, onboarding, or self-service funnels. 

    Experience contributing to design systems, content systems, UX writing guidelines, or content governance models. 

    Experience with experimentation, content testing, usability testing, conversion optimization, analytics, or journey measurement. 

    Knowledge with SEO, personalization, localization, or Spanish-language content workflows. 

   LANGUAGE SKILLS  
 English required. Bilingual Spanish a plus. 
  PHYSICAL DEMANDS  
 Work is primarily sedentary, performed indoors from a home or company office while operating a computer and standard office productivity tools. Occasional additional hours may be required to meet project deadlines. 
 #LI-RW1
 Additional Information
  WHY JOIN US? 
   We aspire to contemporary ways of working.  
 Recognized as a Top Workplace by the Charlotte Observer, Brightspeed HQ is located on the 7th floor of the new Vantage South End - East Tower in Charlotte, NC. We prioritize hiring talent in the Charlotte area, whenever possible, to make it a truly vibrant destination for our hybrid workforce. At Brightspeed, we have roles that are designated as remote, hybrid, office or field-based, depending on the position, business needs and individual circumstances. We also invest in technology that enables our entire team to stay connected. Why? Because Brightspeed recognizes the value of finding the best talent for the job, wherever they may be.
   We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits.  
 Our benefits and paid time off programs reflect our underlying belief in promoting overall wellness through physical, emotional and financial health. Brightspeed offers a comprehensive benefit program, including competitive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance; an employee assistance program; a 401K plan with company match and a host of voluntary benefits. 
   Inclusion and belonging     are at the center of our grounding belief in Being Real .  
 When we bring our authentic selves to work, everyone is better as a result. A diverse team helps us be fierce advocates for more accessible, inclusive and high-quality internet, because we believe doing so promotes equity in the communities we serve.
 Brightspeed is an Equal Opportunity Employer that is committed to inclusion of all qualified individuals, including individuals with a disability/veterans. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact  taaccommodationrequests@brightspeed.com  to initiate the accommodations process. 
 For all applicants, please take a moment to review our Privacy Notices:

title: Senior Digital Learning Experience Designer - Learning & Inclusion
summary: Spotify is seeking a Senior Digital Learning Experience Designer to create inclusive, effective learning experiences across digital, live, blended, and self-directed formats. The role leads end-to-end instructional design, partners with subject-matter experts and stakeholders, develops interactive learning materials using authoring and design tools, and evaluates outcomes through feedback and performance data.
description:
We’re looking for a Senior Digital Learning Experience Designer to join our Learning & Inclusion team, the group responsible for creating learning experiences that help every Spotify band member grow, belong, and do their best work.
 You’ll bring together instructional design, visual design, storytelling, and broader learning and development expertise to create inclusive and effective experiences at scale. You’ll partner with subject-matter experts, people leaders, and Learning & Inclusion colleagues on company-wide initiatives, from leadership development to programs that bring Spotify’s values to life.
  What You'll Do
  Lead the end-to-end design of learning experiences, from needs analysis and curriculum architecture through development, launch, and evaluation.
 Partner with subject-matter experts and stakeholders to identify performance needs and turn them into clear learning objectives and practical solutions.
 Design learning journeys across live, digital, blended, and self-directed formats using evidence-based learning principles.
 Create engaging learning materials, including eLearning, facilitator guides, participant resources, job aids, presentations, and micro-learning experiences.
 Use visual design and storytelling to make complex ideas clear, memorable, and engaging while creating experiences that feel unmistakably Spotify.
 Build interactive digital learning experiences using AI-assisted workflows and authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline or Rise, Adobe Captivate, or similar platforms.
 Design inclusive learning experiences that reflect different perspectives, reduce barriers to participation, and support a culture of belonging.
 Pilot and iterate on learning experiences using learner feedback, stakeholder input, and performance data.
 Define meaningful measures of success and evaluate learning effectiveness, knowledge transfer, learner experience, and behavior change.
 Manage multiple learning projects from initial scoping through delivery while creating clarity around priorities, timelines, and stakeholder expectations.
 Explore emerging approaches in learning design, including AI-assisted authoring and adaptive learning, and apply them where they can meaningfully improve the learner experience.
  Who You Are
  You have 5+ years of professional instructional design experience and a portfolio demonstrating thoughtful work across multiple learning formats.
 You apply learning science principles such as cognitive load, retrieval practice, spaced learning, and adult learning theory to practical design decisions.
 You know how to uncover learning and performance needs, translate them into measurable objectives, and design learning journeys that build knowledge and skills over time.
 You create meaningful practice through scenarios, simulations, assessments, and other interactive experiences rather than relying on passive content.
 You have strong visual and UX design judgment and understand how typography, hierarchy, layout, and visual storytelling can make learning clearer and easier to navigate.
 You have experience with rapid authoring tools such as Articulate 360, Captivate, Lectora, or similar platforms, along with design tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, or equivalent.
 You can create clear storyboards, scripts, facilitator guides, and supporting materials that help others confidently deliver consistent learning experiences.
 You use learner feedback and data to evaluate effectiveness, iterate on your work, and connect learning experiences to meaningful outcomes.
 You communicate complex ideas clearly and collaborate effectively with subject-matter experts, leaders, and cross-functional partners.
 You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, balancing multiple priorities, and taking ownership from an early idea through a polished learning experience.
 You bring experience in areas such as inclusive learning design, leadership development, learning technology, short-form learning video or animation, LMS/LXP platforms, or SCORM/xAPI.
 You have a degree in instructional design, learning sciences, education, human-computer interaction, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  Where You'll Be
  This role is based in New York
 We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
  The United States base range for this position is $87,000 – $125,000 USD, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.  
   Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.    At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

title: Learning Experience Designer
summary: Sentry is seeking a Learning Experience Designer to create innovative, learner-centric learning solutions by applying instructional design principles, UX methodologies, and modern technologies. The role involves collaborating with stakeholders, designing multimedia-rich learning experiences, and measuring impact through data analytics. The position requires a Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) and 3+ years of related experience.
description:
Sentry’s Learning Experience Designers leverage technology and learning theory to design innovative learning solutions.     As a Learning Experience Designer,  you’ll  craft engaging, effective, and innovative learning experiences that empower our associates and drive business outcomes.  You’ll  apply principles of performance-based learning in the workplace, User Experience methodologies, and modern technologies to create holistic learning journeys that support continuous development and performance. Partnering closely with subject matter experts and stakeholders,  you’ll  assess performance needs, design learner-centric solutions, and develop multimedia-rich learning assets to ensure every interaction is intuitive, impactful, and aligned with Sentry’s strategic goals.  

  What You'll Do  
       Collaborate & Assess Needs:    Partner with subject matter experts and business stakeholders to conduct thorough needs assessments, define performance-based learning  objectives  , and align solutions with business priorities.  

        Design & Develop Engaging Experiences:    Create and develop engaging, learner-centric experiences across diverse modalities, including e-learning, live  facilitated  learning, immersive simulations, blended programs, and performance support systems.  

        Apply UX & Technology:    Utilize  User Experience design principles and apply learning technology and authoring tools to ensure  optimal  learning effectiveness and transfer to on-the-job performance.  

        Create Multimedia Content:    Design visually appealing, interactive, and multimedia-rich learning materials (storyboards, scripts, visual designs, e-learning, videos, assessments) that incorporate graphic design principles and brand standards.  

        Manage Projects & Evaluate Impact:    Apply effective project management principles, including Agile methodologies, to deliver learning projects on time and within budget. Develop and implement evaluation strategies using data analytics to measure business impact and provide data-driven recommendations.  

        Innovate & Grow:    Stay current with industry trends and best practices in performance-based learning, UX, and emerging technologies. Contribute to researching  new approaches  and  participate  in peer reviews, actively  seeking  and providing constructive feedback.  

      What it Takes  
  To be eligible for this career-launching opportunity, you must meet the following criteria:  
       Bachelors  Degree  or equivalent work experience. Degree in Learning Experience Design, Instructional Design, user Experience Design, Talent  Development  or a related field highly preferred  .  

        Minimum of  3  years related work experience.  

        Experience  designing,  developing  and implementing learning solutions using rapid prototyping,  storyboards  and instructional script writing techniques.  

        Experience  with e-learning authoring  tools and  integrat  ing with  LMS platforms.  P  roficient  in writing,  editing,  and proofreading learning content.  

        Knowledge  of contemporary adult learning theories and instructional design models and the ability to develop innovative learning solutions with minimal supervision.  

        Experience in applying adult learning theories and instructional design frameworks into professional learning engagements.  

        Ability to write effective instructional text and media scripts that support learning and instructional resources.  Visual & graphic design skills with ability to storyboard and produce finished graphics.  

        Proficient in current instructional design tools,  video  and audio creation, editing tools and applicable programming languages. Research and remain current with emerging technologies.  

        Experience with virtual delivery, podcasts, micro learning, learner centric design, eLearning and social media  , and video  solutions.  

      Here is what you can look forward to as part of our team  :  
     At Sentry, your total rewards go beyond competitive compensation.  We’re  committed to supporting the  whole  you, which is why we offer a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive both professionally and personally.   
         Hybrid Flexibility:    Enjoy the best of both worlds. With optional work from home on Mondays and Fridays and join your team in the office Tuesday through Thursday to collaborate and learn.  We provide the technology and tools you need for both your office and home workspace from day one.  

        Dining on  Us:    Depending on your location, we  may  provide a stipend that can be used at our on-site cafeteria or a meal allowance to keep you fueled.  

        Continuous Learning:    Unlock your potential through Sentry University and take advantage of our tuition reimbursement program.  

        Comprehensive Benefits:    We support your whole self with  group  medical, dental, and vision  insurance  along with parental leave,  pet insurance,  caregiver  leave,  and wellness resources.  Options for HSA, FSA, and Dependent Care FSA are available.

title: Customer Education & Learning Experience Designer
summary: The Customer Education & Learning Experience Designer will create and manage customer education programs covering Microsoft 365, cybersecurity, AI tools, CubX products, and technology workflows. Responsibilities include producing instructional videos and visual content, building onboarding journeys and learning paths, maintaining documentation, collaborating with technical subject matter experts, and improving content based on customer feedback and adoption data.
description:

 CubX is a modern Managed Service Provider (MSP) transforming how businesses experience technology.
 We believe IT should be simple, secure, and enjoyable—not confusing or intimidating. Through automation, thoughtful design, and world-class customer experiences, we're changing what businesses expect from their technology partner.
 As we continue building the future of our platform and services, we're looking for someone who can redefine how customers learn.
 If you're passionate about education, design, storytelling, and making complex technology easy to understand, we'd love to meet you.
  Why CubX? 
 At CubX, we believe our clients are more than just tickets—they're our friends. We're committed to providing top-notch service with a personal touch. We like to take a creative approach, think outside the box, and get ahead of issue before they arise. We also believe in providing a balanced environment, with benefits that include:
  Competitive Salary & Comprehensive Benefits Package: Health, dental, vision, 401(k), and PTO.
 Professional Development: Access to training and certification programs to grow your skills in areas like Microsoft 365, Azure, and networking.
 Fun & Inclusive Company Culture: Team events, social activities, onsite gym for physical wellness, and a supportive work environment that values your ideas and input.
   Want to see what what It’s really like to work at CubX?

 We're looking for a  Customer Education & Learning Experience Designer  to create one of the best customer education programs in the MSP industry.

 Customer onboarding courses
 Interactive learning paths
 Help center articles and knowledge base content
 In-app guidance and tutorials
 Product documentation
 AI-assisted training experiences
 Visual graphics and illustrations
 Customer success playbooks
 Internal employee onboarding and training
 Feature release education
 Security awareness content
 Microsoft 365 adoption guides

title: Social Media And Email Marketing Specialist
summary: The Social Media and Email Marketing Specialist owns social media and email marketing for a fintech wealth planning platform. Responsibilities include managing social channels and community engagement, coordinating content and agencies, running HubSpot email campaigns and A/B tests, and tracking performance to improve audience growth and campaign results.
description:
About the Role
 This role owns social media and email marketing for a fintech wealth planning platform, sitting within the Marketing team and reporting to the Head of Marketing. You will shape how the brand shows up across every channel, turning each post and campaign send into a learning opportunity that drives real audience growth and engagement.
 What You'll Do
   Manage brand social media channels across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, and TikTok, keeping content on-brand and on-calendar.

  Partner with external content creation agencies to brief, align, and deliver work on time.

  Build and maintain a content calendar that supports campaigns and key announcements.

  Engage daily by responding to comments, answering DMs, and starting real conversations with the audience.

  Spot trends quickly and translate them into on-brand content opportunities.

  Own the email marketing strategy in HubSpot, from planning through execution.

  Write and design newsletters that subscribers genuinely want to read.

  Run continuous experiments on subject lines, send times, formats, and segmentation to improve opens, clicks, and conversions.

  Track performance weekly, report clearly, and adjust strategy based on data.

  What We're Looking For
   1 to 2 years of experience in social media, email marketing, or digital marketing with measurable results.

  Demonstrated track record of growing audiences or improving campaign performance metrics through owned work.

  Hands-on experience managing at least one major social platform, including content posting, community engagement, and performance tracking.

  Strong writing skills with a natural instinct for brand voice and tone across social posts, email copy, and newsletters.

  Proficiency executing email campaigns in HubSpot or a comparable platform such as Mailchimp or Klaviyo.

  Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests on email campaigns.

  Comfort reading marketing performance data and translating it into clear, actionable insights.

  Experience coordinating with external agencies, content creators, or freelancers to deliver on-brand work on deadline.

  Background in fintech, personal finance, or consumer brand marketing is a plus.

  Familiarity with paid social advertising to complement organic strategy is a plus.

  Compensation & Benefits
 Salary range:  $80,000 to $100,000 USD annually.  Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.
 Location
 This is a full-time, on-site role based in  New York, NY, United States.

title: Senior Lifecycle & Email Marketing Strategist
summary: The Senior Lifecycle & Email Marketing Strategist owns lifecycle email strategy, campaign architecture, audience segmentation, deployment, testing, and measurement for complex B2B marketing programs. The role partners cross-functionally to align content, cadence, KPIs, governance, and AI-assisted personalization across email nurtures, events, webinars, and product launches.
description:
Company Description
 It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
 Join us to put AI to work for people.
 Job Description
 The Senior Email and Lifecycle Marketing Strategist owns lifecycle email strategy and deployment for high-complexity or high-visibility programs, spanning a subset of existing Integrated Marketing buying group programs (IT, CRM, Employee Experience, Risk & Security). 
 Each program strategy covers audience segmentation, campaign architecture, content POV, volume and cadence plan, and KPIs by campaign type. The Senior Lifecycle & Email Marketing Strategist will set the point of view across these dimensions, partners with Integrated counterparts to align, and deploys in Marketo Engage or AJO. 
  Responsibilities  
  Own lifecycle and email campaign architecture across email nurtures, webinar promotion, event invitations, and product launches, driving alignment with Campaign Managers. 
 Manage lifecycle email strategy and deployment for high-complexity or high-visibility books (Flagship events, multi-product, or multi-region scope), mapped to buying group structures and the ABX motion. 
 Define audience segmentation for each program (buying group roles, account tier, lifecycle stage), driving alignment with Audience Planners. 
 Partner with Content Strategists to shape email content POV, providing recommendations on the email content journey. 
 Set the volume and cadence plan (quarterly volume, audience cuts, fatigue governance), driving alignment with Audience Planners and Campaign Managers. 
 Define KPIs and activities by campaign type, tied to program business outcomes and the ABX motion. 
 Build, configure, and deploy email programs end-to-end in Marketo Engage or comparable platform, including branching logic, dynamic content, and template architecture. 
 Refine the lifecycle copy framework for the assigned book and use AI-assisted tooling to scale persona-level content across Champions, Economic Buyers, and Influencers. 
 Operate the team's human-in-the-loop approval gates on agentic builds and contribute to refinement of governance standards within the assigned book. 
 Design A/B and multivariate testing programs, surface insights through QBR reporting, and proactively address sequencing conflicts and governance risks. 
  Qualifications
  Qualifications  
 6+ years in B2B email marketing, lifecycle marketing, or marketing automation, with hands-on experience deploying programs in an enterprise marketing automation platform and a track record operationalizing lifecycle strategy. 
  Hard Skills  
  Email Platform Fluency: Hands-on experience deploying email programs in Marketo Engage required. Adobe Journey Optimizer B2B, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or Oracle Eloqua acceptable. Depth in audience selection, triggered sends, dynamic content, branching logic, and template architecture. 
 Lifecycle Program Design: Multi-stage strategies across Awareness, Education, Acquisition, Progression, and Adoption (industry equivalents: awareness, consideration, conversion, pipeline progression, and retention), including Flagship event programs and multi-product motions. 
 Audience and Cadence Strategy: Designs audience segmentation and cadence architecture for high-complexity books. Sets volume targets, audience cuts, and fatigue rules that hold across overlapping programs without creating channel conflict. 
 Content POV and Copy: Shapes narrative arc and copy recommendations using the lifecycle copy framework. Fluency on persona-level messaging and content strategy. 
 Testing and Measurement: A/B and multivariate testing tied to business impact. Defines KPIs by campaign type and translates results into stakeholder-ready insights. 
 Analytical Fluency: Partners closely with Analytics and Digital partners to scope out KPI’s and build an impactful performance report that tells how programs are driving growth from multiple angles of performance data. 
 AI and Automation Fluency: Practical use of the lifecycle copy framework, AI-assisted copy and personalization tooling, and human-in-the-loop approval gates on agentic builds. Brings judgment on where AI improves program quality and where it doesn’t. 
 Compliance Fluency: CAN-SPAM, CASL, GDPR, CCPA/CPRA. 
   Soft Skills (Leadership Competencies)  
  Cross-Functional Influence: Operates as the email channel voice in Integrated planning forums for assigned programs. Brings recommendations and tradeoffs that shape program direction. 
 Strategic Definition: Defines program strategy within ambiguous or high-complexity scope, then translates it into executable plans. 
 Systems Thinking: Sees how email decisions ripple across cadence, sender reputation, and buying group engagement. 
 Operational Discipline: Holds multiple high-stakes programs on overlapping timelines, stepping in to unblock sequencing or governance issues before they escalate. 
 Automation Mindset: Identifies manual work worth automating, with judgment on where AI helps and where it does not. 
   Preferred  
  Track record applying ABM, ABX, or buying group frameworks to email strategy. 
 Fluency with Adobe Experience Platform and Real-Time CDP. 
 Familiarity with webinar and event platforms (ON24, RainFocus) and their integration into lifecycle programs. 
 Track record using AI tools to improve email throughput, personalization, or decision quality. 
  For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $114200-$199900 plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs.  Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.  Additional Information
  Work Personas 
 We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location.  Learn more here  . To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.
  Equal Opportunity Employer 
 ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity,  veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.  
  Accommodations 
 We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact  globaltalentss@servicenow.com  for assistance. 
  Export Control Regulations 
 For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

title: Senior Specialist, Email Marketing Operations
summary: The Senior Specialist, Email Marketing Operations executes partner marketing campaigns, with a focus on eBlast development, audience segmentation, deployment, quality assurance, and performance reporting. The role uses Marketo and marketing automation expertise to deliver compliant campaigns, coordinate with internal teams and partners, and optimize engagement and revenue outcomes.
description:
SHRM is a member-driven catalyst for creating better workplaces where people and businesses thrive together. As the trusted authority on all things work, SHRM is the foremost expert, researcher, advocate, and thought leader on issues and innovations impacting today’s evolving workplaces. With nearly 340,000 members in 180 countries, SHRM touches the lives of more than 362 million workers and their families globally.     Summary
  The Senior Specialist, Email Marketing Operations supports the execution of client marketing campaigns within Advertising Operations, with primary responsibility for eBlast development, audience segmentation, deployment, quality assurance, and performance reporting. The role applies advanced marketing automation expertise to ensure campaigns are delivered accurately, on time, and in accordance with contractual commitments, SHRM standards, and applicable legal requirements, serving as a day-to-day point of contact for assigned partners and ensuring seamless execution of partnership initiatives. 
 Responsibilities
   Execute marketing plans for Brand Partnership campaigns, including eBlasts, events, webinar promotions, and executive positioning, in alignment with established strategy, business priorities, and contractual commitments. Manage audience segmentation, targeting, and deployment for partner campaigns in Marketo, including advanced filters to prevent audience fatigue and maintain high engagement rates. 
  Serve as the day-to-day campaign execution contact, coordinating with Advertising, Sales, Product, and Events teams to support timely, client-focused delivery. Ensure all campaigns adhere to legal and industry best practices, including CAN-SPAM compliance. 
  Craft partner emails in Marketo with attention to SHRM branding, tone, and engagement best practices. 
  Performance Optimization: Monitoring campaign performance, prepare reports, and recommend enhancements to improve future campaign effectiveness. Conduct research on client organizations to inform campaign execution and identify insights for Advertising and Sales partners. Coordinate internally across sales, marketing, and events teams to ensure timely delivery of partnership commitments. 
  Support achievement of revenue and engagement goals for assigned accounts, tracking against performance benchmarks. 
  Position SHRM as a trusted advisor and thought leader by incorporating organizational research, workforce insights, and HR trends into client conversations, as appropriate. 
  Education & Experience Requirements
 Education
   Bachelor’s degree preferred or relevant equivalent experience in lieu of degree.  
  Experience
   Five (5) or more years of experience in marketing automation, digital marketing, and email operations. 
  Experience supporting sales or partnership activities within HR-related programs or equivalent professional services. 
  Demonstrated ability to manage multiple accounts and projects simultaneously while maintaining high attention to detail. 
  Proficiency in CRM systems (e.g., Marketo), PowerPoint, Excel, and related tools. 
  Strong research and outreach skills to identify potential prospects and partnership opportunities. 
  Certifications  - NA 
 Knowledge, Skills & Abilities
   Ability to effectively leverage artificial intelligence (AI) tools and technologies to streamline workflows, enhance productivity, and improve overall work quality. 
  Ability to identify campaign issues, recommends solutions, and escalates matters requiring changes to established processes or standards. Can resolve complex campaign-execution issues within established guidelines and escalates significant risks, roadblocks, or exceptions. Exemplary communication skills, both written and oral. 
  Ability to gain a thorough understanding of SHRM products and services to collaborate closely with internal stakeholders who have delivery responsibility for SHRM offerings and to bundle these offerings in creative ways to meet client requirements. 
  Strong sense of accountability for achieving results. 
  Ability to understand and communicate concepts quickly and accurately. 
  Accomplished skills in developing proposals and client presentations. 
  Strong attention to detail. 
  Self-start; Resourcefulness; self-motivated. 
  Disciplined, agile. 
  Ability to effectively leverage artificial intelligence (AI) tools and technologies to streamline workflows, enhance productivity, and improve overall work quality. 
  Physical Requirements
  This position operates in a typical office environment (which includes a home office setting) and requires the ability to perform essential job functions with or without reasonable accommodation. Physical requirements may include: 
   Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. 
  Frequent use of hands and fingers for typing, handling documents, and using office equipment. 
  Occasional standing, walking, bending, and reaching. 
  Ability to lift and carry up to 30 pounds as needed. 
  Clear verbal and written communication skills for effective interaction with colleagues and stakeholders. 
  Work Environment
   Fully Remote:   
Employees must be available during standard business hours, with core hours beginning between 8:00–9:00 a.m. and concluding between 5:00–6:00 p.m.   
 Travel:  Moderate 20 – 30%
 #LI
   The hiring range for this position is $80,000 to $98,000 per year. This range is an estimate, and the actual salary may vary based on the candidate's experience, skills, and qualifications. SHRM offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package. The benefits for this position include professional growth and development, health, dental, vision, well-being, health savings, flexible spending, retirement, open leave, and annual discretionary bonus and incentives.

SHRM is an equal opportunity employer (Minority/Female/Disabled/Veteran).      We do not sponsor applicants for work visas.

title: Senior Scaled Customer Education Specialist
summary: The Senior Scaled Customer Education Specialist will design, deliver, and facilitate scalable customer education programs, including digital learning programs, live webinars, and cohort-based training. The role develops learning assets, manages live-session logistics, supports customer questions, analyzes engagement data, and collaborates with Customer Success and Product teams to improve customer adoption of Samsara’s connected operations platform.
description:
Who we are  
  Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 
  Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 
   About the role:
 
 Do you want to join a dynamic, creative team? Samsara's Customer & Partner Education team is looking for a trainer to help us scale our reach and customer support globally. As a Senior Scaled Customer Education Specialist focused primarily on our Scale segment (i.e. Commercial and Mid-market accounts), you'll help thousands of customers derive immediate value from our connected operations platform. Across one:many digital programs, live webinars, and cohort-based training sessions, you'll guide customers through structured learning journeys, make complex platform concepts accessible and actionable, and ensure success at every stage of their journey — across transportation, construction, field services, and the many other industries Samsara serves.
  This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US   except   the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.  
  You should apply if: 
   You want to impact the industries that run our world:  Every session you deliver can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  You thrive the most when solving problems:  Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically design and deliver training that helps keep operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  You are a natural relationship builder:  Whether with customers or cross-functional teams at Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  You are the architect of your own career:  If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  You want to be with the best:  At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.
   In this role, you will: 
  Build, deliver and facilitate cohort-based one:many programs for customers, guiding groups through structured learning journeys from onboarding through advanced product adoption
 Design new, innovative experiences tying together physical and digital assets to live sessions and/or Community experiences
 Produce new and leverage existing training materials in accordance with team standards and brand guidelines; adapt existing materials to reflect product changes and audience needs
 Proactively leverage in-house and external tools and platforms to optimize the training you deliver (e.g., Samsara Community, in-house AI tools; Slido)
 Demonstrate expertise across the Samsara platform and show confidence in fielding a wide range of customer questions during live sessions
 Manage all live session logistics, including training registration, session delivery, Q&A facilitation, polling, and post-session follow-up resources
 Collaborate closely with the CS Scale as well as the rest of the Education team to shape content for live training and share customer feedback from training events
 Identify common knowledge gaps across the Scale customer base and partner with Customer Success and Product teams to address them through programming
  Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices 
   Minimum requirements for the role: 
  Excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills. You make complex platform concepts clear and compelling for large, diverse audiences, both in your verbal delivery and in the materials you produce.
 Demonstrated experience delivering at-scale programs and live webinars or vILT to external audiences.
 Excellent interpersonal skills. You're dynamic and enthusiastic, and you connect well with people at any level of an organization.
 Ability to build digital learning assets when needed, e.g., video tutorials, job aids, and presentation decks, using AI models, authoring and editing tools.
 A working grasp of instructional design: you structure content around clear learning objectives and can help shape a program, not just deliver it.
 Self-directed and analytical. You can teach yourself new products and tools quickly and assess what customers most need to know.
 Ability to analyze engagement and impact data, then iterate on your content to improve what's working and fix what isn't.
 Strong prioritization skills. You handle multiple programs and sessions concurrently while staying organized, methodical, and detail-oriented.
 An eye for detail and polish in everything you produce.
 Comfortable working independently and as part of a team.
 3–4 years of experience teaching or delivering training, with at least 1 year in a one-to-many or scaled delivery model.
   An ideal candidate also has: 
  Familiarity with webinar and virtual classroom platforms and tools 
 Experience with LMS and Community platforms, and customer education content development tools 
 Background in SaaS product training
      The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below. 
  Annual Base Salary   $80,622.50  —  $121,950 USD       Total Rewards 
 At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why  our rewards  are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
 Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
  Flexible Working  
  At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements.
